55void VLCReader::xReadCodeTr(uint32_t length, uint32_t& rValue, const char *pSymbolName)
56{
57#if RExt__DECODER_DEBUG_BIT_STATISTICS
58 xReadCode (length, rValue, pSymbolName);
59#else
60 xReadCode (length, rValue);
61#endif
62 if (length < 10)
63 {
64 DTRACE( g_trace_ctx, D_HEADER, "%-50s u(%d) : %u\n", pSymbolName, length, rValue );
65 }
66 else
67 {
68 DTRACE( g_trace_ctx, D_HEADER, "%-50s u(%d) : %u\n", pSymbolName, length, rValue );
69 }
70}

104#if RExt__DECODER_DEBUG_BIT_STATISTICS || ENABLE_TRACING
105void VLCReader::xReadSCode (uint32_t length, int& value, const char *pSymbolName)
106#else
107void VLCReader::xReadSCode (uint32_t length, int& value)
108#endif
109{
110 uint32_t val;
111 assert ( length > 0 && length<=32);
112 m_pcBitstream->read (length, val);
113 value= length>=32 ? int(val) : ( (-int( val & (uint32_t(1)<<(length-1)))) | int(val) );
114
115#if RExt__DECODER_DEBUG_BIT_STATISTICS
116 CodingStatistics::IncrementStatisticEP(pSymbolName, length, value);
117#endif
118#if ENABLE_TRACING
119 if (length < 10)
120 {
121 DTRACE( g_trace_ctx, D_HEADER, "%-50s i(%d) : %d\n", pSymbolName, length, value );
122 }
123 else
124 {
125 DTRACE( g_trace_ctx, D_HEADER, "%-50s i(%d) : %d\n", pSymbolName, length, value );
126 }
127#endif
128}

133#if RExt__DECODER_DEBUG_BIT_STATISTICS
134void VLCReader::xReadCode (uint32_t uiLength, uint32_t& ruiCode, const char *pSymbolName)
135#else
136void VLCReader::xReadCode (uint32_t uiLength, uint32_t& ruiCode)
137#endif
138{
139 CHECK( uiLength == 0, "Reading a code of length '0'" );
140 m_pcBitstream->read (uiLength, ruiCode);
141#if RExt__DECODER_DEBUG_BIT_STATISTICS
142 CodingStatistics::IncrementStatisticEP(pSymbolName, uiLength, ruiCode);
143#endif
144}

146#if RExt__DECODER_DEBUG_BIT_STATISTICS
147void VLCReader::xReadUvlc( uint32_t& ruiVal, const char *pSymbolName)
148#else
149void VLCReader::xReadUvlc( uint32_t& ruiVal)
150#endif
151{
152 uint32_t uiVal = 0;
153 uint32_t uiCode = 0;
154 uint32_t uiLength;
155 m_pcBitstream->read( 1, uiCode );
156#if RExt__DECODER_DEBUG_BIT_STATISTICS
157 uint32_t totalLen=1;
158#endif
159
160 if( 0 == uiCode )
161 {
162 uiLength = 0;
163
164 while( ! ( uiCode & 1 ))
165 {
166 m_pcBitstream->read( 1, uiCode );
167 uiLength++;
168 }
169
170 m_pcBitstream->read( uiLength, uiVal );
171
172 uiVal += (1 << uiLength)-1;
173#if RExt__DECODER_DEBUG_BIT_STATISTICS
174 totalLen+=uiLength+uiLength;
175#endif
176 }
177
178 ruiVal = uiVal;
179#if RExt__DECODER_DEBUG_BIT_STATISTICS
180 CodingStatistics::IncrementStatisticEP(pSymbolName, int(totalLen), ruiVal);
181#endif
182}

184#if RExt__DECODER_DEBUG_BIT_STATISTICS
185void VLCReader::xReadSvlc( int& riVal, const char *pSymbolName)
186#else
187void VLCReader::xReadSvlc( int& riVal)
188#endif
189{
190 uint32_t uiBits = 0;
191 m_pcBitstream->read( 1, uiBits );
192#if RExt__DECODER_DEBUG_BIT_STATISTICS
193 uint32_t totalLen=1;
194#endif
195 if( 0 == uiBits )
196 {
197 uint32_t uiLength = 0;
198
199 while( ! ( uiBits & 1 ))
200 {
201 m_pcBitstream->read( 1, uiBits );
202 uiLength++;
203 }
204
205 m_pcBitstream->read( uiLength, uiBits );
206
207 uiBits += (1 << uiLength);
208 riVal = ( uiBits & 1) ? -(int)(uiBits>>1) : (int)(uiBits>>1);
209#if RExt__DECODER_DEBUG_BIT_STATISTICS
210 totalLen+=uiLength+uiLength;
211#endif
212 }
213 else
214 {
215 riVal = 0;
216 }
217#if RExt__DECODER_DEBUG_BIT_STATISTICS
218 CodingStatistics::IncrementStatisticEP(pSymbolName, int(totalLen), uiBits);
219#endif
220}

234void VLCReader::xReadRbspTrailingBits()
235{
236 uint32_t bit;
237 READ_FLAG( bit, "rbsp_stop_one_bit");
238 CHECK(bit!=1, "Trailing bit not '1'");
239 int cnt = 0;
240 while (m_pcBitstream->getNumBitsUntilByteAligned())
241 {
242 READ_FLAG( bit, "rbsp_alignment_zero_bit");
243 CHECK(bit!=0, "Alignment bit is not '0'");
244 cnt++;
245 }
246 CHECK(cnt >= 8, "Read more than '8' trailing bits");
247}

249void AUDReader::parseAccessUnitDelimiter(InputBitstream* bs, uint32_t &audIrapOrGdrAuFlag, uint32_t &picType)
250{
251 setBitstream(bs);
252
253#if ENABLE_TRACING
254 xTraceAccessUnitDelimiter();
255#endif
256
257 READ_FLAG (audIrapOrGdrAuFlag, "aud_irap_or_gdr_au_flag");
258 READ_CODE (3, picType, "pic_type");
259 xReadRbspTrailingBits();
260}
261
262void FDReader::parseFillerData(InputBitstream* bs, uint32_t &fdSize)
263{
264 setBitstream(bs);
265#if ENABLE_TRACING
266 xTraceFillerData();
267#endif
268 uint32_t ffByte;
269 fdSize = 0;
270 while( m_pcBitstream->getNumBitsLeft() >8 )
271 {
272 READ_CODE (8, ffByte, "ff_byte");
273 CHECK(ffByte!=0xff, "Invalid filler data : not '0xff'");
274 fdSize++;
275 }
276 xReadRbspTrailingBits();
277}

296void HLSyntaxReader::copyRefPicList(SPS* sps, ReferencePictureList* source_rpl, ReferencePictureList* dest_rp)
297{
298 dest_rp->setNumberOfShorttermPictures(source_rpl->getNumberOfShorttermPictures());
299
300 dest_rp->setNumberOfInterLayerPictures( sps->getInterLayerPresentFlag() ? source_rpl->getNumberOfInterLayerPictures() : 0 );
301
302 if( sps->getLongTermRefsPresent() )
303 {
304 dest_rp->setLtrpInSliceHeaderFlag(source_rpl->getLtrpInSliceHeaderFlag());
305 dest_rp->setNumberOfLongtermPictures( source_rpl->getNumberOfLongtermPictures() );
306 }
307 else
308 dest_rp->setNumberOfLongtermPictures(0);
309
310 uint32_t numRefPic = dest_rp->getNumberOfShorttermPictures() + dest_rp->getNumberOfLongtermPictures();
311
312 for( int ii = 0; ii < numRefPic; ii++ )
313 {
314 dest_rp->setRefPicIdentifier( ii, source_rpl->getRefPicIdentifier( ii ), source_rpl->isRefPicLongterm( ii ), source_rpl->isInterLayerRefPic( ii ), source_rpl->getInterLayerRefPicIdx( ii ) );
315 }
316}
317
318void HLSyntaxReader::parseRefPicList(SPS* sps, ReferencePictureList* rpl, int rplIdx)
319{
320 uint32_t code;
321 READ_UVLC(code, "num_ref_entries[ listIdx ][ rplsIdx ]");
322 uint32_t numRefPic = code;
323 uint32_t numStrp = 0;
324 uint32_t numLtrp = 0;
325 uint32_t numIlrp = 0;
326
327 if (sps->getLongTermRefsPresent() && numRefPic > 0 && rplIdx != -1)
328 {
329 READ_FLAG(code, "ltrp_in_slice_header_flag[ listIdx ][ rplsIdx ]");
330 rpl->setLtrpInSliceHeaderFlag(code);
331 }
332 else if(sps->getLongTermRefsPresent())
333 {
334 rpl->setLtrpInSliceHeaderFlag( 1 );
335 }
336
337 bool isLongTerm;
338 int prevDelta = MAX_INT;
339 int deltaValue = 0;
340 bool firstSTRP = true;
341
342 rpl->setInterLayerPresentFlag( sps->getInterLayerPresentFlag() );
343
344 for (int ii = 0; ii < numRefPic; ii++)
345 {
346 uint32_t isInterLayerRefPic = 0;
347
348 if( rpl->getInterLayerPresentFlag() )
349 {
350 READ_FLAG( isInterLayerRefPic, "inter_layer_ref_pic_flag[ listIdx ][ rplsIdx ][ i ]" );
351
352 if( isInterLayerRefPic )
353 {
354 READ_UVLC( code, "ilrp_idx[ listIdx ][ rplsIdx ][ i ]" );
355 rpl->setRefPicIdentifier( ii, 0, true, true, code );
356 numIlrp++;
357 }
358 }
359
360 if( !isInterLayerRefPic )
361 {
362 isLongTerm = false;
363 if (sps->getLongTermRefsPresent())
364 {
365 READ_FLAG(code, "st_ref_pic_flag[ listIdx ][ rplsIdx ][ i ]");
366 isLongTerm = (code == 1) ? false : true;
367 }
368 else
369 isLongTerm = false;
370
371 if (!isLongTerm)
372 {
373 READ_UVLC(code, "abs_delta_poc_st[ listIdx ][ rplsIdx ][ i ]");
374 if ((!sps->getUseWP() && !sps->getUseWPBiPred()) || (ii == 0))
375 {
376 code++;
377 }
378 int readValue = code;
379 if (readValue > 0)
380 {
381 READ_FLAG(code, "strp_entry_sign_flag[ listIdx ][ rplsIdx ][ i ]");
382 if (code)
383 {
384 readValue = -readValue;
385 }
386 }
387 if (firstSTRP)
388 {
389 firstSTRP = false;
390 prevDelta = deltaValue = readValue;
391 }
392 else
393 {
394 deltaValue = prevDelta + readValue;
395 prevDelta = deltaValue;
396 }
397
398 rpl->setRefPicIdentifier( ii, deltaValue, isLongTerm, false, 0 );
399 numStrp++;
400 }
401 else
402 {
403 if (!rpl->getLtrpInSliceHeaderFlag())
404 READ_CODE(sps->getBitsForPOC(), code, "poc_lsb_lt[listIdx][rplsIdx][j]");
405 rpl->setRefPicIdentifier( ii, code, isLongTerm, false, 0 );
406 numLtrp++;
407 }
408 }
409 }
410 rpl->setNumberOfShorttermPictures(numStrp);
411 rpl->setNumberOfLongtermPictures(numLtrp);
412 rpl->setNumberOfInterLayerPictures( numIlrp );
413}
414
415void HLSyntaxReader::parsePPS( PPS* pcPPS )
416{
417#if ENABLE_TRACING
418 xTracePPSHeader ();
419#endif
420 uint32_t uiCode;
421
422 int iCode;
423 READ_CODE(6, uiCode, "pps_pic_parameter_set_id");
424 CHECK(uiCode > 63, "PPS id exceeds boundary (63)");
425 pcPPS->setPPSId (uiCode);
426
427 READ_CODE(4, uiCode, "pps_seq_parameter_set_id");
428 pcPPS->setSPSId (uiCode);
429
430 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_mixed_nalu_types_in_pic_flag" ); pcPPS->setMixedNaluTypesInPicFlag( uiCode == 1 );
431
432 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "pps_pic_width_in_luma_samples" ); pcPPS->setPicWidthInLumaSamples( uiCode );
433 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "pps_pic_height_in_luma_samples" ); pcPPS->setPicHeightInLumaSamples( uiCode );
434 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_conformance_window_flag");
435 pcPPS->setConformanceWindowFlag( uiCode );
436 if (uiCode != 0)
437 {
438 Window& conf = pcPPS->getConformanceWindow();
439 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "pps_conf_win_left_offset"); conf.setWindowLeftOffset(uiCode);
440 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "pps_conf_win_right_offset"); conf.setWindowRightOffset(uiCode);
441 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "pps_conf_win_top_offset"); conf.setWindowTopOffset(uiCode);
442 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "pps_conf_win_bottom_offset"); conf.setWindowBottomOffset(uiCode);
443 }
444 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_scaling_window_explicit_signalling_flag" );
445 if( uiCode != 0 )
446 {
447 Window &scalingWindow = pcPPS->getScalingWindow();
448 READ_SVLC( iCode, "pps_scaling_win_left_offset" ); scalingWindow.setWindowLeftOffset( iCode );
449 READ_SVLC( iCode, "pps_scaling_win_right_offset" ); scalingWindow.setWindowRightOffset( iCode );
450 READ_SVLC( iCode, "pps_scaling_win_top_offset" ); scalingWindow.setWindowTopOffset( iCode );
451 READ_SVLC( iCode, "pps_scaling_win_bottom_offset" ); scalingWindow.setWindowBottomOffset( iCode );
452 }
453 else
454 {
455 Window &scalingWindow = pcPPS->getScalingWindow();
456 Window& conf = pcPPS->getConformanceWindow();
457 scalingWindow.setWindowLeftOffset( conf.getWindowLeftOffset() );
458 scalingWindow.setWindowRightOffset( conf.getWindowRightOffset() );
459 scalingWindow.setWindowTopOffset( conf.getWindowTopOffset() );
460 scalingWindow.setWindowBottomOffset( conf.getWindowBottomOffset() );
461 }
462
463 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_output_flag_present_flag" ); pcPPS->setOutputFlagPresentFlag( uiCode==1 );
464
465 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_no_pic_partition_flag"); pcPPS->setNoPicPartitionFlag(uiCode == 1);
466 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_subpic_id_mapping_present_flag" ); pcPPS->setSubPicIdMappingInPpsFlag( uiCode != 0 );
467 if( pcPPS->getSubPicIdMappingInPpsFlag() )
468 {
469 if( !pcPPS->getNoPicPartitionFlag() )
470 {
471 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "pps_num_subpics_minus1"); pcPPS->setNumSubPics(uiCode + 1);
472 }
473 else
474 {
475 pcPPS->setNumSubPics(1);
476 }
477 CHECK( uiCode > MAX_NUM_SUB_PICS-1, "Number of sub-pictures exceeds limit");
478
479 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "pps_subpic_id_len_minus1" ); pcPPS->setSubPicIdLen( uiCode + 1 );
480 CHECK( uiCode > 15, "Invalid pps_subpic_id_len_minus1 signalled");
481
482 CHECK((1 << pcPPS->getSubPicIdLen()) < pcPPS->getNumSubPics(), "pps_subpic_id_len exceeds valid range");
483 for( int picIdx = 0; picIdx < pcPPS->getNumSubPics( ); picIdx++ )
484 {
485 READ_CODE( pcPPS->getSubPicIdLen( ), uiCode, "pps_subpic_id[i]" ); pcPPS->setSubPicId( picIdx, uiCode );
486 }
487 }
488 if(!pcPPS->getNoPicPartitionFlag())
489 {
490 int colIdx, rowIdx;
491 pcPPS->resetTileSliceInfo();
492
493 // CTU size - required to match size in SPS
494 READ_CODE(2, uiCode, "pps_log2_ctu_size_minus5"); pcPPS->setLog2CtuSize(uiCode + 5);
495 CHECK(uiCode > 2, "pps_log2_ctu_size_minus5 must be less than or equal to 2");
496
497 // number of explicit tile columns/rows
498 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "pps_num_exp_tile_columns_minus1" ); pcPPS->setNumExpTileColumns( uiCode + 1 );
499 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "pps_num_exp_tile_rows_minus1" ); pcPPS->setNumExpTileRows( uiCode + 1 );
500 CHECK(pcPPS->getNumExpTileColumns() > MAX_TILE_COLS, "Number of explicit tile columns exceeds valid range");
501
502 // tile sizes
503 for( colIdx = 0; colIdx < pcPPS->getNumExpTileColumns(); colIdx++ )
504 {
505 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "pps_tile_column_width_minus1[i]" ); pcPPS->addTileColumnWidth( uiCode + 1 );
506 CHECK(uiCode > (pcPPS->getPicWidthInCtu()-1), "The value of pps_tile_column_width_minus1[i] shall be in the range of 0 to PicWidthInCtbY-1, inclusive");
507 }
508 for( rowIdx = 0; rowIdx < pcPPS->getNumExpTileRows(); rowIdx++ )
509 {
510 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "pps_tile_row_height_minus1[i]" ); pcPPS->addTileRowHeight( uiCode + 1 );
511 CHECK(uiCode > (pcPPS->getPicHeightInCtu() - 1), "The value of pps_tile_row_height_minus shall be in the range of 0 to PicHeightInCtbY-1, inclusive");
512 }
513 pcPPS->initTiles();
514 // rectangular slice signalling
515 if (pcPPS->getNumTiles() > 1)
516 {
517 READ_CODE(1, uiCode, "pps_loop_filter_across_tiles_enabled_flag"); pcPPS->setLoopFilterAcrossTilesEnabledFlag(uiCode == 1);
518 READ_CODE(1, uiCode, "pps_rect_slice_flag");
519 }
520 else
521 {
522 pcPPS->setLoopFilterAcrossTilesEnabledFlag(false);
523 uiCode = 1;
524 }
525 pcPPS->setRectSliceFlag(uiCode == 1);
526 if (pcPPS->getRectSliceFlag())
527 {
528 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "pps_single_slice_per_subpic_flag"); pcPPS->setSingleSlicePerSubPicFlag(uiCode == 1);
529 }
530 else
531 {
532 pcPPS->setSingleSlicePerSubPicFlag(0);
533 }
534 if (pcPPS->getRectSliceFlag() & !(pcPPS->getSingleSlicePerSubPicFlag()))
535 {
536 int32_t tileIdx = 0;
537
538 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "pps_num_slices_in_pic_minus1" ); pcPPS->setNumSlicesInPic( uiCode + 1 );
539 CHECK(pcPPS->getNumSlicesInPic() > MAX_SLICES, "Number of slices in picture exceeds valid range");
540 if ((pcPPS->getNumSlicesInPic() - 1) > 1)
541 {
542 READ_CODE(1, uiCode, "pps_tile_idx_delta_present_flag");
543 pcPPS->setTileIdxDeltaPresentFlag(uiCode == 1);
544 }
545 else
546 {
547 pcPPS->setTileIdxDeltaPresentFlag(0);
548 }
549 pcPPS->initRectSlices();
550
551 // read rectangular slice parameters
552 for( int i = 0; i < pcPPS->getNumSlicesInPic()-1; i++ )
553 {
554 pcPPS->setSliceTileIdx( i, tileIdx );
555
556 // complete tiles within a single slice
557 if( ( tileIdx % pcPPS->getNumTileColumns() ) != pcPPS->getNumTileColumns() - 1 )
558 {
559 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "pps_slice_width_in_tiles_minus1[i]" );
560 pcPPS->setSliceWidthInTiles ( i, uiCode + 1 );
561 }
562 else
563 {
564 pcPPS->setSliceWidthInTiles( i, 1 );
565 }
566
567 if( tileIdx / pcPPS->getNumTileColumns() != pcPPS->getNumTileRows() - 1 &&
568 ( pcPPS->getTileIdxDeltaPresentFlag() || tileIdx % pcPPS->getNumTileColumns() == 0 ) )
569 {
570 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "pps_slice_height_in_tiles_minus1[i]" );
571 pcPPS->setSliceHeightInTiles( i, uiCode + 1 );
572 }
573 else
574 {
575 if( ( tileIdx / pcPPS->getNumTileColumns() ) == pcPPS->getNumTileRows() - 1 )
576 {
577 pcPPS->setSliceHeightInTiles( i, 1 );
578 }
579 else
580 {
581 pcPPS->setSliceHeightInTiles( i, pcPPS->getSliceHeightInTiles( i - 1 ) );
582 }
583 }
584
585 // multiple slices within a single tile special case
586 if( pcPPS->getSliceWidthInTiles(i) == 1 && pcPPS->getSliceHeightInTiles(i) == 1 )
587 {
588 if( pcPPS->getTileRowHeight(tileIdx / pcPPS->getNumTileColumns()) > 1 )
589 {
590 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "pps_num_exp_slices_in_tile[i]");
591 if (uiCode == 0)
592 {
593 pcPPS->setNumSlicesInTile(i, 1);
594 pcPPS->setSliceHeightInCtu(i, pcPPS->getTileRowHeight(tileIdx / pcPPS->getNumTileColumns()));
595 }
596 else
597 {
598 uint32_t numExpSliceInTile = uiCode;
599 uint32_t remTileRowHeight = pcPPS->getTileRowHeight(tileIdx / pcPPS->getNumTileColumns());
600 int j = 0;
601
602 for( ; j < numExpSliceInTile; j++ )
603 {
604 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "pps_exp_slice_height_in_ctus_minus1[i]");
605 pcPPS->setSliceHeightInCtu(i + j, uiCode + 1);
606 remTileRowHeight -= (uiCode + 1);
607 }
608 uint32_t uniformSliceHeight = uiCode + 1;
609
610 while( remTileRowHeight >= uniformSliceHeight )
611 {
612 pcPPS->setSliceHeightInCtu(i + j, uniformSliceHeight);
613 remTileRowHeight -= uniformSliceHeight;
614 j++;
615 }
616 if( remTileRowHeight > 0 )
617 {
618 pcPPS->setSliceHeightInCtu(i + j, remTileRowHeight);
619 j++;
620 }
621 for( int k = 0; k < j; k++ )
622 {
623 pcPPS->setNumSlicesInTile(i + k, j);
624 pcPPS->setSliceWidthInTiles(i + k, 1);
625 pcPPS->setSliceHeightInTiles(i + k, 1);
626 pcPPS->setSliceTileIdx(i + k, tileIdx);
627 }
628 i += (j - 1);
629 }
630 }
631 else
632 {
633 pcPPS->setNumSlicesInTile(i, 1);
634 pcPPS->setSliceHeightInCtu(i, pcPPS->getTileRowHeight(tileIdx / pcPPS->getNumTileColumns()));
635 }
636 }
637
638 // tile index offset to start of next slice
639 if( i < pcPPS->getNumSlicesInPic()-1 )
640 {
641 if( pcPPS->getTileIdxDeltaPresentFlag() )
642 {
643 int32_t tileIdxDelta;
644 READ_SVLC( tileIdxDelta, "pps_tile_idx_delta[i]" );
645 tileIdx += tileIdxDelta;
646 CHECK( tileIdx < 0 || tileIdx >= pcPPS->getNumTiles(), "Invalid pps_tile_idx_delta.");
647 }
648 else
649 {
650 tileIdx += pcPPS->getSliceWidthInTiles( i );
651 if( tileIdx % pcPPS->getNumTileColumns() == 0)
652 {
653 tileIdx += (pcPPS->getSliceHeightInTiles( i ) - 1) * pcPPS->getNumTileColumns();
654 }
655 }
656 }
657 }
658 pcPPS->setSliceTileIdx(pcPPS->getNumSlicesInPic()-1, tileIdx );
659 }
660
661 if (pcPPS->getRectSliceFlag() == 0 || pcPPS->getSingleSlicePerSubPicFlag() || pcPPS->getNumSlicesInPic() > 1)
662 {
663 READ_CODE(1, uiCode, "pps_loop_filter_across_slices_enabled_flag"); pcPPS->setLoopFilterAcrossSlicesEnabledFlag( uiCode == 1 );
664 }
665 else
666 {
667 pcPPS->setLoopFilterAcrossSlicesEnabledFlag( false );
668 }
669 }
670 else
671 {
672 pcPPS->setSingleSlicePerSubPicFlag(1);
673 }
674
675 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_cabac_init_present_flag" ); pcPPS->setCabacInitPresentFlag( uiCode ? true : false );
676
677 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "pps_num_ref_idx_default_active_minus1[0]");
678 CHECK(uiCode > 14, "Invalid code read");
679 pcPPS->setNumRefIdxL0DefaultActive(uiCode+1);
680
681 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "pps_num_ref_idx_default_active_minus1[1]");
682 CHECK(uiCode > 14, "Invalid code read");
683 pcPPS->setNumRefIdxL1DefaultActive(uiCode+1);
684
685 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "pps_rpl1_idx_present_flag");
686 pcPPS->setRpl1IdxPresentFlag(uiCode);
687 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_weighted_pred_flag" ); // Use of Weighting Prediction (P_SLICE)
688 pcPPS->setUseWP( uiCode==1 );
689 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_weighted_bipred_flag" ); // Use of Bi-Directional Weighting Prediction (B_SLICE)
690 pcPPS->setWPBiPred( uiCode==1 );
691 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "pps_ref_wraparound_enabled_flag"); pcPPS->setWrapAroundEnabledFlag( uiCode ? true : false );
692 if (pcPPS->getWrapAroundEnabledFlag())
693 {
694 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "pps_ref_wraparound_offset");
695 pcPPS->setPicWidthMinusWrapAroundOffset(uiCode);
696 }
697 else
698 {
699 pcPPS->setPicWidthMinusWrapAroundOffset(0);
700 }
701
702 READ_SVLC(iCode, "pps_init_qp_minus26" ); pcPPS->setPicInitQPMinus26(iCode);
703 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_cu_qp_delta_enabled_flag" ); pcPPS->setUseDQP( uiCode ? true : false );
704 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "pps_chroma_tool_offsets_present_flag");
705 pcPPS->setPPSChromaToolFlag(uiCode ? true : false);
706 if (pcPPS->getPPSChromaToolFlag())
707 {
708 READ_SVLC( iCode, "pps_cb_qp_offset");
709 pcPPS->setQpOffset(COMPONENT_Cb, iCode);
710 CHECK( pcPPS->getQpOffset(COMPONENT_Cb) < -12, "Invalid Cb QP offset" );
711 CHECK( pcPPS->getQpOffset(COMPONENT_Cb) > 12, "Invalid Cb QP offset" );
712
713 READ_SVLC( iCode, "pps_cr_qp_offset");
714 pcPPS->setQpOffset(COMPONENT_Cr, iCode);
715 CHECK( pcPPS->getQpOffset(COMPONENT_Cr) < -12, "Invalid Cr QP offset" );
716 CHECK( pcPPS->getQpOffset(COMPONENT_Cr) > 12, "Invalid Cr QP offset" );
717
718 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "pps_joint_cbcr_qp_offset_present_flag");
719 pcPPS->setJointCbCrQpOffsetPresentFlag(uiCode ? true : false);
720
721 if (pcPPS->getJointCbCrQpOffsetPresentFlag())
722 {
723 READ_SVLC(iCode, "pps_joint_cbcr_qp_offset_value");
724 }
725 else
726 {
727 iCode = 0;
728 }
729 pcPPS->setQpOffset(JOINT_CbCr, iCode);
730
731 CHECK( pcPPS->getQpOffset(JOINT_CbCr) < -12, "Invalid CbCr QP offset" );
732 CHECK( pcPPS->getQpOffset(JOINT_CbCr) > 12, "Invalid CbCr QP offset" );
733
734 CHECK(MAX_NUM_COMPONENT>3, "Invalid maximal number of components");
735
736 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_slice_chroma_qp_offsets_present_flag" );
737 pcPPS->setSliceChromaQpFlag( uiCode ? true : false );
738
739 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_cu_chroma_qp_offset_list_enabled_flag");
740 if (uiCode == 0)
741 {
742 pcPPS->clearChromaQpOffsetList();
743 }
744 else
745 {
746 uint32_t tableSizeMinus1 = 0;
747 READ_UVLC(tableSizeMinus1, "pps_chroma_qp_offset_list_len_minus1");
748 CHECK(tableSizeMinus1 >= MAX_QP_OFFSET_LIST_SIZE, "Table size exceeds maximum");
749
750 for (int cuChromaQpOffsetIdx = 0; cuChromaQpOffsetIdx <= (tableSizeMinus1); cuChromaQpOffsetIdx++)
751 {
752 int cbOffset;
753 int crOffset;
754 int jointCbCrOffset;
755 READ_SVLC(cbOffset, "pps_cb_qp_offset_list[i]");
756 CHECK(cbOffset < -12 || cbOffset > 12, "Invalid chroma QP offset");
757 READ_SVLC(crOffset, "pps_cr_qp_offset_list[i]");
758 CHECK(crOffset < -12 || crOffset > 12, "Invalid chroma QP offset");
759 if (pcPPS->getJointCbCrQpOffsetPresentFlag())
760 {
761 READ_SVLC(jointCbCrOffset, "pps_joint_cbcr_qp_offset_list[i]");
762 }
763 else
764 {
765 jointCbCrOffset = 0;
766 }
767 CHECK(jointCbCrOffset < -12 || jointCbCrOffset > 12, "Invalid chroma QP offset");
768 // table uses +1 for index (see comment inside the function)
769 pcPPS->setChromaQpOffsetListEntry(cuChromaQpOffsetIdx + 1, cbOffset, crOffset, jointCbCrOffset);
770 }
771 CHECK(pcPPS->getChromaQpOffsetListLen() != tableSizeMinus1 + 1, "Invalid chroma QP offset list length");
772 }
773 }
774 else
775 {
776 pcPPS->setQpOffset(COMPONENT_Cb, 0);
777 pcPPS->setQpOffset(COMPONENT_Cr, 0);
778 pcPPS->setJointCbCrQpOffsetPresentFlag(0);
779 pcPPS->setSliceChromaQpFlag(0);
780 pcPPS->clearChromaQpOffsetList();
781 }
782 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_deblocking_filter_control_present_flag" ); pcPPS->setDeblockingFilterControlPresentFlag( uiCode ? true : false );
783 if(pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterControlPresentFlag())
784 {
785 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_deblocking_filter_override_enabled_flag" ); pcPPS->setDeblockingFilterOverrideEnabledFlag( uiCode ? true : false );
786 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_deblocking_filter_disabled_flag" ); pcPPS->setPPSDeblockingFilterDisabledFlag(uiCode ? true : false );
787 if (!pcPPS->getNoPicPartitionFlag() && pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterOverrideEnabledFlag())
788 {
789 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "pps_dbf_info_in_ph_flag");
790 pcPPS->setDbfInfoInPhFlag(uiCode ? true : false);
791 }
792 else
793 {
794 pcPPS->setDbfInfoInPhFlag(false);
795 }
796 if(!pcPPS->getPPSDeblockingFilterDisabledFlag())
797 {
798 READ_SVLC( iCode, "pps_beta_offset_div2" ); pcPPS->setDeblockingFilterBetaOffsetDiv2( iCode );
799 CHECK( pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterBetaOffsetDiv2() < -12 ||
800 pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterBetaOffsetDiv2() > 12, "Invalid deblocking filter configuration" );
801
802 READ_SVLC( iCode, "pps_tc_offset_div2"); pcPPS->setDeblockingFilterTcOffsetDiv2( iCode );
803 CHECK( pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterTcOffsetDiv2() < -12 ||
804 pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterTcOffsetDiv2() > 12, "Invalid deblocking filter configuration" );
805
806 if( pcPPS->getPPSChromaToolFlag() )
807 {
808 READ_SVLC( iCode, "pps_cb_beta_offset_div2" ); pcPPS->setDeblockingFilterCbBetaOffsetDiv2( iCode );
809 CHECK( pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterCbBetaOffsetDiv2() < -12 ||
810 pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterCbBetaOffsetDiv2() > 12, "Invalid deblocking filter configuration" );
811
812 READ_SVLC( iCode, "pps_cb_tc_offset_div2" ); pcPPS->setDeblockingFilterCbTcOffsetDiv2( iCode );
813 CHECK( pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterCbTcOffsetDiv2() < -12 ||
814 pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterCbTcOffsetDiv2() > 12, "Invalid deblocking filter configuration" );
815
816 READ_SVLC( iCode, "pps_cr_beta_offset_div2") ; pcPPS->setDeblockingFilterCrBetaOffsetDiv2( iCode );
817 CHECK( pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterCrBetaOffsetDiv2() < -12 ||
818 pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterCrBetaOffsetDiv2() > 12, "Invalid deblocking filter configuration" );
819
820 READ_SVLC( iCode, "pps_cr_tc_offset_div2" ); pcPPS->setDeblockingFilterCrTcOffsetDiv2( iCode );
821 CHECK(pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterCrTcOffsetDiv2() < -12 ||
822 pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterCrTcOffsetDiv2() > 12, "Invalid deblocking filter configuration");
823 }
824 else
825 {
826 pcPPS->setDeblockingFilterCbBetaOffsetDiv2 ( pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterBetaOffsetDiv2() );
827 pcPPS->setDeblockingFilterCbTcOffsetDiv2 ( pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterTcOffsetDiv2() );
828 pcPPS->setDeblockingFilterCrBetaOffsetDiv2 ( pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterBetaOffsetDiv2() );
829 pcPPS->setDeblockingFilterCrTcOffsetDiv2 ( pcPPS->getDeblockingFilterTcOffsetDiv2() );
830 }
831 }
832 }
833 else
834 {
835 pcPPS->setDeblockingFilterOverrideEnabledFlag(false);
836 pcPPS->setDbfInfoInPhFlag(false);
837 }
838
839 if (!pcPPS->getNoPicPartitionFlag())
840 {
841 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "pps_rpl_info_in_ph_flag"); pcPPS->setRplInfoInPhFlag(uiCode ? true : false);
842 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "pps_sao_info_in_ph_flag"); pcPPS->setSaoInfoInPhFlag(uiCode ? true : false);
843 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "pps_alf_info_in_ph_flag"); pcPPS->setAlfInfoInPhFlag(uiCode ? true : false);
844 if ((pcPPS->getUseWP() || pcPPS->getWPBiPred()) && pcPPS->getRplInfoInPhFlag())
845 {
846 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "pps_wp_info_in_ph_flag"); pcPPS->setWpInfoInPhFlag(uiCode ? true : false);
847 }
848 else
849 {
850 pcPPS->setWpInfoInPhFlag(false);
851 }
852 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "pps_qp_delta_info_in_ph_flag"); pcPPS->setQpDeltaInfoInPhFlag(uiCode ? true : false);
853 }
854 else
855 {
856 pcPPS->setRplInfoInPhFlag(false);
857 pcPPS->setSaoInfoInPhFlag(false);
858 pcPPS->setAlfInfoInPhFlag(false);
859 pcPPS->setWpInfoInPhFlag(false);
860 pcPPS->setQpDeltaInfoInPhFlag(false);
861 }
862
863 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_picture_header_extension_present_flag");
864 pcPPS->setPictureHeaderExtensionPresentFlag(uiCode);
865 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_slice_header_extension_present_flag");
866 pcPPS->setSliceHeaderExtensionPresentFlag(uiCode);
867
868 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_extension_flag");
869
870 if (uiCode)
871 {
872 while ( xMoreRbspData() )
873 {
874 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "pps_extension_data_flag");
875 }
876 }
877 xReadRbspTrailingBits();
878}
879
880void HLSyntaxReader::parseAPS( APS* aps )
881{
882#if ENABLE_TRACING
883 xTraceAPSHeader();
884#endif
885
886 uint32_t code;
887 READ_CODE(3, code, "aps_params_type");
888 aps->setAPSType(ApsType(code));
889
890 READ_CODE(5, code, "adaptation_parameter_set_id");
891 aps->setAPSId(code);
892 uint32_t codeApsChromaPresentFlag;
893 READ_FLAG(codeApsChromaPresentFlag, "aps_chroma_present_flag");
894 aps->chromaPresentFlag = codeApsChromaPresentFlag;
895
896 const ApsType apsType = aps->getAPSType();
897
898 if (apsType == ALF_APS)
899 {
900 parseAlfAps( aps );
901 }
902 else if (apsType == LMCS_APS)
903 {
904 parseLmcsAps( aps );
905 }
906 else if (apsType == SCALING_LIST_APS)
907 {
908 parseScalingListAps( aps );
909 }
910 READ_FLAG(code, "aps_extension_flag");
911 if (code)
912 {
913 while (xMoreRbspData())
914 {
915 READ_FLAG(code, "aps_extension_data_flag");
916 }
917 }
918 xReadRbspTrailingBits();
919}
920
921void HLSyntaxReader::parseAlfAps( APS* aps )
922{
923 uint32_t code;
924
925 AlfParam param = aps->getAlfAPSParam();
926 param.reset();
927 param.enabledFlag[COMPONENT_Y] = param.enabledFlag[COMPONENT_Cb] = param.enabledFlag[COMPONENT_Cr] = true;
928 READ_FLAG(code, "alf_luma_new_filter");
929 param.newFilterFlag[CHANNEL_TYPE_LUMA] = code;
930
931 if (aps->chromaPresentFlag)
932 {
933 READ_FLAG(code, "alf_chroma_new_filter");
934 param.newFilterFlag[CHANNEL_TYPE_CHROMA] = code;
935 }
936 else
937 {
938 param.newFilterFlag[CHANNEL_TYPE_CHROMA] = 0;
939 }
940
941 CcAlfFilterParam ccAlfParam = aps->getCcAlfAPSParam();
942 if (aps->chromaPresentFlag)
943 {
944 READ_FLAG(code, "alf_cc_cb_filter_signal_flag");
945 ccAlfParam.newCcAlfFilter[COMPONENT_Cb - 1] = code;
946 }
947 else
948 {
949 ccAlfParam.newCcAlfFilter[COMPONENT_Cb - 1] = 0;
950 }
951 if (aps->chromaPresentFlag)
952 {
953 READ_FLAG(code, "alf_cc_cr_filter_signal_flag");
954 ccAlfParam.newCcAlfFilter[COMPONENT_Cr - 1] = code;
955 }
956 else
957 {
958 ccAlfParam.newCcAlfFilter[COMPONENT_Cr - 1] = 0;
959 }
960 CHECK(param.newFilterFlag[CHANNEL_TYPE_LUMA] == 0 && param.newFilterFlag[CHANNEL_TYPE_CHROMA] == 0
961 && ccAlfParam.newCcAlfFilter[COMPONENT_Cb - 1] == 0 && ccAlfParam.newCcAlfFilter[COMPONENT_Cr - 1] == 0,
962 "bitstream conformance error: one of alf_luma_filter_signal_flag, alf_chroma_filter_signal_flag, "
963 "alf_cross_component_cb_filter_signal_flag, and alf_cross_component_cr_filter_signal_flag shall be nonzero");
964
965 if (param.newFilterFlag[CHANNEL_TYPE_LUMA])
966 {
967 READ_FLAG(code, "alf_luma_clip");
968 param.nonLinearFlag[CHANNEL_TYPE_LUMA] = code ? true : false;
969 READ_UVLC(code, "alf_luma_num_filters_signalled_minus1");
970 param.numLumaFilters = code + 1;
971 if (param.numLumaFilters > 1)
972 {
973 const int length = ceilLog2(param.numLumaFilters);
974 for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NUM_ALF_CLASSES; i++)
975 {
976 READ_CODE(length, code, "alf_luma_coeff_delta_idx");
977 param.filterCoeffDeltaIdx[i] = code;
978 }
979 }
980 else
981 {
982 memset(param.filterCoeffDeltaIdx, 0, sizeof(param.filterCoeffDeltaIdx));
983 }
984 alfFilter( param, false, 0 );
985 }
986 if (param.newFilterFlag[CHANNEL_TYPE_CHROMA])
987 {
988 READ_FLAG(code, "alf_nonlinear_enable_flag_chroma");
989 param.nonLinearFlag[CHANNEL_TYPE_CHROMA] = code ? true : false;
990
991 if( MAX_NUM_ALF_ALTERNATIVES_CHROMA > 1 )
992 READ_UVLC( code, "alf_chroma_num_alts_minus1" );
993 else
994 code = 0;
995
996 param.numAlternativesChroma = code + 1;
997
998 for( int altIdx=0; altIdx < param.numAlternativesChroma; ++altIdx )
999 {
1000 alfFilter( param, true, altIdx );
1001 }
1002 }
1003
1004 for (int ccIdx = 0; ccIdx < 2; ccIdx++)
1005 {
1006 if (ccAlfParam.newCcAlfFilter[ccIdx])
1007 {
1008 if (MAX_NUM_CC_ALF_FILTERS > 1)
1009 {
1010 READ_UVLC(code, ccIdx == 0 ? "alf_cc_cb_filters_signalled_minus1" : "alf_cc_cr_filters_signalled_minus1");
1011 }
1012 else
1013 {
1014 code = 0;
1015 }
1016 ccAlfParam.ccAlfFilterCount[ccIdx] = code + 1;
1017
1018 for (int filterIdx = 0; filterIdx < ccAlfParam.ccAlfFilterCount[ccIdx]; filterIdx++)
1019 {
1020 ccAlfParam.ccAlfFilterIdxEnabled[ccIdx][filterIdx] = true;
1021 AlfFilterShape alfShape(size_CC_ALF);
1022
1023 short *coeff = ccAlfParam.ccAlfCoeff[ccIdx][filterIdx];
1024 // Filter coefficients
1025 for (int i = 0; i < alfShape.numCoeff - 1; i++)
1026 {
1027 READ_CODE(CCALF_BITS_PER_COEFF_LEVEL, code,
1028 ccIdx == 0 ? "alf_cc_cb_mapped_coeff_abs" : "alf_cc_cr_mapped_coeff_abs");
1029 if (code == 0)
1030 {
1031 coeff[i] = 0;
1032 }
1033 else
1034 {
1035 coeff[i] = 1 << (code - 1);
1036 READ_FLAG(code, ccIdx == 0 ? "alf_cc_cb_coeff_sign" : "alf_cc_cr_coeff_sign");
1037 coeff[i] *= 1 - 2 * code;
1038 }
1039 }
1040
1041 DTRACE(g_trace_ctx, D_SYNTAX, "%s coeff filterIdx %d: ", ccIdx == 0 ? "Cb" : "Cr", filterIdx);
1042 for (int i = 0; i < alfShape.numCoeff; i++)
1043 {
1044 DTRACE(g_trace_ctx, D_SYNTAX, "%d ", coeff[i]);
1045 }
1046 DTRACE(g_trace_ctx, D_SYNTAX, "\n");
1047 }
1048
1049 for (int filterIdx = ccAlfParam.ccAlfFilterCount[ccIdx]; filterIdx < MAX_NUM_CC_ALF_FILTERS; filterIdx++)
1050 {
1051 ccAlfParam.ccAlfFilterIdxEnabled[ccIdx][filterIdx] = false;
1052 }
1053 }
1054 }
1055 aps->setCcAlfAPSParam(ccAlfParam);
1056
1057 aps->setAlfAPSParam(param);
1058}
1059
1060void HLSyntaxReader::parseLmcsAps( APS* aps )
1061{
1062 uint32_t code;
1063
1064 SliceReshapeInfo& info = aps->getReshaperAPSInfo();
1065 memset(info.reshaperModelBinCWDelta, 0, PIC_CODE_CW_BINS * sizeof(int));
1066 READ_UVLC(code, "lmcs_min_bin_idx"); info.reshaperModelMinBinIdx = code;
1067 READ_UVLC(code, "lmcs_delta_max_bin_idx"); info.reshaperModelMaxBinIdx = PIC_CODE_CW_BINS - 1 - code;
1068 READ_UVLC(code, "lmcs_delta_cw_prec_minus1"); info.maxNbitsNeededDeltaCW = code + 1;
1069 assert(info.maxNbitsNeededDeltaCW > 0);
1070 for (uint32_t i = info.reshaperModelMinBinIdx; i <= info.reshaperModelMaxBinIdx; i++)
1071 {
1072 READ_CODE(info.maxNbitsNeededDeltaCW, code, "lmcs_delta_abs_cw[ i ]");
1073 int absCW = code;
1074 if (absCW > 0)
1075 {
1076 READ_CODE(1, code, "lmcs_delta_sign_cw_flag[ i ]");
1077 }
1078 int signCW = code;
1079 info.reshaperModelBinCWDelta[i] = (1 - 2 * signCW) * absCW;
1080 }
1081 if (aps->chromaPresentFlag)
1082 {
1083 READ_CODE(3, code, "lmcs_delta_abs_crs");
1084 }
1085 int absCW = aps->chromaPresentFlag ? code : 0;
1086 if (absCW > 0)
1087 {
1088 READ_CODE(1, code, "lmcs_delta_sign_crs_flag");
1089 }
1090 int signCW = code;
1091 info.chrResScalingOffset = (1 - 2 * signCW) * absCW;
1092
1093 aps->setReshaperAPSInfo(info);
1094}
1095
1096void HLSyntaxReader::parseScalingListAps( APS* aps )
1097{
1098 ScalingList& info = aps->getScalingList();
1099 parseScalingList(&info, aps->chromaPresentFlag);
1100}
1101
1102void HLSyntaxReader::parseVUI(VUI* pcVUI, SPS *pcSPS)
1103{
1104#if ENABLE_TRACING
1105 DTRACE( g_trace_ctx, D_HEADER, "----------- vui_parameters -----------\n");
1106#endif
1107 unsigned vuiPayloadSize = pcSPS->getVuiPayloadSize();
1108 InputBitstream *bs = getBitstream();
1109 setBitstream(bs->extractSubstream(vuiPayloadSize * 8));
1110
1111 uint32_t symbol;
1112
1113 READ_FLAG(symbol, "vui_progressive_source_flag" ); pcVUI->setProgressiveSourceFlag(symbol ? true : false);
1114 READ_FLAG(symbol, "vui_interlaced_source_flag" ); pcVUI->setInterlacedSourceFlag(symbol ? true : false);
1115 READ_FLAG(symbol, "vui_non_packed_constraint_flag"); pcVUI->setNonPackedFlag(symbol ? true : false);
1116 READ_FLAG(symbol, "vui_non_projected_constraint_flag"); pcVUI->setNonProjectedFlag(symbol ? true : false);
1117 READ_FLAG( symbol, "vui_aspect_ratio_info_present_flag"); pcVUI->setAspectRatioInfoPresentFlag(symbol);
1118 if (pcVUI->getAspectRatioInfoPresentFlag())
1119 {
1120 READ_FLAG( symbol, "vui_aspect_ratio_constant_flag"); pcVUI->setAspectRatioConstantFlag(symbol);
1121 READ_CODE(8, symbol, "vui_aspect_ratio_idc"); pcVUI->setAspectRatioIdc(symbol);
1122 if (pcVUI->getAspectRatioIdc() == 255)
1123 {
1124 READ_CODE(16, symbol, "vui_sar_width"); pcVUI->setSarWidth(symbol);
1125 READ_CODE(16, symbol, "vui_sar_height"); pcVUI->setSarHeight(symbol);
1126 }
1127 }
1128
1129 READ_FLAG( symbol, "vui_overscan_info_present_flag"); pcVUI->setOverscanInfoPresentFlag(symbol);
1130 if (pcVUI->getOverscanInfoPresentFlag())
1131 {
1132 READ_FLAG( symbol, "vui_overscan_appropriate_flag"); pcVUI->setOverscanAppropriateFlag(symbol);
1133 }
1134
1135 READ_FLAG( symbol, "vui_colour_description_present_flag"); pcVUI->setColourDescriptionPresentFlag(symbol);
1136 if (pcVUI->getColourDescriptionPresentFlag())
1137 {
1138 READ_CODE(8, symbol, "vui_colour_primaries"); pcVUI->setColourPrimaries(symbol);
1139 READ_CODE(8, symbol, "vui_transfer_characteristics"); pcVUI->setTransferCharacteristics(symbol);
1140 READ_CODE(8, symbol, "vui_matrix_coeffs"); pcVUI->setMatrixCoefficients(symbol);
1141 READ_FLAG( symbol, "vui_full_range_flag"); pcVUI->setVideoFullRangeFlag(symbol);
1142 }
1143
1144 READ_FLAG( symbol, "vui_chroma_loc_info_present_flag"); pcVUI->setChromaLocInfoPresentFlag(symbol);
1145 if (pcVUI->getChromaLocInfoPresentFlag())
1146 {
1147 if(pcVUI->getProgressiveSourceFlag() && !pcVUI->getInterlacedSourceFlag())
1148 {
1149 READ_UVLC( symbol, "vui_chroma_sample_loc_type" ); pcVUI->setChromaSampleLocType(symbol);
1150 }
1151 else
1152 {
1153 READ_UVLC( symbol, "vui_chroma_sample_loc_type_top_field" ); pcVUI->setChromaSampleLocTypeTopField(symbol);
1154 READ_UVLC( symbol, "vui_chroma_sample_loc_type_bottom_field" ); pcVUI->setChromaSampleLocTypeBottomField(symbol);
1155 }
1156 }
1157
1158 int payloadBitsRem = getBitstream()->getNumBitsLeft();
1159 if(payloadBitsRem) //Corresponds to more_data_in_payload()
1160 {
1161 while(payloadBitsRem > 9) //payload_extension_present()
1162 {
1163 READ_CODE(1, symbol, "vui_reserved_payload_extension_data");
1164 payloadBitsRem--;
1165 }
1166 int finalBits = getBitstream()->peekBits(payloadBitsRem);
1167 int numFinalZeroBits = 0;
1168 int mask = 0xff;
1169 while(finalBits & (mask >> numFinalZeroBits))
1170 {
1171 numFinalZeroBits++;
1172 }
1173 while(payloadBitsRem > 9-numFinalZeroBits) //payload_extension_present()
1174 {
1175 READ_CODE(1, symbol, "vui_reserved_payload_extension_data");
1176 payloadBitsRem--;
1177 }
1178 READ_FLAG(symbol, "vui_payload_bit_equal_to_one");
1179 CHECK(symbol != 1, "vui_payload_bit_equal_to_one not equal to 1");
1180 payloadBitsRem--;
1181 while(payloadBitsRem)
1182 {
1183 READ_FLAG(symbol, "vui_payload_bit_equal_to_zero");
1184 CHECK(symbol != 0, "vui_payload_bit_equal_to_zero not equal to 0");
1185 payloadBitsRem--;
1186 }
1187 }
1188 delete getBitstream();
1189 setBitstream(bs);
1190}
1191
1192void HLSyntaxReader::parseGeneralHrdParameters(GeneralHrdParams *hrd)
1193{
1194 uint32_t symbol;
1195 READ_CODE(32, symbol, "num_units_in_tick"); hrd->setNumUnitsInTick(symbol);
1196 READ_CODE(32, symbol, "time_scale"); hrd->setTimeScale(symbol);
1197 READ_FLAG(symbol, "general_nal_hrd_parameters_present_flag"); hrd->setGeneralNalHrdParametersPresentFlag(symbol == 1 ? true : false);
1198 READ_FLAG(symbol, "general_vcl_hrd_parameters_present_flag"); hrd->setGeneralVclHrdParametersPresentFlag(symbol == 1 ? true : false);
1199#if JVET_S0175_ASPECT6
1200 if( hrd->getGeneralNalHrdParametersPresentFlag() || hrd->getGeneralVclHrdParametersPresentFlag() )
1201 {
1202#else
1203 CHECK((hrd->getGeneralNalHrdParametersPresentFlag() == 0) && (hrd->getGeneralVclHrdParametersPresentFlag() == 0), "general_nal_hrd_params_present_flag and general_vcl_hrd_params_present_flag in each general_hrd_parameters( ) syntax structure shall not be both equal to 0.");
1204#endif
1205 READ_FLAG(symbol, "general_same_pic_timing_in_all_ols_flag"); hrd->setGeneralSamePicTimingInAllOlsFlag(symbol == 1 ? true : false);
1206 READ_FLAG(symbol, "general_decoding_unit_hrd_params_present_flag"); hrd->setGeneralDecodingUnitHrdParamsPresentFlag(symbol == 1 ? true : false);
1207 if (hrd->getGeneralDecodingUnitHrdParamsPresentFlag())
1208 {
1209 READ_CODE(8, symbol, "tick_divisor_minus2"); hrd->setTickDivisorMinus2(symbol);
1210 }
1211 READ_CODE(4, symbol, "bit_rate_scale"); hrd->setBitRateScale(symbol);
1212 READ_CODE(4, symbol, "cpb_size_scale"); hrd->setCpbSizeScale(symbol);
1213 if (hrd->getGeneralDecodingUnitHrdParamsPresentFlag())
1214 {
1215 READ_CODE(4, symbol, "cpb_size_du_scale"); hrd->setCpbSizeDuScale(symbol);
1216 }
1217 READ_UVLC(symbol, "hrd_cpb_cnt_minus1"); hrd->setHrdCpbCntMinus1(symbol);
1218 CHECK(symbol > 31,"The value of hrd_cpb_cnt_minus1 shall be in the range of 0 to 31, inclusive");
1219#if JVET_S0175_ASPECT6
1220 }
1221#endif
1222}
1223void HLSyntaxReader::parseOlsHrdParameters(GeneralHrdParams * generalHrd, OlsHrdParams *olsHrd, uint32_t firstSubLayer, uint32_t maxNumSubLayersMinus1)
1224{
1225 uint32_t symbol;
1226
1227 for( int i = firstSubLayer; i <= maxNumSubLayersMinus1; i ++ )
1228 {
1229 OlsHrdParams *hrd = &(olsHrd[i]);
1230 READ_FLAG(symbol, "fixed_pic_rate_general_flag"); hrd->setFixedPicRateGeneralFlag(symbol == 1 ? true : false);
1231 if (!hrd->getFixedPicRateGeneralFlag())
1232 {
1233 READ_FLAG(symbol, "fixed_pic_rate_within_cvs_flag"); hrd->setFixedPicRateWithinCvsFlag(symbol == 1 ? true : false);
1234 }
1235 else
1236 {
1237 hrd->setFixedPicRateWithinCvsFlag(true);
1238 }
1239
1240 hrd->setLowDelayHrdFlag(false); // Inferred to be 0 when not present
1241
1242 if (hrd->getFixedPicRateWithinCvsFlag())
1243 {
1244 READ_UVLC(symbol, "elemental_duration_in_tc_minus1"); hrd->setElementDurationInTcMinus1(symbol);
1245 }
1246#if JVET_S0175_ASPECT6
1247 else if((generalHrd->getGeneralNalHrdParametersPresentFlag() || generalHrd->getGeneralVclHrdParametersPresentFlag()) && generalHrd->getHrdCpbCntMinus1() == 0)
1248#else
1249 else if(generalHrd->getHrdCpbCntMinus1() == 0)
1250#endif
1251 {
1252 READ_FLAG(symbol, "low_delay_hrd_flag"); hrd->setLowDelayHrdFlag(symbol == 1 ? true : false);
1253 }
1254
1255 for( int nalOrVcl = 0; nalOrVcl < 2; nalOrVcl ++ )
1256 {
1257 if (((nalOrVcl == 0) && (generalHrd->getGeneralNalHrdParametersPresentFlag())) || ((nalOrVcl == 1) && (generalHrd->getGeneralVclHrdParametersPresentFlag())))
1258 {
1259 for (int j = 0; j <= (generalHrd->getHrdCpbCntMinus1()); j++)
1260 {
1261 READ_UVLC(symbol, "bit_rate_value_minus1"); hrd->setBitRateValueMinus1(j, nalOrVcl, symbol);
1262 READ_UVLC(symbol, "cpb_size_value_minus1"); hrd->setCpbSizeValueMinus1(j, nalOrVcl, symbol);
1263 if (generalHrd->getGeneralDecodingUnitHrdParamsPresentFlag())
1264 {
1265 READ_UVLC(symbol, "cpb_size_du_value_minus1"); hrd->setDuCpbSizeValueMinus1(j, nalOrVcl, symbol);
1266 READ_UVLC(symbol, "bit_rate_du_value_minus1"); hrd->setDuBitRateValueMinus1(j, nalOrVcl, symbol);
1267 }
1268 READ_FLAG(symbol, "cbr_flag"); hrd->setCbrFlag(j, nalOrVcl, symbol == 1 ? true : false);
1269 }
1270 }
1271 }
1272 }
1273 for (int i = 0; i < firstSubLayer; i++)
1274 {
1275 OlsHrdParams* hrdHighestTLayer = &(olsHrd[maxNumSubLayersMinus1]);
1276 OlsHrdParams* hrdTemp = &(olsHrd[i]);
1277 bool tempFlag = hrdHighestTLayer->getFixedPicRateGeneralFlag();
1278 hrdTemp->setFixedPicRateGeneralFlag(tempFlag);
1279 tempFlag = hrdHighestTLayer->getFixedPicRateWithinCvsFlag();
1280 hrdTemp->setFixedPicRateWithinCvsFlag(tempFlag);
1281 uint32_t tempElementDurationInTcMinus1 = hrdHighestTLayer->getElementDurationInTcMinus1();
1282 hrdTemp->setElementDurationInTcMinus1(tempElementDurationInTcMinus1);
1283 for (int nalOrVcl = 0; nalOrVcl < 2; nalOrVcl++)
1284 {
1285 if (((nalOrVcl == 0) && (generalHrd->getGeneralNalHrdParametersPresentFlag())) || ((nalOrVcl == 1) && (generalHrd->getGeneralVclHrdParametersPresentFlag())))
1286 {
1287 for (int j = 0; j <= (generalHrd->getHrdCpbCntMinus1()); j++)
1288 {
1289 uint32_t bitRate = hrdHighestTLayer->getBitRateValueMinus1(j, nalOrVcl);
1290 hrdTemp->setBitRateValueMinus1(j, nalOrVcl, bitRate);
1291 uint32_t cpbSize = hrdHighestTLayer->getCpbSizeValueMinus1(j, nalOrVcl);
1292 hrdTemp->setCpbSizeValueMinus1(j, nalOrVcl, cpbSize);
1293 if (generalHrd->getGeneralDecodingUnitHrdParamsPresentFlag())
1294 {
1295 uint32_t bitRateDu = hrdHighestTLayer->getDuBitRateValueMinus1(j, nalOrVcl);
1296 hrdTemp->setDuBitRateValueMinus1(j, nalOrVcl, bitRateDu);
1297 uint32_t cpbSizeDu = hrdHighestTLayer->getDuCpbSizeValueMinus1(j, nalOrVcl);
1298 hrdTemp->setDuCpbSizeValueMinus1(j, nalOrVcl, cpbSizeDu);
1299 }
1300 bool flag = hrdHighestTLayer->getCbrFlag(j, nalOrVcl);
1301 hrdTemp->setCbrFlag(j, nalOrVcl, flag);
1302 }
1303 }
1304 }
1305 }
1306}
1307
1308void HLSyntaxReader::dpb_parameters(int maxSubLayersMinus1, bool subLayerInfoFlag, SPS *pcSPS)
1309{
1310 uint32_t code;
1311 for (int i = (subLayerInfoFlag ? 0 : maxSubLayersMinus1); i <= maxSubLayersMinus1; i++)
1312 {
1313 READ_UVLC(code, "dpb_max_dec_pic_buffering_minus1[i]");
1314 pcSPS->setMaxDecPicBuffering(code + 1, i);
1315 READ_UVLC(code, "dpb_max_num_reorder_pics[i]");
1316 pcSPS->setMaxNumReorderPics(code, i);
1317 CHECK( pcSPS->getMaxNumReorderPics(i) >= pcSPS->getMaxDecPicBuffering(i), "The value of dpb_max_num_reorder_pics[ i ] shall be in the range of 0 to dpb_max_dec_pic_buffering_minus1[ i ], inclusive" );
1318 READ_UVLC(code, "dpb_max_latency_increase_plus1[i]");
1319 pcSPS->setMaxLatencyIncreasePlus1(code, i);
1320 }
1321}
1322
1323
1324void HLSyntaxReader::parseSPS(SPS* pcSPS)
1325{
1326 uint32_t uiCode;
1327
1328#if ENABLE_TRACING
1329 xTraceSPSHeader ();
1330#endif
1331
1332 READ_CODE(4, uiCode, "sps_seq_parameter_set_id"); pcSPS->setSPSId(uiCode);
1333 READ_CODE( 4, uiCode, "sps_video_parameter_set_id" ); pcSPS->setVPSId( uiCode );
1334 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "sps_max_sub_layers_minus1"); pcSPS->setMaxTLayers (uiCode + 1);
1335 CHECK(uiCode > 6, "Invalid maximum number of T-layer signalled");
1336 READ_CODE(2, uiCode, "sps_chroma_format_idc");
1337 pcSPS->setChromaFormatIdc(ChromaFormat(uiCode));
1338
1339 READ_CODE(2, uiCode, "sps_log2_ctu_size_minus5");
1340 pcSPS->setCTUSize(1 << (uiCode + 5));
1341 CHECK(uiCode > 2, "sps_log2_ctu_size_minus5 must be less than or equal to 2");
1342 unsigned ctbLog2SizeY = uiCode + 5;
1343 pcSPS->setMaxCUWidth(pcSPS->getCTUSize());
1344 pcSPS->setMaxCUHeight(pcSPS->getCTUSize());
1345 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_ptl_dpb_hrd_params_present_flag"); pcSPS->setPtlDpbHrdParamsPresentFlag(uiCode);
1346
1347 if( !pcSPS->getVPSId() )
1348 {
1349 CHECK( !pcSPS->getPtlDpbHrdParamsPresentFlag(), "When sps_video_parameter_set_id is equal to 0, the value of sps_ptl_dpb_hrd_params_present_flag shall be equal to 1" );
1350 }
1351
1352 if (pcSPS->getPtlDpbHrdParamsPresentFlag())
1353 {
1354
1355 parseProfileTierLevel(pcSPS->getProfileTierLevel(), true, pcSPS->getMaxTLayers() - 1);
1356
1357 }
1358
1359 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_gdr_enabled_flag");
1360 pcSPS->setGDREnabledFlag(uiCode);
1361
1362#if JVET_R0266_GCI
1363 if (pcSPS->getProfileTierLevel()->getConstraintInfo()->getNoGdrConstraintFlag())
1364 {
1365 CHECK(uiCode != 0, "When gci_no_gdr_constraint_flag equal to 1 , the value of sps_gdr_enabled_flag shall be equal to 0");
1366 }
1367#endif
1368
1369 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_ref_pic_resampling_enabled_flag"); pcSPS->setRprEnabledFlag(uiCode);
1370 if (pcSPS->getProfileTierLevel()->getConstraintInfo()->getNoRprConstraintFlag())
1371 {
1372 CHECK(uiCode != 0, "When gci_no_ref_pic_resampling_constraint_flag is equal to 1, sps_ref_pic_resampling_enabled_flag shall be equal to 0");
1373 }
1374 if (uiCode)
1375 {
1376 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_res_change_in_clvs_allowed_flag"); pcSPS->setResChangeInClvsEnabledFlag(uiCode);
1377 }
1378 else
1379 {
1380 pcSPS->setResChangeInClvsEnabledFlag(0);
1381 }
1382
1383 if (pcSPS->getProfileTierLevel()->getConstraintInfo()->getNoResChangeInClvsConstraintFlag())
1384 {
1385 CHECK(uiCode != 0, "When no_res_change_in_clvs_constraint_flag is equal to 1, sps_res_change_in_clvs_allowed_flag shall be equal to 0");
1386 }
1387
1388 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "sps_pic_width_max_in_luma_samples" ); pcSPS->setMaxPicWidthInLumaSamples( uiCode );
1389 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "sps_pic_height_max_in_luma_samples" ); pcSPS->setMaxPicHeightInLumaSamples( uiCode );
1390 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "sps_conformance_window_flag");
1391 if (uiCode != 0)
1392 {
1393 Window& conf = pcSPS->getConformanceWindow();
1394 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "sps_conf_win_left_offset"); conf.setWindowLeftOffset(uiCode);
1395 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "sps_conf_win_right_offset"); conf.setWindowRightOffset(uiCode);
1396 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "sps_conf_win_top_offset"); conf.setWindowTopOffset(uiCode);
1397 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "sps_conf_win_bottom_offset"); conf.setWindowBottomOffset(uiCode);
1398 }
1399
1400
1401 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "sps_subpic_info_present_flag" ); pcSPS->setSubPicInfoPresentFlag(uiCode);
1402 if (pcSPS->getProfileTierLevel()->getConstraintInfo()->getNoSubpicInfoConstraintFlag())
1403 {
1404 CHECK(uiCode != 0, "When gci_no_subpic_info_constraint_flag is equal to 1, the value of sps_subpic_info_present_flag shall be equal to 0");
1405 }
1406
1407 if (pcSPS->getSubPicInfoPresentFlag())
1408 {
1409 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "sps_num_subpics_minus1"); pcSPS->setNumSubPics(uiCode + 1);
1410 CHECK(uiCode > (pcSPS->getMaxPicWidthInLumaSamples() / (1 << pcSPS->getCTUSize())) * (pcSPS->getMaxPicHeightInLumaSamples() / (1 << pcSPS->getCTUSize())) - 1, "Invalid sps_num_subpics_minus1 value");
1411 if( pcSPS->getNumSubPics() == 1 )
1412 {
1413 pcSPS->setSubPicCtuTopLeftX( 0, 0 );
1414 pcSPS->setSubPicCtuTopLeftY( 0, 0 );
1415 pcSPS->setSubPicWidth( 0, ( pcSPS->getMaxPicWidthInLumaSamples() + pcSPS->getCTUSize() - 1 ) >> floorLog2( pcSPS->getCTUSize() ) );
1416 pcSPS->setSubPicHeight( 0, ( pcSPS->getMaxPicHeightInLumaSamples() + pcSPS->getCTUSize() - 1 ) >> floorLog2( pcSPS->getCTUSize() ) );
1417
1418 pcSPS->setIndependentSubPicsFlag(1);
1419 pcSPS->setSubPicSameSizeFlag(0);
1420
1421 pcSPS->setSubPicTreatedAsPicFlag(0, 1);
1422 pcSPS->setLoopFilterAcrossSubpicEnabledFlag(0, 0);
1423 }
1424 else
1425 {
1426 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_independent_subpics_flag"); pcSPS->setIndependentSubPicsFlag(uiCode != 0);
1427 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_subpic_same_size_flag"); pcSPS->setSubPicSameSizeFlag(uiCode);
1428 uint32_t tmpWidthVal = (pcSPS->getMaxPicWidthInLumaSamples() + pcSPS->getCTUSize() - 1) / pcSPS->getCTUSize();
1429 uint32_t tmpHeightVal = (pcSPS->getMaxPicHeightInLumaSamples() + pcSPS->getCTUSize() - 1) / pcSPS->getCTUSize();
1430 uint32_t numSubpicCols = 1;
1431 for (int picIdx = 0; picIdx < pcSPS->getNumSubPics(); picIdx++)
1432 {
1433 if (!pcSPS->getSubPicSameSizeFlag() || picIdx == 0)
1434 {
1435 if ((picIdx > 0) && (pcSPS->getMaxPicWidthInLumaSamples() > pcSPS->getCTUSize()))
1436 {
1437 READ_CODE(ceilLog2(tmpWidthVal), uiCode, "sps_subpic_ctu_top_left_x[ i ]");
1438 pcSPS->setSubPicCtuTopLeftX(picIdx, uiCode);
1439 }
1440 else
1441 {
1442 pcSPS->setSubPicCtuTopLeftX(picIdx, 0);
1443 }
1444 if ((picIdx > 0) && (pcSPS->getMaxPicHeightInLumaSamples() > pcSPS->getCTUSize()))
1445 {
1446 READ_CODE(ceilLog2(tmpHeightVal), uiCode, "sps_subpic_ctu_top_left_y[ i ]");
1447 pcSPS->setSubPicCtuTopLeftY(picIdx, uiCode);
1448 }
1449 else
1450 {
1451 pcSPS->setSubPicCtuTopLeftY(picIdx, 0);
1452 }
1453 if (picIdx <pcSPS->getNumSubPics() - 1 && pcSPS->getMaxPicWidthInLumaSamples() > pcSPS->getCTUSize())
1454 {
1455 READ_CODE(ceilLog2(tmpWidthVal), uiCode, "sps_subpic_width_minus1[ i ]");
1456 pcSPS->setSubPicWidth(picIdx, uiCode + 1);
1457 }
1458 else
1459 {
1460 pcSPS->setSubPicWidth(picIdx, tmpWidthVal - pcSPS->getSubPicCtuTopLeftX(picIdx));
1461 }
1462 if (picIdx <pcSPS->getNumSubPics() - 1 && pcSPS->getMaxPicHeightInLumaSamples() > pcSPS->getCTUSize())
1463 {
1464 READ_CODE(ceilLog2(tmpHeightVal), uiCode, "sps_subpic_height_minus1[ i ]");
1465 pcSPS->setSubPicHeight(picIdx, uiCode + 1);
1466 }
1467 else
1468 {
1469 pcSPS->setSubPicHeight(picIdx, tmpHeightVal - pcSPS->getSubPicCtuTopLeftY(picIdx));
1470 }
1471 if (pcSPS->getSubPicSameSizeFlag())
1472 {
1473 numSubpicCols = tmpWidthVal / pcSPS->getSubPicWidth(0);
1474 CHECK(!(tmpWidthVal % pcSPS->getSubPicWidth(0) == 0), "sps_subpic_width_minus1[0] is invalid.");
1475 CHECK(!(tmpHeightVal % pcSPS->getSubPicHeight(0) == 0), "sps_subpic_height_minus1[0] is invalid.");
1476 CHECK(!(numSubpicCols * (tmpHeightVal / pcSPS->getSubPicHeight(0)) == pcSPS->getNumSubPics()), "when sps_subpic_same_size_flag is equal to, sps_num_subpics_minus1 is invalid");
1477 }
1478 }
1479 else
1480 {
1481 pcSPS->setSubPicCtuTopLeftX(picIdx, (picIdx % numSubpicCols) * pcSPS->getSubPicWidth(0));
1482 pcSPS->setSubPicCtuTopLeftY(picIdx, (picIdx / numSubpicCols) * pcSPS->getSubPicHeight(0));
1483 pcSPS->setSubPicWidth(picIdx, pcSPS->getSubPicWidth(0));
1484 pcSPS->setSubPicHeight(picIdx, pcSPS->getSubPicHeight(0));
1485 }
1486 if (!pcSPS->getIndependentSubPicsFlag())
1487 {
1488 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_subpic_treated_as_pic_flag[ i ]");
1489 pcSPS->setSubPicTreatedAsPicFlag(picIdx, uiCode);
1490 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_loop_filter_across_subpic_enabled_flag[ i ]");
1491 pcSPS->setLoopFilterAcrossSubpicEnabledFlag(picIdx, uiCode);
1492 }
1493 else
1494 {
1495 pcSPS->setSubPicTreatedAsPicFlag(picIdx, 1);
1496 pcSPS->setLoopFilterAcrossSubpicEnabledFlag(picIdx, 0);
1497 }
1498 }
1499 }
1500
1501 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "sps_subpic_id_len_minus1" ); pcSPS->setSubPicIdLen( uiCode + 1 );
1502 CHECK( uiCode > 15, "Invalid sps_subpic_id_len_minus1 value" );
1503 CHECK( (1 << (uiCode + 1)) < pcSPS->getNumSubPics(), "Invalid sps_subpic_id_len_minus1 value" );
1504 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "sps_subpic_id_mapping_explicitly_signalled_flag" ); pcSPS->setSubPicIdMappingExplicitlySignalledFlag( uiCode != 0 );
1505 if (pcSPS->getSubPicIdMappingExplicitlySignalledFlag())
1506 {
1507 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "sps_subpic_id_mapping_present_flag" ); pcSPS->setSubPicIdMappingPresentFlag( uiCode != 0 );
1508 if (pcSPS->getSubPicIdMappingPresentFlag())
1509 {
1510 for (int picIdx = 0; picIdx < pcSPS->getNumSubPics(); picIdx++)
1511 {
1512 READ_CODE(pcSPS->getSubPicIdLen(), uiCode, "sps_subpic_id[i]"); pcSPS->setSubPicId(picIdx, uiCode);
1513 }
1514 }
1515 }
1516 }
1517 else
1518 {
1519 pcSPS->setSubPicIdMappingExplicitlySignalledFlag(0);
1520 pcSPS->setNumSubPics(1);
1521 pcSPS->setSubPicCtuTopLeftX(0, 0);
1522 pcSPS->setSubPicCtuTopLeftY(0, 0);
1523 pcSPS->setSubPicWidth(0, (pcSPS->getMaxPicWidthInLumaSamples() + pcSPS->getCTUSize() - 1) >> floorLog2(pcSPS->getCTUSize()));
1524 pcSPS->setSubPicHeight(0, (pcSPS->getMaxPicHeightInLumaSamples() + pcSPS->getCTUSize() - 1) >> floorLog2(pcSPS->getCTUSize()));
1525 }
1526
1527 if( !pcSPS->getSubPicIdMappingExplicitlySignalledFlag() || !pcSPS->getSubPicIdMappingPresentFlag() )
1528 {
1529 for( int picIdx = 0; picIdx < pcSPS->getNumSubPics( ); picIdx++ )
1530 {
1531 pcSPS->setSubPicId( picIdx, picIdx );
1532 }
1533 }
1534
1535 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "sps_bitdepth_minus8");
1536 CHECK(uiCode > 8, "Invalid bit depth signalled");
1537 const Profile::Name profile = pcSPS->getProfileTierLevel()->getProfileIdc();
1538 if (profile != Profile::NONE)
1539 {
1540 CHECK(uiCode + 8 > ProfileFeatures::getProfileFeatures(profile)->maxBitDepth, "sps_bitdepth_minus8 exceeds range supported by signalled profile");
1541 }
1542 pcSPS->setBitDepth(CHANNEL_TYPE_LUMA, 8 + uiCode);
1543 pcSPS->setBitDepth(CHANNEL_TYPE_CHROMA, 8 + uiCode);
1544 pcSPS->setQpBDOffset(CHANNEL_TYPE_LUMA, (int) (6*uiCode) );
1545 pcSPS->setQpBDOffset(CHANNEL_TYPE_CHROMA, (int) (6*uiCode) );
1546
1547 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "sps_entropy_coding_sync_enabled_flag" ); pcSPS->setEntropyCodingSyncEnabledFlag(uiCode == 1);
1548 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "sps_entry_point_offsets_present_flag"); pcSPS->setEntryPointsPresentFlag(uiCode == 1);
1549 READ_CODE(4, uiCode, "sps_log2_max_pic_order_cnt_lsb_minus4"); pcSPS->setBitsForPOC( 4 + uiCode );
1550 CHECK(uiCode > 12, "sps_log2_max_pic_order_cnt_lsb_minus4 shall be in the range of 0 to 12");
1551
1552 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_poc_msb_cycle_flag"); pcSPS->setPocMsbCycleFlag(uiCode ? true : false);
1553 if (pcSPS->getPocMsbCycleFlag())
1554 {
1555 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "sps_poc_msb_cycle_len_minus1"); pcSPS->setPocMsbCycleLen(1 + uiCode);
1556 CHECK(uiCode > (32 - ( pcSPS->getBitsForPOC() - 4 )- 5), "The value of sps_poc_msb_cycle_len_minus1 shall be in the range of 0 to 32 - sps_log2_max_pic_order_cnt_lsb_minus4 - 5, inclusive");
1557 }
1558
1559 // extra bits are for future extensions, we will read, but ignore them,
1560 // unless a meaning is specified in the spec
1561 READ_CODE(2, uiCode, "sps_num_extra_ph_bytes"); pcSPS->setNumExtraPHBytes(uiCode);
1562 int numExtraPhBytes = uiCode;
1563 std::vector<bool> extraPhBitPresentFlags;
1564 extraPhBitPresentFlags.resize ( 8 * numExtraPhBytes );
1565 for (int i=0; i < 8*numExtraPhBytes; i++)
1566 {
1567 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_extra_ph_bit_present_flag[ i ]");
1568 extraPhBitPresentFlags[i] = uiCode;
1569 }
1570 pcSPS->setExtraPHBitPresentFlags(extraPhBitPresentFlags);
1571 READ_CODE(2, uiCode, "sps_num_extra_sh_bytes"); pcSPS->setNumExtraSHBytes(uiCode);
1572 int numExtraShBytes = uiCode;
1573 std::vector<bool> extraShBitPresentFlags;
1574 extraShBitPresentFlags.resize ( 8 * numExtraShBytes );

1954 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "sps_ladf_enabled_flag" ); pcSPS->setLadfEnabled( uiCode != 0 );
1955 if ( pcSPS->getLadfEnabled() )
1956 {
1957 int signedSymbol = 0;
1958 READ_CODE( 2, uiCode, "sps_num_ladf_intervals_minus2"); pcSPS->setLadfNumIntervals( uiCode + 2 );
1959 READ_SVLC(signedSymbol, "sps_ladf_lowest_interval_qp_offset" ); pcSPS->setLadfQpOffset( signedSymbol, 0 );
1960 for ( int k = 1; k < pcSPS->getLadfNumIntervals(); k++ )
1961 {
1962 READ_SVLC(signedSymbol, "sps_ladf_qp_offset" ); pcSPS->setLadfQpOffset( signedSymbol, k );
1963 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "sps_ladf_delta_threshold_minus1");
1964 pcSPS->setLadfIntervalLowerBound(uiCode + pcSPS->getLadfIntervalLowerBound(k - 1) + 1, k);
1965 }
1966 }
1967#endif
1968 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_explicit_scaling_list_enabled_flag"); pcSPS->setScalingListFlag(uiCode);
1969 if (pcSPS->getProfileTierLevel()->getConstraintInfo()->getNoExplicitScaleListConstraintFlag())
1970 {
1971 CHECK(uiCode != 0, "When gci_no_explicit_scaling_list_constraint_flag is equal to 1, sps_explicit_scaling_list_enabled_flag shall be equal to 0");
1972 }
1973
1974 if (pcSPS->getUseLFNST() && pcSPS->getScalingListFlag())
1975 {
1976 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_scaling_matrix_for_lfnst_disabled_flag"); pcSPS->setDisableScalingMatrixForLfnstBlks(uiCode ? true : false);
1977 }
1978
1979 if (pcSPS->getUseColorTrans() && pcSPS->getScalingListFlag())
1980 {
1981 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_scaling_matrix_for_alternative_colour_space_disabled_flag"); pcSPS->setScalingMatrixForAlternativeColourSpaceDisabledFlag(uiCode);
1982 }
1983 if (pcSPS->getScalingMatrixForAlternativeColourSpaceDisabledFlag())
1984 {
1985 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_scaling_matrix_designated_colour_space_flag"); pcSPS->setScalingMatrixDesignatedColourSpaceFlag(uiCode);
1986 }
1987 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_dep_quant_enabled_flag"); pcSPS->setDepQuantEnabledFlag(uiCode);
1988 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_sign_data_hiding_enabled_flag"); pcSPS->setSignDataHidingEnabledFlag(uiCode);
1989
1990 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "sps_virtual_boundaries_enabled_flag" ); pcSPS->setVirtualBoundariesEnabledFlag( uiCode != 0 );
1991 if (pcSPS->getProfileTierLevel()->getConstraintInfo()->getNoVirtualBoundaryConstraintFlag())
1992 {
1993 CHECK(uiCode != 0, "When gci_no_virtual_boundaries_constraint_flag is equal to 1, sps_virtual_boundaries_enabled_flag shall be equal to 0");
1994 }
1995
1996 if( pcSPS->getVirtualBoundariesEnabledFlag() )
1997 {
1998 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "sps_loop_filter_across_virtual_boundaries_present_flag" ); pcSPS->setVirtualBoundariesPresentFlag( uiCode != 0 );
1999 if( pcSPS->getVirtualBoundariesPresentFlag() )
2000 {
2001 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "sps_num_ver_virtual_boundaries"); pcSPS->setNumVerVirtualBoundaries( uiCode );
2002 if (pcSPS->getMaxPicWidthInLumaSamples() <= 8)
2003 {
2004 CHECK(pcSPS->getNumVerVirtualBoundaries() != 0, "SPS: When picture width is less than or equal to 8, the number of vertical virtual boundaries shall be equal to 0");
2005 }
2006 else
2007 {
2008 CHECK(pcSPS->getNumVerVirtualBoundaries() > 3, "SPS: The number of vertical virtual boundaries shall be in the range of 0 to 3");
2009 }
2010 for( unsigned i = 0; i < pcSPS->getNumVerVirtualBoundaries(); i++ )
2011 {
2012 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "sps_virtual_boundary_pos_x_minus1[i]"); pcSPS->setVirtualBoundariesPosX((uiCode + 1) << 3, i);
2013 CHECK(uiCode > (((pcSPS->getMaxPicWidthInLumaSamples() + 7) >> 3) - 2), "The value of sps_virtual_boundary_pos_x_minus1[ i ] shall be in the range of 0 to Ceil( sps_pic_width_max_in_luma_samples / 8 ) - 2, inclusive.");
2014 }
2015 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "sps_num_hor_virtual_boundaries"); pcSPS->setNumHorVirtualBoundaries( uiCode );
2016 if (pcSPS->getMaxPicHeightInLumaSamples() <= 8)
2017 {
2018 CHECK(pcSPS->getNumHorVirtualBoundaries() != 0, "SPS: When picture height is less than or equal to 8, the number of horizontal virtual boundaries shall be equal to 0");
2019 }
2020 else
2021 {
2022 CHECK(pcSPS->getNumHorVirtualBoundaries() > 3, "SPS: The number of horizontal virtual boundaries shall be in the range of 0 to 3");
2023 }
2024 for( unsigned i = 0; i < pcSPS->getNumHorVirtualBoundaries(); i++ )
2025 {
2026 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "sps_virtual_boundary_pos_y_minus1[i]"); pcSPS->setVirtualBoundariesPosY((uiCode + 1) << 3, i);
2027 CHECK(uiCode > (((pcSPS->getMaxPicHeightInLumaSamples() + 7) >> 3) - 2), "The value of sps_virtual_boundary_pos_y_minus1[ i ] shall be in the range of 0 to Ceil( sps_pic_height_max_in_luma_samples / 8 ) - 2, inclusive.");
2028 }
2029 }
2030 else
2031 {
2032 pcSPS->setNumVerVirtualBoundaries( 0 );
2033 pcSPS->setNumHorVirtualBoundaries( 0 );
2034 }
2035 }
2036 else
2037 {
2038 pcSPS->setVirtualBoundariesPresentFlag(false);
2039 }
2040
2041 if (pcSPS->getPtlDpbHrdParamsPresentFlag())
2042 {
2043 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_timing_hrd_params_present_flag"); pcSPS->setGeneralHrdParametersPresentFlag(uiCode);
2044 if (pcSPS->getGeneralHrdParametersPresentFlag())
2045 {
2046 parseGeneralHrdParameters(pcSPS->getGeneralHrdParameters());
2047 if ((pcSPS->getMaxTLayers()-1) > 0)
2048 {
2049 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_sublayer_cpb_params_present_flag"); pcSPS->setSubLayerParametersPresentFlag(uiCode);
2050 }
2051 else if((pcSPS->getMaxTLayers()-1) == 0)
2052 {
2053 pcSPS->setSubLayerParametersPresentFlag(0);
2054 }
2055
2056 uint32_t firstSubLayer = pcSPS->getSubLayerParametersPresentFlag() ? 0 : (pcSPS->getMaxTLayers() - 1);
2057 parseOlsHrdParameters(pcSPS->getGeneralHrdParameters(),pcSPS->getOlsHrdParameters(), firstSubLayer, pcSPS->getMaxTLayers() - 1);
2058 }
2059 }
2060
2061 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "sps_field_seq_flag"); pcSPS->setFieldSeqFlag(uiCode);
2062 CHECK( pcSPS->getProfileTierLevel()->getFrameOnlyConstraintFlag() && uiCode, "When ptl_frame_only_constraint_flag equal to 1 , the value of sps_field_seq_flag shall be equal to 0");
2063
2064 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "sps_vui_parameters_present_flag" ); pcSPS->setVuiParametersPresentFlag(uiCode);
2065
2066 if (pcSPS->getVuiParametersPresentFlag())
2067 {
2068 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "sps_vui_payload_size_minus1");
2069 pcSPS->setVuiPayloadSize(uiCode+1);
2070 while (!isByteAligned())
2071 {
2072 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sps_vui_alignment_zero_bit");
2073 CHECK(uiCode != 0, "sps_vui_alignment_zero_bit not equal to 0");
2074 }
2075 parseVUI(pcSPS->getVuiParameters(), pcSPS);
2076 }
2077
2078 // KJS: no SPS extensions defined yet
2079
2080 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "sps_extension_present_flag");
2081 if (uiCode)
2082 {
2083#if ENABLE_TRACING || RExt__DECODER_DEBUG_BIT_STATISTICS
2084 static const char *syntaxStrings[]={ "sps_range_extension_flag",
2085 "sps_multilayer_extension_flag",
2086 "sps_extension_6bits[0]",
2087 "sps_extension_6bits[1]",
2088 "sps_extension_6bits[2]",
2089 "sps_extension_6bits[3]",
2090 "sps_extension_6bits[4]",
2091 "sps_extension_6bits[5]" };
2092#endif
2093 bool sps_extension_flags[NUM_SPS_EXTENSION_FLAGS];
2094
2095 for(int i=0; i<NUM_SPS_EXTENSION_FLAGS; i++)
2096 {
2097 READ_FLAG( uiCode, syntaxStrings[i] );
2098 sps_extension_flags[i] = uiCode!=0;
2099 }
2100
2101 bool bSkipTrailingExtensionBits=false;
2102 for(int i=0; i<NUM_SPS_EXTENSION_FLAGS; i++) // loop used so that the order is determined by the enum.
2103 {
2104 if (sps_extension_flags[i])
2105 {
2106 switch (SPSExtensionFlagIndex(i))
2107 {
2108 case SPS_EXT__REXT:
2109 CHECK(bSkipTrailingExtensionBits, "Skipping trailing extension bits not supported");
2110 {
2111 SPSRExt &spsRangeExtension = pcSPS->getSpsRangeExtension();
2112 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "transform_skip_rotation_enabled_flag"); spsRangeExtension.setTransformSkipRotationEnabledFlag(uiCode != 0);
2113 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "transform_skip_context_enabled_flag"); spsRangeExtension.setTransformSkipContextEnabledFlag (uiCode != 0);
2114 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "extended_precision_processing_flag"); spsRangeExtension.setExtendedPrecisionProcessingFlag (uiCode != 0);
2115 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "intra_smoothing_disabled_flag"); spsRangeExtension.setIntraSmoothingDisabledFlag (uiCode != 0);
2116 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "high_precision_offsets_enabled_flag"); spsRangeExtension.setHighPrecisionOffsetsEnabledFlag (uiCode != 0);
2117 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "persistent_rice_adaptation_enabled_flag"); spsRangeExtension.setPersistentRiceAdaptationEnabledFlag (uiCode != 0);
2118 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "cabac_bypass_alignment_enabled_flag"); spsRangeExtension.setCabacBypassAlignmentEnabledFlag (uiCode != 0);
2119 }
2120 break;
2121 default:
2122 bSkipTrailingExtensionBits=true;
2123 break;
2124 }
2125 }
2126 }
2127 if (bSkipTrailingExtensionBits)
2128 {
2129 while ( xMoreRbspData() )
2130 {
2131 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "sps_extension_data_flag");
2132 }
2133 }
2134 }
2135 xReadRbspTrailingBits();
2136}

2138#if JVET_S0163_ON_TARGETOLS_SUBLAYERS
2139void HLSyntaxReader::parseOPI(OPI* opi)

2161 }

2169 }
