2175
2176void HLSyntaxReader::parseDCI(DCI* dci)
2177{
2178#if ENABLE_TRACING
2179 xTraceDCIHeader();
2180#endif
2181 uint32_t symbol;
2182
2183 READ_CODE(4, symbol, "dci_reserved_zero_4bits");
2184
2185 uint32_t numPTLs;
2186 READ_CODE(4, numPTLs, "dci_num_ptls_minus1");
2187 numPTLs += 1;
2188
2189 std::vector<ProfileTierLevel> ptls;
2190 ptls.resize(numPTLs);
2191 for (int i = 0; i < numPTLs; i++)
2192 {
2193 parseProfileTierLevel(&ptls[i], true, 0);
2194 }
2195 dci->setProfileTierLevel(ptls);
2196
2197 READ_FLAG(symbol, "dci_extension_flag");
2198 if (symbol)
2199 {
2200 while (xMoreRbspData())
2201 {
2202 READ_FLAG(symbol, "dci_extension_data_flag");
2203 }
2204 }
2205 xReadRbspTrailingBits();
2206}
2207
2208void HLSyntaxReader::parseVPS(VPS* pcVPS)
2209{
2210#if ENABLE_TRACING
2211 xTraceVPSHeader();
2212#endif
2213 uint32_t uiCode;
2214
2215 READ_CODE(4, uiCode, "vps_video_parameter_set_id");
2216 CHECK( uiCode == 0, "vps_video_parameter_set_id equal to zero is reserved and shall not be used in a bitstream" );
2217 pcVPS->setVPSId(uiCode);
2218
2219 READ_CODE(6, uiCode, "vps_max_layers_minus1"); pcVPS->setMaxLayers(uiCode + 1); CHECK(uiCode + 1 > MAX_VPS_LAYERS, "Signalled number of layers larger than MAX_VPS_LAYERS.");
2220 if (pcVPS->getMaxLayers() - 1 == 0)
2221 {
2222 pcVPS->setEachLayerIsAnOlsFlag(1);
2223 }
2224 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "vps_max_sublayers_minus1"); pcVPS->setMaxSubLayers(uiCode + 1); CHECK(uiCode + 1 > MAX_VPS_SUBLAYERS, "Signalled number of sublayers larger than MAX_VPS_SUBLAYERS.");
2225 if( pcVPS->getMaxLayers() > 1 && pcVPS->getMaxSubLayers() > 1)
2226 {
2227 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "vps_default_ptl_dpb_hrd_max_tid_flag"); pcVPS->setDefaultPtlDpbHrdMaxTidFlag(uiCode);
2228 }
2229 else
2230 {
2231 pcVPS->setDefaultPtlDpbHrdMaxTidFlag(1);
2232 }
2233 if( pcVPS->getMaxLayers() > 1 )
2234 {
2235 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "vps_all_independent_layers_flag"); pcVPS->setAllIndependentLayersFlag(uiCode);
2236 if (pcVPS->getAllIndependentLayersFlag() == 0)
2237 {
2238 pcVPS->setEachLayerIsAnOlsFlag(0);
2239 }
2240 }
2241#if JVET_R0193
2242 std::vector<std::vector<uint32_t>> maxTidilRefPicsPlus1;
2243 maxTidilRefPicsPlus1.resize(pcVPS->getMaxLayers(), std::vector<uint32_t>(pcVPS->getMaxLayers(), NOT_VALID));
2244 pcVPS->setMaxTidIlRefPicsPlus1(maxTidilRefPicsPlus1);
2245#endif
2246 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < pcVPS->getMaxLayers(); i++)
2247 {
2248 READ_CODE(6, uiCode, "vps_layer_id"); pcVPS->setLayerId(i, uiCode);
2249 pcVPS->setGeneralLayerIdx(uiCode, i);
2250
2251 if (i > 0 && !pcVPS->getAllIndependentLayersFlag())
2252 {
2253 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "vps_independent_layer_flag"); pcVPS->setIndependentLayerFlag(i, uiCode);
2254 if (!pcVPS->getIndependentLayerFlag(i))
2255 {
2256#if JVET_R0193
2257 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "max_tid_ref_present_flag[ i ]");
2258 bool presentFlag = uiCode;
2259 uint16_t sumUiCode = 0;
2260 for (int j = 0, k = 0; j < i; j++)
2261 {
2262 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "vps_direct_ref_layer_flag"); pcVPS->setDirectRefLayerFlag(i, j, uiCode);
2263 if (uiCode)
2264 {
2265 pcVPS->setInterLayerRefIdc(i, j, k);
2266 pcVPS->setDirectRefLayerIdx(i, k++, j);
2267 sumUiCode++;
2268 }
2269 if (presentFlag && pcVPS->getDirectRefLayerFlag(i, j))
2270 {
2271 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "max_tid_il_ref_pics_plus1[ i ][ j ]");
2272 pcVPS->setMaxTidIlRefPicsPlus1(i, j, uiCode);
2273 }
2274 else
2275 {
2276 pcVPS->setMaxTidIlRefPicsPlus1(i, j, 7);
2277 }
2278 }
2279 CHECK(sumUiCode == 0, "There has to be at least one value of j such that the value of vps_direct_dependency_flag[ i ][ j ] is equal to 1,when vps_independent_layer_flag[ i ] is equal to 0 ");
2280#else
2281 uint16_t sumUiCode = 0;
2282 for (int j = 0, k = 0; j < i; j++)
2283 {
2284 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "vps_direct_dependency_flag"); pcVPS->setDirectRefLayerFlag(i, j, uiCode);
2285 if( uiCode )
2286 {
2287 pcVPS->setInterLayerRefIdc( i, j, k );
2288 pcVPS->setDirectRefLayerIdx( i, k++, j );
2289 sumUiCode++;
2290 }
2291 }
2292 CHECK(sumUiCode == 0, "There has to be at least one value of j such that the value of vps_direct_dependency_flag[ i ][ j ] is equal to 1,when vps_independent_layer_flag[ i ] is equal to 0 ");
2293 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "vps_max_tid_ref_present_flag[ i ]");
2294 if (uiCode)
2295 {
2296 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "vps_max_tid_il_ref_pics_plus1[ i ]");
2297 pcVPS->setMaxTidIlRefPicsPlus1(i, uiCode);
2298 }
2299 else
2300 {
2301 pcVPS->setMaxTidIlRefPicsPlus1(i, 7);
2302 }
2303#endif
2304 }
2305 }
2306 }
2307
2308 if (pcVPS->getMaxLayers() > 1)
2309 {
2310 if (pcVPS->getAllIndependentLayersFlag())
2311 {
2312 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "vps_each_layer_is_an_ols_flag"); pcVPS->setEachLayerIsAnOlsFlag(uiCode);
2313 if (pcVPS->getEachLayerIsAnOlsFlag() == 0)
2314 {
2315 pcVPS->setOlsModeIdc(2);
2316 }
2317 }
2318 if (!pcVPS->getEachLayerIsAnOlsFlag())
2319 {
2320 if (!pcVPS->getAllIndependentLayersFlag())
2321 {
2322 READ_CODE(2, uiCode, "vps_ols_mode_idc"); pcVPS->setOlsModeIdc(uiCode); CHECK(uiCode > MAX_VPS_OLS_MODE_IDC, "vps_ols_mode_idc shall be in the range of 0 to 2");
2323 }
2324 if (pcVPS->getOlsModeIdc() == 2)
2325 {
2326 READ_CODE(8, uiCode, "vps_num_output_layer_sets_minus2"); pcVPS->setNumOutputLayerSets(uiCode + 2);
2327 for (uint32_t i = 1; i <= pcVPS->getNumOutputLayerSets() - 1; i++)
2328 {
2329 for (uint32_t j = 0; j < pcVPS->getMaxLayers(); j++)
2330 {
2331 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "vps_ols_output_layer_flag"); pcVPS->setOlsOutputLayerFlag(i, j, uiCode);
2332 }
2333 }
2334 }
2335 }
2336 READ_CODE(8, uiCode, "vps_num_ptls_minus1"); pcVPS->setNumPtls(uiCode + 1);
2337 }
2338 else
2339 {
2340 pcVPS->setNumPtls(1);
2341 }
2342 pcVPS->deriveOutputLayerSets();
2343 CHECK( uiCode >= pcVPS->getTotalNumOLSs(),"The value of vps_num_ptls_minus1 shall be less than TotalNumOlss");
2344 std::vector<bool> isPTLReferred( pcVPS->getNumPtls(), false);
2345
2346 for (int i = 0; i < pcVPS->getNumPtls(); i++)
2347 {
2348 if(i > 0)
2349 {
2350 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "vps_pt_present_flag");
2351 pcVPS->setPtPresentFlag(i, uiCode);
2352 }
2353 else
2354 pcVPS->setPtPresentFlag(0, 1);
2355 if (!pcVPS->getDefaultPtlDpbHrdMaxTidFlag())
2356 {
2357 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "vps_ptl_max_tid");
2358 pcVPS->setPtlMaxTemporalId(i, uiCode);
2359 }
2360 else
2361 {
2362 pcVPS->setPtlMaxTemporalId(i, pcVPS->getMaxSubLayers() - 1);
2363 }
2364 }
2365 int cnt = 0;
2366 while (m_pcBitstream->getNumBitsUntilByteAligned())
2367 {
2368 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "vps_ptl_reserved_zero_bit");
2369 CHECK(uiCode!=0, "Alignment bit is not '0'");
2370 cnt++;
2371 }
2372 CHECK(cnt >= 8, "Read more than '8' alignment bits");
2373 std::vector<ProfileTierLevel> ptls;
2374 ptls.resize(pcVPS->getNumPtls());
2375 for (int i = 0; i < pcVPS->getNumPtls(); i++)
2376 {
2377 parseProfileTierLevel(&ptls[i], pcVPS->getPtPresentFlag(i), pcVPS->getPtlMaxTemporalId(i) - 1);
2378 }
2379 pcVPS->setProfileTierLevel(ptls);
2380 for (int i = 0; i < pcVPS->getTotalNumOLSs(); i++)
2381 {
2382 if (pcVPS->getNumPtls() > 1 && pcVPS->getNumPtls() != pcVPS->getTotalNumOLSs())
2383 {
2384 READ_CODE(8, uiCode, "vps_ols_ptl_idx");
2385 pcVPS->setOlsPtlIdx(i, uiCode);
2386 }
2387 else if (pcVPS->getNumPtls() == pcVPS->getTotalNumOLSs())
2388 {
2389 pcVPS->setOlsPtlIdx(i, i);
2390 }
2391 else
2392 pcVPS->setOlsPtlIdx(i, 0);
2393 isPTLReferred[pcVPS->getOlsPtlIdx(i)] = true;
2394 }
2395 for( int i = 0; i < pcVPS->getNumPtls(); i++ )
2396 {
2397 CHECK( !isPTLReferred[i],"Each profile_tier_level( ) syntax structure in the VPS shall be referred to by at least one value of vps_ols_ptl_idx[ i ] for i in the range of 0 to TotalNumOlss ? 1, inclusive");
2398 }
2399
2400 if( !pcVPS->getEachLayerIsAnOlsFlag() )
2401 {
2402 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "vps_num_dpb_params_minus1" ); pcVPS->m_numDpbParams = uiCode + 1;
2403
2404 CHECK( pcVPS->m_numDpbParams > pcVPS->getNumMultiLayeredOlss(),"The value of vps_num_dpb_params_minus1 shall be in the range of 0 to NumMultiLayerOlss - 1, inclusive");
2405 std::vector<bool> isDPBParamReferred(pcVPS->m_numDpbParams, false);
2406
2407 if( pcVPS->m_numDpbParams > 0 && pcVPS->getMaxSubLayers() > 1 )
2408 {
2409 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "vps_sublayer_dpb_params_present_flag" ); pcVPS->m_sublayerDpbParamsPresentFlag = uiCode;
2410 }
2411
2412 pcVPS->m_dpbParameters.resize( pcVPS->m_numDpbParams );
2413
2414 for( int i = 0; i < pcVPS->m_numDpbParams; i++ )
2415 {
2416 if (!pcVPS->getDefaultPtlDpbHrdMaxTidFlag())
2417 {
2418 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "vps_dpb_max_tid[i]");
2419 pcVPS->m_dpbMaxTemporalId.push_back(uiCode);
2420 CHECK (uiCode > (pcVPS->getMaxSubLayers() - 1), "The value of vps_dpb_max_tid[i] shall be in the range of 0 to vps_max_sublayers_minus1, inclusive." )
2421 }
2422 else
2423 {
2424 pcVPS->m_dpbMaxTemporalId.push_back(pcVPS->getMaxSubLayers() - 1);
2425 }
2426
2427 for( int j = ( pcVPS->m_sublayerDpbParamsPresentFlag ? 0 : pcVPS->m_dpbMaxTemporalId[i] ); j <= pcVPS->m_dpbMaxTemporalId[i]; j++ )
2428 {
2429 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "dpb_max_dec_pic_buffering_minus1[i]");
2430 pcVPS->m_dpbParameters[i].m_maxDecPicBuffering[j] = uiCode + 1;
2431 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "dpb_max_num_reorder_pics[i]" ); pcVPS->m_dpbParameters[i].m_maxNumReorderPics[j] = uiCode;
2432 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "dpb_max_latency_increase_plus1[i]" ); pcVPS->m_dpbParameters[i].m_maxLatencyIncreasePlus1[j] = uiCode;
2433 }
2434
2435 for( int j = ( pcVPS->m_sublayerDpbParamsPresentFlag ? pcVPS->m_dpbMaxTemporalId[i] : 0 ); j < pcVPS->m_dpbMaxTemporalId[i]; j++ )
2436 {
2437 // When dpb_max_dec_pic_buffering_minus1[ i ] is not present for i in the range of 0 to maxSubLayersMinus1 - 1, inclusive, due to subLayerInfoFlag being equal to 0, it is inferred to be equal to dpb_max_dec_pic_buffering_minus1[ maxSubLayersMinus1 ].
2438 pcVPS->m_dpbParameters[i].m_maxDecPicBuffering[j] = pcVPS->m_dpbParameters[i].m_maxDecPicBuffering[pcVPS->m_dpbMaxTemporalId[i]];
2439
2440 // When dpb_max_num_reorder_pics[ i ] is not present for i in the range of 0 to maxSubLayersMinus1 - 1, inclusive, due to subLayerInfoFlag being equal to 0, it is inferred to be equal to dpb_max_num_reorder_pics[ maxSubLayersMinus1 ].
2441 pcVPS->m_dpbParameters[i].m_maxNumReorderPics[j] = pcVPS->m_dpbParameters[i].m_maxNumReorderPics[pcVPS->m_dpbMaxTemporalId[i]];
2442
2443 // When dpb_max_latency_increase_plus1[ i ] is not present for i in the range of 0 to maxSubLayersMinus1 - 1, inclusive, due to subLayerInfoFlag being equal to 0, it is inferred to be equal to dpb_max_latency_increase_plus1[ maxSubLayersMinus1 ].
2444 pcVPS->m_dpbParameters[i].m_maxLatencyIncreasePlus1[j] = pcVPS->m_dpbParameters[i].m_maxLatencyIncreasePlus1[pcVPS->m_dpbMaxTemporalId[i]];
2445 }
2446 }
2447
2448
2449 for( int i = 0, j=0; i < pcVPS->getTotalNumOLSs(); i++ )
2450 {
2451 if( pcVPS->m_numLayersInOls[i] > 1 )
2452 {
2453 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "vps_ols_dpb_pic_width[i]" ); pcVPS->setOlsDpbPicWidth( i, uiCode );
2454 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "vps_ols_dpb_pic_height[i]" ); pcVPS->setOlsDpbPicHeight( i, uiCode );
2455 READ_CODE( 2, uiCode, "vps_ols_dpb_chroma_format[i]"); pcVPS->setOlsDpbChromaFormatIdc(i, uiCode);
2456 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "vps_ols_dpb_bitdepth_minus8[i]"); pcVPS->setOlsDpbBitDepthMinus8(i, uiCode);
2457 const Profile::Name profile = pcVPS->getProfileTierLevel(pcVPS->getOlsPtlIdx(i)).getProfileIdc();
2458 if (profile != Profile::NONE)
2459 {
2460 CHECK(uiCode + 8 > ProfileFeatures::getProfileFeatures(profile)->maxBitDepth, "vps_ols_dpb_bitdepth_minus8[ i ] exceeds range supported by signalled profile");
2461 }
2462 if ((pcVPS->m_numDpbParams > 1) && (pcVPS->m_numDpbParams != pcVPS->m_numMultiLayeredOlss))
2463 {
2464 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "vps_ols_dpb_params_idx[i]" ); pcVPS->setOlsDpbParamsIdx( i, uiCode );
2465 }
2466 else if (pcVPS->m_numDpbParams == 1)
2467 {
2468 pcVPS->setOlsDpbParamsIdx(i, 0);
2469 }
2470 else
2471 {
2472 pcVPS->setOlsDpbParamsIdx(i, j);
2473 }
2474 j += 1;
2475 isDPBParamReferred[pcVPS->getOlsDpbParamsIdx(i)] = true;
2476 }
2477 }
2478 for( int i = 0; i < pcVPS->m_numDpbParams; i++ )
2479 {
2480 CHECK( !isDPBParamReferred[i],"Each dpb_parameters( ) syntax structure in the VPS shall be referred to by at least one value of vps_ols_dpb_params_idx[i] for i in the range of 0 to NumMultiLayerOlss - 1, inclusive");
2481 }
2482 }
2483
2484 if (!pcVPS->getEachLayerIsAnOlsFlag())
2485 {
2486 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "vps_general_hrd_params_present_flag"); pcVPS->setVPSGeneralHrdParamsPresentFlag(uiCode);
2487 }
2488 if (pcVPS->getVPSGeneralHrdParamsPresentFlag())
2489 {
2490 parseGeneralHrdParameters(pcVPS->getGeneralHrdParameters());
2491 if ((pcVPS->getMaxSubLayers() - 1) > 0)
2492 {
2493 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "vps_sublayer_cpb_params_present_flag"); pcVPS->setVPSSublayerCpbParamsPresentFlag(uiCode);
2494 }
2495 else
2496 {
2497 pcVPS->setVPSSublayerCpbParamsPresentFlag(0);
2498 }
2499 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "vps_num_ols_timing_hrd_params_minus1"); pcVPS->setNumOlsTimingHrdParamsMinus1(uiCode);
2500 CHECK( uiCode >= pcVPS->getNumMultiLayeredOlss(),"The value of vps_num_ols_timing_hrd_params_minus1 shall be in the range of 0 to NumMultiLayerOlss - 1, inclusive");
2501 std::vector<bool> isHRDParamReferred( uiCode + 1, false);
2502 pcVPS->m_olsHrdParams.clear();
2503 pcVPS->m_olsHrdParams.resize(pcVPS->getNumOlsTimingHrdParamsMinus1(), std::vector<OlsHrdParams>(pcVPS->getMaxSubLayers()));
2504 for (int i = 0; i <= pcVPS->getNumOlsTimingHrdParamsMinus1(); i++)
2505 {
2506 if (!pcVPS->getDefaultPtlDpbHrdMaxTidFlag())
2507 {
2508 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "vps_hrd_max_tid[i]"); pcVPS->setHrdMaxTid(i, uiCode);
2509 CHECK (uiCode > (pcVPS->getMaxSubLayers() - 1), "The value of vps_hrd_max_tid[i] shall be in the range of 0 to vps_max_sublayers_minus1, inclusive." )
2510 }
2511 else
2512 {
2513 pcVPS->setHrdMaxTid(i, pcVPS->getMaxSubLayers() - 1);
2514 }
2515 uint32_t firstSublayer = pcVPS->getVPSSublayerCpbParamsPresentFlag() ? 0 : pcVPS->getHrdMaxTid(i);
2516 parseOlsHrdParameters(pcVPS->getGeneralHrdParameters(),pcVPS->getOlsHrdParameters(i), firstSublayer, pcVPS->getHrdMaxTid(i));
2517 }
2518 for (int i = pcVPS->getNumOlsTimingHrdParamsMinus1() + 1; i < pcVPS->getTotalNumOLSs(); i++)
2519 {
2520 pcVPS->setHrdMaxTid(i, pcVPS->getMaxSubLayers() - 1);
2521 }
2522 for (int i = 0; i < pcVPS->m_numMultiLayeredOlss; i++)
2523 {
2524 if (((pcVPS->getNumOlsTimingHrdParamsMinus1() + 1) != pcVPS->m_numMultiLayeredOlss) && (pcVPS->getNumOlsTimingHrdParamsMinus1() > 0))
2525 {
2526 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "vps_ols_timing_hrd_idx[i]"); pcVPS->setOlsTimingHrdIdx(i, uiCode);
2527 CHECK(uiCode > pcVPS->getNumOlsTimingHrdParamsMinus1(), "The value of vps_ols_timing_hrd_idx[[ i ] shall be in the range of 0 to vps_num_ols_timing_hrd_params_minus1, inclusive.");
2528 }
2529 else if (pcVPS->getNumOlsTimingHrdParamsMinus1() == 0)
2530 {
2531 pcVPS->setOlsTimingHrdIdx(i, 0);
2532 }
2533 else
2534 {
2535 pcVPS->setOlsTimingHrdIdx(i, i);
2536 }
2537 isHRDParamReferred[pcVPS->getOlsTimingHrdIdx(i)] = true;
2538 }
2539 for( int i = 0; i <= pcVPS->getNumOlsTimingHrdParamsMinus1(); i++ )
2540 {
2541 CHECK( !isHRDParamReferred[i], "Each vps_ols_timing_hrd_parameters( ) syntax structure in the VPS shall be referred to by at least one value of vps_ols_timing_hrd_idx[ i ] for i in the range of 1 to NumMultiLayerOlss - 1, inclusive");
2542 }
2543 }
2544 else
2545 {
2546 for (int i = 0; i < pcVPS->getTotalNumOLSs(); i++)
2547 {
2548 pcVPS->setHrdMaxTid(i, pcVPS->getMaxSubLayers() - 1);
2549 }
2550 }
2551
2552
2553 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "vps_extension_flag");
2554 if (uiCode)
2555 {
2556 while (xMoreRbspData())
2557 {
2558 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "vps_extension_data_flag");
2559 }
2560 }
2561 pcVPS->checkVPS();
2562 xReadRbspTrailingBits();
2563}
2564
2565void HLSyntaxReader::parsePictureHeader( PicHeader* picHeader, ParameterSetManager *parameterSetManager, bool readRbspTrailingBits )
2566{
2567 uint32_t uiCode;
2568 int iCode;
2569 PPS* pps = NULL;
2570 SPS* sps = NULL;
2571
2572#if ENABLE_TRACING
2573 xTracePictureHeader();
2574#endif
2575
2576 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ph_gdr_or_irap_pic_flag"); picHeader->setGdrOrIrapPicFlag(uiCode != 0);
2577 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ph_non_ref_pic_flag"); picHeader->setNonReferencePictureFlag(uiCode != 0);
2578 if (picHeader->getGdrOrIrapPicFlag())
2579 {
2580 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ph_gdr_pic_flag"); picHeader->setGdrPicFlag(uiCode != 0);
2581 }
2582 else
2583 {
2584 picHeader->setGdrPicFlag(false);
2585 }
2586 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ph_inter_slice_allowed_flag"); picHeader->setPicInterSliceAllowedFlag(uiCode != 0);
2587 if (picHeader->getPicInterSliceAllowedFlag())
2588 {
2589 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ph_intra_slice_allowed_flag"); picHeader->setPicIntraSliceAllowedFlag(uiCode != 0);
2590 }
2591 else
2592 {
2593 picHeader->setPicIntraSliceAllowedFlag(true);
2594 }
2595 CHECK(picHeader->getPicInterSliceAllowedFlag() == 0 && picHeader->getPicIntraSliceAllowedFlag() == 0, "Invalid picture without intra or inter slice");
2596 // parameter sets
2597 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "ph_pic_parameter_set_id");
2598 picHeader->setPPSId(uiCode);
2599 pps = parameterSetManager->getPPS(picHeader->getPPSId());
2600 CHECK(pps == 0, "Invalid PPS");
2601 picHeader->setSPSId(pps->getSPSId());
2602 sps = parameterSetManager->getSPS(picHeader->getSPSId());
2603 CHECK(sps == 0, "Invalid SPS");
2604 READ_CODE(sps->getBitsForPOC(), uiCode, "ph_pic_order_cnt_lsb");
2605 picHeader->setPocLsb(uiCode);
2606 if( picHeader->getGdrPicFlag() )
2607 {
2608 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "ph_recovery_poc_cnt"); picHeader->setRecoveryPocCnt( uiCode );
2609 }
2610 else
2611 {
2612 picHeader->setRecoveryPocCnt( -1 );
2613 }
2614
2615 std::vector<bool> phExtraBitsPresent = sps->getExtraPHBitPresentFlags();
2616 for (int i=0; i< sps->getNumExtraPHBytes() * 8; i++)
2617 {
2618 // extra bits are ignored (when present)
2619 if (phExtraBitsPresent[i])
2620 {
2621 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ph_extra_bit[ i ]");
2622 }
2623 }
2624
2625 if (sps->getPocMsbCycleFlag())
2626 {
2627 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ph_poc_msb_present_flag"); picHeader->setPocMsbPresentFlag(uiCode != 0);
2628 if (picHeader->getPocMsbPresentFlag())
2629 {
2630 READ_CODE(sps->getPocMsbCycleLen(), uiCode, "ph_poc_msb_cycle_val");
2631 picHeader->setPocMsbVal(uiCode);
2632 }
2633 }
2634
2635
2636 // alf enable flags and aps IDs
2637 picHeader->setCcAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cb, false);
2638 picHeader->setCcAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cr, false);
2639 if (sps->getALFEnabledFlag())
2640 {
2641 if (pps->getAlfInfoInPhFlag())
2642 {
2643 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ph_alf_enabled_flag");
2644 picHeader->setAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Y, uiCode);
2645
2646 int alfCbEnabledFlag = 0;
2647 int alfCrEnabledFlag = 0;
2648 if (uiCode)
2649 {
2650 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "ph_num_alf_aps_ids_luma");
2651 int numAps = uiCode;
2652 picHeader->setNumAlfAps(numAps);
2653
2654 std::vector<int> apsId(numAps, -1);
2655 for (int i = 0; i < numAps; i++)
2656 {
2657 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "ph_alf_aps_id_luma");
2658 apsId[i] = uiCode;
2659 }
2660 picHeader->setAlfAPSs(apsId);
2661
2662 if (sps->getChromaFormatIdc() != CHROMA_400)
2663 {
2664 READ_CODE(1, uiCode, "ph_alf_cb_enabled_flag"); alfCbEnabledFlag = uiCode;
2665 READ_CODE(1, uiCode, "ph_alf_cr_enabled_flag"); alfCrEnabledFlag = uiCode;
2666 }
2667 else
2668 {
2669 alfCbEnabledFlag = 0;
2670 alfCrEnabledFlag = 0;
2671 }
2672 if (alfCbEnabledFlag || alfCrEnabledFlag)
2673 {
2674 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "ph_alf_aps_id_chroma");
2675 picHeader->setAlfApsIdChroma(uiCode);
2676 }
2677 if (sps->getCCALFEnabledFlag())
2678 {
2679 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ph_cc_alf_cb_enabled_flag");
2680 picHeader->setCcAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cb, uiCode != 0);
2681 picHeader->setCcAlfCbApsId(-1);
2682 if (picHeader->getCcAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cb))
2683 {
2684 // parse APS ID
2685 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "ph_cc_alf_cb_aps_id");
2686 picHeader->setCcAlfCbApsId(uiCode);
2687 }
2688 // Cr
2689 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ph_cc_alf_cr_enabled_flag");
2690 picHeader->setCcAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cr, uiCode != 0);
2691 picHeader->setCcAlfCrApsId(-1);
2692 if (picHeader->getCcAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cr))
2693 {
2694 // parse APS ID
2695 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "ph_cc_alf_cr_aps_id");
2696 picHeader->setCcAlfCrApsId(uiCode);
2697 }
2698 }
2699 }
2700 else
2701 {
2702 picHeader->setNumAlfAps(0);
2703 }
2704 picHeader->setAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cb, alfCbEnabledFlag);
2705 picHeader->setAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cr, alfCrEnabledFlag);
2706 }
2707 else
2708 {
2709 picHeader->setAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Y, true);
2710 picHeader->setAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cb, true);
2711 picHeader->setAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cr, true);
2712 }
2713 }
2714 else
2715 {
2716 picHeader->setAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Y, false);
2717 picHeader->setAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cb, false);
2718 picHeader->setAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cr, false);
2719 }
2720 // luma mapping / chroma scaling controls
2721 if (sps->getUseLmcs())
2722 {
2723 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ph_lmcs_enabled_flag");
2724 picHeader->setLmcsEnabledFlag(uiCode != 0);
2725
2726 if (picHeader->getLmcsEnabledFlag())
2727 {
2728 READ_CODE(2, uiCode, "ph_lmcs_aps_id");
2729 picHeader->setLmcsAPSId(uiCode);
2730
2731 if (sps->getChromaFormatIdc() != CHROMA_400)
2732 {
2733 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ph_chroma_residual_scale_flag");
2734 picHeader->setLmcsChromaResidualScaleFlag(uiCode != 0);
2735 }
2736 else
2737 {
2738 picHeader->setLmcsChromaResidualScaleFlag(false);
2739 }
2740 }
2741 }
2742 else
2743 {
2744 picHeader->setLmcsEnabledFlag(false);
2745 picHeader->setLmcsChromaResidualScaleFlag(false);
2746 }
2747 // quantization scaling lists
2748 if (sps->getScalingListFlag())
2749 {
2750 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ph_explicit_scaling_list_enabled_flag");
2751 picHeader->setExplicitScalingListEnabledFlag(uiCode);
2752 if (picHeader->getExplicitScalingListEnabledFlag())
2753 {
2754 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "ph_scaling_list_aps_id");
2755 picHeader->setScalingListAPSId(uiCode);
2756 }
2757 }
2758 else
2759 {
2760 picHeader->setExplicitScalingListEnabledFlag(false);
2761 }
2762 if (pps->getPicWidthInLumaSamples() == sps->getMaxPicWidthInLumaSamples() && pps->getPicHeightInLumaSamples() == sps->getMaxPicHeightInLumaSamples())
2763 {
2764 CHECK(pps->getConformanceWindowFlag(), "When pps_pic_width_in_luma_samples is equal to sps_pic_width_max_in_luma_samples and pps_pic_height_in_luma_samples is equal to sps_pic_height_max_in_luma_samples, the value of pps_conformance_window_flag shall be equal to 0");
2765 pps->getConformanceWindow().setWindowLeftOffset(sps->getConformanceWindow().getWindowLeftOffset());
2766 pps->getConformanceWindow().setWindowRightOffset(sps->getConformanceWindow().getWindowRightOffset());
2767 pps->getConformanceWindow().setWindowTopOffset(sps->getConformanceWindow().getWindowTopOffset());
2768 pps->getConformanceWindow().setWindowBottomOffset(sps->getConformanceWindow().getWindowBottomOffset());
2769 }
2770
2771 // initialize tile/slice info for no partitioning case
2772
2773 if( pps->getNoPicPartitionFlag() )
2774 {
2775 pps->resetTileSliceInfo();
2776 pps->setLog2CtuSize( ceilLog2(sps->getCTUSize()) );
2777 pps->setNumExpTileColumns(1);
2778 pps->setNumExpTileRows(1);
2779 pps->addTileColumnWidth( pps->getPicWidthInCtu( ) );
2780 pps->addTileRowHeight( pps->getPicHeightInCtu( ) );
2781 pps->initTiles();
2782 pps->setRectSliceFlag( 1 );
2783 pps->setNumSlicesInPic( 1 );
2784 pps->initRectSlices( );
2785 pps->setTileIdxDeltaPresentFlag( 0 );
2786 pps->setSliceTileIdx( 0, 0 );
2787 pps->initRectSliceMap(sps);
2788 // when no Pic partition, number of sub picture shall be less than 2
2789 CHECK(pps->getNumSubPics()>=2, "error, no picture partitions, but have equal to or more than 2 sub pictures");
2790 }
2791 else
2792 {
2793 CHECK(pps->getCtuSize() != sps->getCTUSize(), "PPS CTU size does not match CTU size in SPS");
2794 if (pps->getRectSliceFlag())
2795 {
2796 pps->initRectSliceMap(sps);
2797 }
2798 }
2799
2800 pps->initSubPic(*sps);
2801
2802 // set wraparound offset from PPS and SPS info
2803 int minCbSizeY = (1 << sps->getLog2MinCodingBlockSize());
2804 CHECK( !sps->getWrapAroundEnabledFlag() && pps->getWrapAroundEnabledFlag(), "When sps_ref_wraparound_enabled_flag is equal to 0, the value of pps_ref_wraparound_enabled_flag shall be equal to 0.");
2805 CHECK( (((sps->getCTUSize() / minCbSizeY) + 1) > ((pps->getPicWidthInLumaSamples() / minCbSizeY) - 1)) && pps->getWrapAroundEnabledFlag(), "When the value of CtbSizeY / MinCbSizeY + 1 is greater than pps_pic_width_in_luma_samples / MinCbSizeY - 1, the value of pps_ref_wraparound_enabled_flag shall be equal to 0.");
2806 if( pps->getWrapAroundEnabledFlag() )
2807 {
2808 CHECK((pps->getPicWidthMinusWrapAroundOffset() > (pps->getPicWidthInLumaSamples() / minCbSizeY - sps->getCTUSize() / minCbSizeY - 2)), "pps_pic_width_minus_wraparound_ofsfet shall be less than or equal to pps_pic_width_in_luma_samples/MinCbSizeY - CtbSizeY/MinCbSizeY-2");
2809 pps->setWrapAroundOffset(minCbSizeY * (pps->getPicWidthInLumaSamples()/minCbSizeY- pps->getPicWidthMinusWrapAroundOffset()));
2810 }
2811 else
2812 {
2813 pps->setWrapAroundOffset( 0 );
2814 }
2815
2816 // virtual boundaries
2817 if( sps->getVirtualBoundariesEnabledFlag() && !sps->getVirtualBoundariesPresentFlag() )
2818 {
2819 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "ph_virtual_boundaries_present_flag" );
2820 picHeader->setVirtualBoundariesPresentFlag( uiCode != 0 );
2821 if( picHeader->getVirtualBoundariesPresentFlag() )
2822 {
2823 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "ph_num_ver_virtual_boundaries"); picHeader->setNumVerVirtualBoundaries( uiCode );
2824 if (pps->getPicWidthInLumaSamples() <= 8)
2825 {
2826 CHECK(picHeader->getNumVerVirtualBoundaries() != 0, "PH: When picture width is less than or equal to 8, the number of vertical virtual boundaries shall be equal to 0");
2827 }
2828 else
2829 {
2830 CHECK(picHeader->getNumVerVirtualBoundaries() > 3, "PH: The number of vertical virtual boundaries shall be in the range of 0 to 3");
2831 }
2832 for( unsigned i = 0; i < picHeader->getNumVerVirtualBoundaries(); i++ )
2833 {
2834 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "ph_virtual_boundary_pos_x_minus1[i]"); picHeader->setVirtualBoundariesPosX((uiCode + 1) << 3, i);
2835 CHECK(uiCode > (((pps->getPicWidthInLumaSamples() + 7) >> 3) - 2), "The value of ph_virtual_boundary_pos_x_minus1[ i ] shall be in the range of 0 to Ceil( pps_pic_width_in_luma_samples / 8 ) - 2, inclusive.");
2836 }
2837 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "ph_num_hor_virtual_boundaries"); picHeader->setNumHorVirtualBoundaries( uiCode );
2838 if (pps->getPicHeightInLumaSamples() <= 8)
2839 {
2840 CHECK(picHeader->getNumHorVirtualBoundaries() != 0, "PH: When picture width is less than or equal to 8, the number of horizontal virtual boundaries shall be equal to 0");
2841 }
2842 else
2843 {
2844 CHECK(picHeader->getNumHorVirtualBoundaries() > 3, "PH: The number of horizontal virtual boundaries shall be in the range of 0 to 3");
2845 }
2846 for( unsigned i = 0; i < picHeader->getNumHorVirtualBoundaries(); i++ )
2847 {
2848 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "ph_virtual_boundary_pos_y_minus1[i]"); picHeader->setVirtualBoundariesPosY((uiCode + 1) << 3, i);
2849 CHECK(uiCode > (((pps->getPicHeightInLumaSamples() + 7) >> 3) - 2), "The value of ph_virtual_boundary_pos_y_minus1[ i ] shall be in the range of 0 to Ceil( pps_pic_height_in_luma_samples / 8 ) - 2, inclusive.");
2850 }
2851 }
2852 else
2853 {
2854 picHeader->setNumVerVirtualBoundaries( 0 );
2855 picHeader->setNumHorVirtualBoundaries( 0 );
2856 }
2857 }
2858 else
2859 {
2860 picHeader->setVirtualBoundariesPresentFlag( sps->getVirtualBoundariesPresentFlag() );
2861 if( picHeader->getVirtualBoundariesPresentFlag() )
2862 {
2863 picHeader->setNumVerVirtualBoundaries( sps->getNumVerVirtualBoundaries() );
2864 picHeader->setNumHorVirtualBoundaries( sps->getNumHorVirtualBoundaries() );
2865 for( unsigned i = 0; i < 3; i++ )
2866 {
2867 picHeader->setVirtualBoundariesPosX( sps->getVirtualBoundariesPosX(i), i );
2868 picHeader->setVirtualBoundariesPosY( sps->getVirtualBoundariesPosY(i), i );
2869 }
2870 }
2871 }
2872
2873
2874 // picture output flag
2875 if (pps->getOutputFlagPresentFlag() && !picHeader->getNonReferencePictureFlag())
2876 {
2877 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "ph_pic_output_flag" ); picHeader->setPicOutputFlag( uiCode != 0 );
2878 }
2879 else
2880 {
2881 picHeader->setPicOutputFlag( true );
2882 }
2883
2884 // reference picture lists
2885 if (pps->getRplInfoInPhFlag())
2886 {
2887 bool rplSpsFlag0 = 0;
2888
2889 // List0 and List1
2890 for(int listIdx = 0; listIdx < 2; listIdx++)
2891 {
2892 if (sps->getNumRPL(listIdx) > 0 &&
2893 (listIdx == 0 || (listIdx == 1 && pps->getRpl1IdxPresentFlag())))
2894 {
2895 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "rpl_sps_flag[i]");
2896 }
2897 else if (sps->getNumRPL(listIdx) == 0)
2898 {
2899 uiCode = 0;
2900 }
2901 else
2902 {
2903 uiCode = rplSpsFlag0;
2904 }
2905
2906 if (listIdx == 0)
2907 {
2908 rplSpsFlag0 = uiCode;
2909 }
2910
2911 // explicit RPL in picture header
2912 auto const rpl = picHeader->getRPL( listIdx );
2913 if (!uiCode)
2914 {
2915 (*rpl) = ReferencePictureList();
2916 parseRefPicList(sps, rpl, -1);
2917 picHeader->setRPLIdx(listIdx, -1);
2918 }
2919 // use list from SPS
2920 else
2921 {
2922 if (sps->getNumRPL(listIdx) > 1 &&
2923 (listIdx == 0 || (listIdx == 1 && pps->getRpl1IdxPresentFlag())))

3403void HLSyntaxReader::checkAlfNaluTidAndPicTid(Slice* pcSlice, PicHeader* picHeader, ParameterSetManager *parameterSetManager)
3404{
3405 SPS* sps = parameterSetManager->getSPS(picHeader->getSPSId());
3406 PPS* pps = parameterSetManager->getPPS(picHeader->getPPSId());
3407 int curPicTid = pcSlice->getTLayer();
3408 APS* aps;
3409 const std::vector<int>& apsId = picHeader->getAlfAPSs();
3410
3411 if (sps->getALFEnabledFlag() && pps->getAlfInfoInPhFlag() && picHeader->getAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Y))
3412 {
3413 //luma
3414 for (int i = 0; i < picHeader->getNumAlfAps(); i++)
3415 {
3416 aps = parameterSetManager->getAPS(apsId[i], ALF_APS);
3417 CHECK(aps->getTemporalId() > curPicTid, "The TemporalId of the APS NAL unit having aps_params_type equal to ALF_APS and adaptation_parameter_set_id equal to ph_alf_aps_id_luma[ i ] shall be less than or equal to the TemporalId of the picture associated with the PH.");
3418 if( pcSlice->getNalUnitLayerId() != aps->getLayerId() )
3419 {
3420 CHECK( aps->getLayerId() > pcSlice->getNalUnitLayerId(), "Layer Id of APS cannot be greater than layer Id of VCL NAL unit the refer to it" );
3421 CHECK( pcSlice->getSPS()->getVPSId() == 0, "VPSId of the referred SPS cannot be 0 when layer Id of APS and layer Id of current slice are different" );
3422 for (int i = 0; i < pcSlice->getVPS()->getNumOutputLayerSets(); i++ )
3423 {
3424 bool isCurrLayerInOls = false;
3425 bool isRefLayerInOls = false;
3426 for( int j = pcSlice->getVPS()->getNumLayersInOls(i) - 1; j >= 0; j-- )
3427 {
3428 if( pcSlice->getVPS()->getLayerIdInOls(i, j) == pcSlice->getNalUnitLayerId() )
3429 {
3430 isCurrLayerInOls = true;
3431 }
3432 if( pcSlice->getVPS()->getLayerIdInOls(i, j) == aps->getLayerId() )
3433 {
3434 isRefLayerInOls = true;
3435 }
3436 }
3437 CHECK( isCurrLayerInOls && !isRefLayerInOls, "When VCL NAl unit in layer A refers to APS in layer B, all OLS that contains layer A shall also contains layer B" );
3438 }
3439 }
3440 }
3441 //chroma
3442 if (picHeader->getAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cb) || picHeader->getAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cr))
3443 {
3444 int chromaAlfApsId = picHeader->getAlfApsIdChroma();
3445 aps = parameterSetManager->getAPS(chromaAlfApsId, ALF_APS);
3446 CHECK(aps->getTemporalId() > curPicTid, "The TemporalId of the APS NAL unit having aps_params_type equal to ALF_APS and adaptation_parameter_set_id equal to ph_alf_aps_id_chroma shall be less than or equal to the TemporalId of the picture associated with the PH.");
3447 if( pcSlice->getNalUnitLayerId() != aps->getLayerId() )
3448 {
3449 CHECK( aps->getLayerId() > pcSlice->getNalUnitLayerId(), "Layer Id of APS cannot be greater than layer Id of VCL NAL unit the refer to it" );
3450 CHECK( pcSlice->getSPS()->getVPSId() == 0, "VPSId of the referred SPS cannot be 0 when layer Id of APS and layer Id of current slice are different" );
3451 for (int i = 0; i < pcSlice->getVPS()->getNumOutputLayerSets(); i++ )
3452 {
3453 bool isCurrLayerInOls = false;
3454 bool isRefLayerInOls = false;
3455 for( int j = pcSlice->getVPS()->getNumLayersInOls(i) - 1; j >= 0; j-- )
3456 {
3457 if( pcSlice->getVPS()->getLayerIdInOls(i, j) == pcSlice->getNalUnitLayerId() )
3458 {
3459 isCurrLayerInOls = true;
3460 }
3461 if( pcSlice->getVPS()->getLayerIdInOls(i, j) == aps->getLayerId() )
3462 {
3463 isRefLayerInOls = true;
3464 }
3465 }
3466 CHECK( isCurrLayerInOls && !isRefLayerInOls, "When VCL NAl unit in layer A refers to APS in layer B, all OLS that contains layer A shall also contains layer B" );
3467 }
3468 }
3469 }
3470 }
3471}
3472void HLSyntaxReader::parseSliceHeader (Slice* pcSlice, PicHeader* picHeader, ParameterSetManager *parameterSetManager, const int prevTid0POC, const int prevPicPOC)
3473{
3474 uint32_t uiCode;
3475 int iCode;
3476
3477#if ENABLE_TRACING
3478 xTraceSliceHeader();
3479#endif
3480 PPS* pps = NULL;
3481 SPS* sps = NULL;
3482 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sh_picture_header_in_slice_header_flag");
3483 pcSlice->setPictureHeaderInSliceHeader(uiCode);
3484 if (uiCode)
3485 {
3486 parsePictureHeader(picHeader, parameterSetManager, false);
3487 picHeader->setValid();
3488 }
3489 CHECK(picHeader==0, "Invalid Picture Header");
3490 CHECK(picHeader->isValid()==false, "Invalid Picture Header");
3491 checkAlfNaluTidAndPicTid(pcSlice, picHeader, parameterSetManager);
3492 pps = parameterSetManager->getPPS( picHeader->getPPSId() );
3494 CHECK(pps==0, "Invalid PPS");
3495 sps = parameterSetManager->getSPS(pps->getSPSId());
3497 CHECK(sps==0, "Invalid SPS");
3498 if (sps->getProfileTierLevel()->getConstraintInfo()->getPicHeaderInSliceHeaderConstraintFlag())
3499 {
3500 CHECK(pcSlice->getPictureHeaderInSliceHeader() == false, "PH shall be present in SH, when pic_header_in_slice_header_constraint_flag is equal to 1");
3501 }
3502 CHECK(pcSlice->getPictureHeaderInSliceHeader() && pps->getRplInfoInPhFlag() == 1, "When sh_picture_header_in_slice_header_flag is equal to 1, rpl_info_in_ph_flag shall be equal to 0");
3503 CHECK(pcSlice->getPictureHeaderInSliceHeader() && pps->getDbfInfoInPhFlag() == 1, "When sh_picture_header_in_slice_header_flag is equal to 1, dbf_info_in_ph_flag shall be equal to 0");
3504 CHECK(pcSlice->getPictureHeaderInSliceHeader() && pps->getSaoInfoInPhFlag() == 1, "When sh_picture_header_in_slice_header_flag is equal to 1, sao_info_in_ph_flag shall be equal to 0");
3505 CHECK(pcSlice->getPictureHeaderInSliceHeader() && pps->getAlfInfoInPhFlag() == 1, "When sh_picture_header_in_slice_header_flag is equal to 1, alf_info_in_ph_flag shall be equal to 0");
3506 CHECK(pcSlice->getPictureHeaderInSliceHeader() && pps->getWpInfoInPhFlag() == 1, "When sh_picture_header_in_slice_header_flag is equal to 1, wp_info_in_ph_flag shall be equal to 0");
3507 CHECK(pcSlice->getPictureHeaderInSliceHeader() && pps->getQpDeltaInfoInPhFlag() == 1, "When sh_picture_header_in_slice_header_flag is equal to 1, qp_delta_info_in_ph_flag shall be equal to 0");
3508 CHECK(pcSlice->getPictureHeaderInSliceHeader() && sps->getSubPicInfoPresentFlag() == 1, "When sps_subpic_info_present_flag is equal to 1, the value of sh_picture_header_in_slice_header_flag shall be equal to 0");
3509 CHECK(sps->getSubPicInfoPresentFlag() == 1 && sps->getVirtualBoundariesEnabledFlag() == 1 && sps->getVirtualBoundariesPresentFlag() == 0,
3510 "when sps_subpic_info_present_flag is equal to 1 and sps_virtual_boundaries_enabled_flag is equal to 1, sps_virtual_boundaries_present_flag shall be equal 1");
3511
3512 const ChromaFormat chFmt = sps->getChromaFormatIdc();
3513 const uint32_t numValidComp=getNumberValidComponents(chFmt);
3514 const bool bChroma=(chFmt!=CHROMA_400);
3515
3516 // picture order count
3517 uiCode = picHeader->getPocLsb();
3518 int iPOClsb = uiCode;
3519 int iMaxPOClsb = 1 << sps->getBitsForPOC();
3520 int iPOCmsb;
3521 if (pcSlice->getIdrPicFlag())
3522 {
3523 if (picHeader->getPocMsbPresentFlag())
3524 {
3525 iPOCmsb = picHeader->getPocMsbVal()*iMaxPOClsb;
3526 }
3527 else
3528 {
3529 iPOCmsb = 0;
3530 }
3531 pcSlice->setPOC(iPOCmsb + iPOClsb);
3532 }
3533 else
3534 {
3535 int iPrevPOC = prevTid0POC;
3536 int iPrevPOClsb = iPrevPOC & (iMaxPOClsb - 1);
3537 int iPrevPOCmsb = iPrevPOC - iPrevPOClsb;
3538 if (picHeader->getPocMsbPresentFlag())
3539 {
3540 iPOCmsb = picHeader->getPocMsbVal()*iMaxPOClsb;
3541 }
3542 else
3543 {
3544 if ((iPOClsb < iPrevPOClsb) && ((iPrevPOClsb - iPOClsb) >= (iMaxPOClsb / 2)))
3545 {
3546 iPOCmsb = iPrevPOCmsb + iMaxPOClsb;
3547 }
3548 else if ((iPOClsb > iPrevPOClsb) && ((iPOClsb - iPrevPOClsb) > (iMaxPOClsb / 2)))
3549 {
3550 iPOCmsb = iPrevPOCmsb - iMaxPOClsb;
3551 }
3552 else
3553 {
3554 iPOCmsb = iPrevPOCmsb;
3555 }
3556 }
3557 pcSlice->setPOC(iPOCmsb + iPOClsb);
3558 }
3559
3560 if (sps->getSubPicInfoPresentFlag())
3561 {
3562 uint32_t bitsSubPicId;
3563 bitsSubPicId = sps->getSubPicIdLen();
3564 READ_CODE(bitsSubPicId, uiCode, "sh_subpic_id"); pcSlice->setSliceSubPicId(uiCode);
3565 }
3566 else
3567 {
3568 pcSlice->setSliceSubPicId(0);
3569 }
3570
3571 // raster scan slices
3572 uint32_t sliceAddr = 0;
3573 if(pps->getRectSliceFlag() == 0)
3574 {
3575 // slice address is the raster scan tile index of first tile in slice
3576 if( pps->getNumTiles() > 1 )
3577 {
3578 int bitsSliceAddress = ceilLog2(pps->getNumTiles());
3579 READ_CODE(bitsSliceAddress, uiCode, "sh_slice_address"); sliceAddr = uiCode;
3580 }
3581 }
3582 // rectangular slices
3583 else
3584 {
3585 // slice address is the index of the slice within the current sub-picture
3586 uint32_t currSubPicIdx = pps->getSubPicIdxFromSubPicId( pcSlice->getSliceSubPicId() );
3587 SubPic currSubPic = pps->getSubPic(currSubPicIdx);
3588 if( currSubPic.getNumSlicesInSubPic() > 1 )
3589 {
3590 int bitsSliceAddress = ceilLog2(currSubPic.getNumSlicesInSubPic());
3591 READ_CODE(bitsSliceAddress, uiCode, "sh_slice_address"); sliceAddr = uiCode;
3592 CHECK(sliceAddr >= currSubPic.getNumSlicesInSubPic(), "Invalid slice address");
3593 }
3594 uint32_t picLevelSliceIdx = sliceAddr;
3595 for(int subpic = 0; subpic < currSubPicIdx; subpic++)
3596 {
3597 picLevelSliceIdx += pps->getSubPic(subpic).getNumSlicesInSubPic();
3598 }
3599 pcSlice->setSliceMap( pps->getSliceMap(picLevelSliceIdx) );
3600 pcSlice->setSliceID(picLevelSliceIdx);
3601 }
3602
3603 std::vector<bool> shExtraBitsPresent = sps->getExtraSHBitPresentFlags();
3604 for (int i=0; i< sps->getNumExtraSHBytes() * 8; i++)
3605 {
3606 // extra bits are ignored (when present)
3607 if (shExtraBitsPresent[i])
3608 {
3609 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sh_extra_bit[ i ]");
3610 }
3611 }
3612
3613 if(pps->getRectSliceFlag() == 0)
3614 {
3615 uint32_t numTilesInSlice = 1;
3616 if( pps->getNumTiles() > 1 )
3617 {
3618 if (((int)pps->getNumTiles() - (int)sliceAddr) > 1)
3619 {
3620 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "sh_num_tiles_in_slice_minus1"); numTilesInSlice = uiCode + 1;
3621 }
3622 if (!pps->getRectSliceFlag() && sps->getProfileTierLevel()->getConstraintInfo()->getOneSlicePerPicConstraintFlag())
3623 {
3624 CHECK(pps->getNumTiles() != uiCode + 1, "When pps_rect_slice_flag is equal to 0 and one_slice_per_pic_constraint_flag equal to 1, the value of sh_num_tiles_in_slice_minus1 present in each slice header shall be equal to NumTilesInPic - 1");
3625 }
3626 }
3627 CHECK(sliceAddr >= pps->getNumTiles(), "Invalid slice address");
3628 pcSlice->initSliceMap();
3629 pcSlice->setSliceID(sliceAddr);
3630
3631 for( uint32_t tileIdx = sliceAddr; tileIdx < sliceAddr + numTilesInSlice; tileIdx++ )
3632 {
3633 uint32_t tileX = tileIdx % pps->getNumTileColumns();
3634 uint32_t tileY = tileIdx / pps->getNumTileColumns();
3635 CHECK(tileY >= pps->getNumTileRows(), "Number of tiles in slice exceeds the remaining number of tiles in picture");
3636
3637 pcSlice->addCtusToSlice(pps->getTileColumnBd(tileX), pps->getTileColumnBd(tileX + 1),
3638 pps->getTileRowBd(tileY), pps->getTileRowBd(tileY + 1), pps->getPicWidthInCtu());
3639 }
3640 }
3641
3642 if (picHeader->getPicInterSliceAllowedFlag())
3643 {
3644 READ_UVLC ( uiCode, "sh_slice_type" ); pcSlice->setSliceType((SliceType)uiCode);
3645 VPS *vps = parameterSetManager->getVPS(sps->getVPSId());
3646 if (pcSlice->isIRAP() && (sps->getVPSId() == 0 || pcSlice->getPOC() != prevPicPOC || vps->getIndependentLayerFlag(vps->getGeneralLayerIdx(pcSlice->getNalUnitLayerId())) == 1))
3647 {
3648 CHECK(uiCode != 2, "When nal_unit_type is in the range of IDR_W_RADL to CRA_NUT, inclusive, and vps_independent_layer_flag[ GeneralLayerIdx[ nuh_layer_id ] ] is equal to 1 or the current picture is the first picture in the current AU, sh_slice_type shall be equal to 2");
3649 }
3650 }
3651 else
3652 {
3653 pcSlice->setSliceType(I_SLICE);
3654 }
3655 if (!picHeader->getPicIntraSliceAllowedFlag())
3656 {
3657 CHECK(pcSlice->getSliceType() == I_SLICE, "when ph_intra_slice_allowed_flag = 0, no I_Slice is allowed");
3658 }
3659 if (pcSlice->getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_CRA || pcSlice->getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_N_LP || pcSlice->getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_IDR_W_RADL || pcSlice->getNalUnitType() == NAL_UNIT_CODED_SLICE_GDR)
3660 {
3661 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sh_no_output_of_prior_pics_flag"); pcSlice->setNoOutputOfPriorPicsFlag(uiCode != 0);
3662 }
3663 // inherit values from picture header
3664 // set default values in case slice overrides are disabled
3665 pcSlice->inheritFromPicHeader(picHeader, pps, sps);
3666
3667 if (sps->getALFEnabledFlag() && !pps->getAlfInfoInPhFlag())
3668 {
3669 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sh_alf_enabled_flag");
3670 pcSlice->setTileGroupAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Y, uiCode);
3671 int alfCbEnabledFlag = 0;
3672 int alfCrEnabledFlag = 0;
3673
3674 if (uiCode)
3675 {
3676 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "sh_num_alf_aps_ids_luma");
3677 int numAps = uiCode;
3678 pcSlice->setTileGroupNumAps(numAps);
3679 std::vector<int> apsId(numAps, -1);
3680 for (int i = 0; i < numAps; i++)
3681 {
3682 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "sh_alf_aps_id_luma[i]");
3683 apsId[i] = uiCode;
3684 APS* APStoCheckLuma = parameterSetManager->getAPS(apsId[i], ALF_APS);
3685 CHECK(APStoCheckLuma == nullptr, "referenced APS not found");
3686 CHECK(APStoCheckLuma->getAlfAPSParam().newFilterFlag[CHANNEL_TYPE_LUMA] != 1, "bitstream conformance error, alf_luma_filter_signal_flag shall be equal to 1");
3687 }
3688
3689
3690 pcSlice->setAlfAPSs(apsId);
3691 if (bChroma)
3692 {
3693 READ_CODE(1, uiCode, "sh_alf_cb_enabled_flag"); alfCbEnabledFlag = uiCode;
3694 READ_CODE(1, uiCode, "sh_alf_cr_enabled_flag"); alfCrEnabledFlag = uiCode;
3695 }
3696 else
3697 {
3698 alfCbEnabledFlag = 0;
3699 alfCrEnabledFlag = 0;
3700 }
3701 if (alfCbEnabledFlag || alfCrEnabledFlag)
3702 {
3703 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "sh_alf_aps_id_chroma");
3704 pcSlice->setTileGroupApsIdChroma(uiCode);
3705 APS* APStoCheckChroma = parameterSetManager->getAPS(uiCode, ALF_APS);
3706 CHECK(APStoCheckChroma == nullptr, "referenced APS not found");
3707 CHECK(APStoCheckChroma->getAlfAPSParam().newFilterFlag[CHANNEL_TYPE_CHROMA] != 1, "bitstream conformance error, alf_chroma_filter_signal_flag shall be equal to 1");
3708 }
3709 }
3710 else
3711 {
3712 pcSlice->setTileGroupNumAps(0);
3713 }
3714 pcSlice->setTileGroupAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cb, alfCbEnabledFlag);
3715 pcSlice->setTileGroupAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Cr, alfCrEnabledFlag);
3716
3717 CcAlfFilterParam &filterParam = pcSlice->m_ccAlfFilterParam;
3718 if (sps->getCCALFEnabledFlag() && pcSlice->getTileGroupAlfEnabledFlag(COMPONENT_Y))
3719 {
3720 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sh_alf_cc_cb_enabled_flag");
3721 pcSlice->setTileGroupCcAlfCbEnabledFlag(uiCode);
3722 filterParam.ccAlfFilterEnabled[COMPONENT_Cb - 1] = (uiCode == 1) ? true : false;
3723 pcSlice->setTileGroupCcAlfCbApsId(-1);
3724 if (filterParam.ccAlfFilterEnabled[COMPONENT_Cb - 1])
3725 {
3726 // parse APS ID
3727 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "sh_alf_cc_cb_aps_id");
3728 pcSlice->setTileGroupCcAlfCbApsId(uiCode);
3729 }
3730 // Cr
3731 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sh_alf_cc_cr_enabled_flag");
3732 pcSlice->setTileGroupCcAlfCrEnabledFlag(uiCode);
3733 filterParam.ccAlfFilterEnabled[COMPONENT_Cr - 1] = (uiCode == 1) ? true : false;
3734 pcSlice->setTileGroupCcAlfCrApsId(-1);
3735 if (filterParam.ccAlfFilterEnabled[COMPONENT_Cr - 1])
3736 {
3737 // parse APS ID
3738 READ_CODE(3, uiCode, "sh_alf_cc_cr_aps_id");
3739 pcSlice->setTileGroupCcAlfCrApsId(uiCode);
3740 }
3741 }
3742 else
3743 {
3744 filterParam.ccAlfFilterEnabled[COMPONENT_Cb - 1] = false;
3745 filterParam.ccAlfFilterEnabled[COMPONENT_Cr - 1] = false;
3746 pcSlice->setTileGroupCcAlfCbApsId(-1);
3747 pcSlice->setTileGroupCcAlfCrApsId(-1);
3748 }
3749 }
3750 if (picHeader->getLmcsEnabledFlag() && !pcSlice->getPictureHeaderInSliceHeader())
3751 {
3752 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sh_lmcs_used_flag");
3753 pcSlice->setLmcsEnabledFlag(uiCode);
3754 }
3755 else
3756 {
3757 pcSlice->setLmcsEnabledFlag(pcSlice->getPictureHeaderInSliceHeader() ? picHeader->getLmcsEnabledFlag() : false);
3758 }
3759 if (picHeader->getExplicitScalingListEnabledFlag() && !pcSlice->getPictureHeaderInSliceHeader())
3760 {
3761 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sh_explicit_scaling_list_used_flag");
3762 pcSlice->setExplicitScalingListUsed(uiCode);
3763 }
3764 else
3765 {
3766 pcSlice->setExplicitScalingListUsed(pcSlice->getPictureHeaderInSliceHeader() ? picHeader->getExplicitScalingListEnabledFlag() : false);
3767 }
3768
3769 if( pps->getRplInfoInPhFlag() )
3770 {
3771 *pcSlice->getRPL0() = *picHeader->getRPL0();
3772 *pcSlice->getRPL1() = *picHeader->getRPL1();
3773 }
3774 else if( pcSlice->getIdrPicFlag() && !(sps->getIDRRefParamListPresent()) )
3775 {
3776 ReferencePictureList* rpl0 = pcSlice->getRPL0();
3777 (*rpl0) = ReferencePictureList();
3778 ReferencePictureList* rpl1 = pcSlice->getRPL1();
3779 (*rpl1) = ReferencePictureList();
3780 }
3781 else
3782 {
3783 //Read L0 related syntax elements
3784 bool rplSpsFlag0 = 0;
3785
3786 if (sps->getNumRPL0() > 0)
3787 {
3788 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ref_pic_list_sps_flag[0]");
3789 }
3790 else
3791 {
3792 uiCode = 0;
3793 }
3794
3795 rplSpsFlag0 = uiCode;
3796
3797 auto const rpl0 = pcSlice->getRPL0();
3798 if (!uiCode) //explicitly carried in this SH
3799 {
3800 (*rpl0) = ReferencePictureList();
3801 parseRefPicList(sps, rpl0, -1);
3802 pcSlice->setRPL0idx(-1);
3803 }
3804 else //Refer to list in SPS
3805 {
3806 if (sps->getNumRPL0() > 1)
3807 {
3808 int numBits = ceilLog2(sps->getNumRPL0());
3809 READ_CODE(numBits, uiCode, "ref_pic_list_idx[0]");
3810 pcSlice->setRPL0idx(uiCode);
3811 *rpl0 = *sps->getRPLList0()->getReferencePictureList(uiCode);
3812 }
3813 else
3814 {
3815 pcSlice->setRPL0idx(0);
3816 *rpl0 = *sps->getRPLList0()->getReferencePictureList(0);
3817 }
3818 }
3819 //Deal POC Msb cycle signalling for LTRP
3820 for (int i = 0; i < rpl0->getNumberOfLongtermPictures() + rpl0->getNumberOfShorttermPictures(); i++)
3821 {
3822 rpl0->setDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i, false);
3823 rpl0->setDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i, 0);
3824 }
3825 if (rpl0->getNumberOfLongtermPictures())
3826 {
3827 for (int i = 0; i < rpl0->getNumberOfLongtermPictures() + rpl0->getNumberOfShorttermPictures(); i++)
3828 {
3829 if (rpl0->isRefPicLongterm(i))
3830 {
3831 if (rpl0->getLtrpInSliceHeaderFlag())
3832 {
3833 READ_CODE(sps->getBitsForPOC(), uiCode, "slice_poc_lsb_lt[i][j]");
3834 rpl0->setRefPicIdentifier( i, uiCode, true, false, 0 );
3835 }
3836 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "delta_poc_msb_present_flag[i][j]");
3837 rpl0->setDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i, uiCode ? true : false);
3838 if (uiCode)
3839 {
3840 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "slice_delta_poc_msb_cycle_lt[i][j]");
3841 if(i != 0)
3842 {
3843 uiCode += rpl0->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i-1);
3844 }
3845 rpl0->setDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i, uiCode);
3846 }
3847 else if(i != 0)
3848 {
3849 rpl0->setDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i, rpl0->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i-1));
3850 }
3851 else
3852 {
3853 rpl0->setDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i,0);
3854 }
3855 }
3856 else if(i != 0)
3857 {
3858 rpl0->setDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i, rpl0->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i-1));
3859 }
3860 else
3861 {
3862 rpl0->setDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i,0);
3863 }
3864 }
3865 }
3866
3867 //Read L1 related syntax elements
3868 if (sps->getNumRPL(1) > 0 && pps->getRpl1IdxPresentFlag())
3869 {
3870 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ref_pic_list_sps_flag[1]");
3871 }
3872 else if (sps->getNumRPL(1) == 0)
3873 {
3874 uiCode = 0;
3875 }
3876 else
3877 {
3878 uiCode = rplSpsFlag0;
3879 }
3880
3881 auto const rpl1 = pcSlice->getRPL1();
3882 if (uiCode == 1)
3883 {
3884 if (sps->getNumRPL(1) > 1 && pps->getRpl1IdxPresentFlag())
3885 {
3886 int numBits = ceilLog2(sps->getNumRPL1());
3887 READ_CODE(numBits, uiCode, "ref_pic_list_idx[1]");
3888 *rpl1 = *sps->getRPLList1()->getReferencePictureList(uiCode);
3889 }
3890 else if (sps->getNumRPL(1) == 1)
3891 {
3892 *rpl1 = *sps->getRPLList1()->getReferencePictureList(0);
3893 }
3894 else
3895 {
3896 assert(pcSlice->getRPL0idx() != -1);
3897 pcSlice->setRPL1idx(pcSlice->getRPL0idx());
3898 *rpl1 = *sps->getRPLList1()->getReferencePictureList(pcSlice->getRPL0idx());
3899 }
3900 }
3901 else
3902 {
3903 (*rpl1) = ReferencePictureList();
3904 parseRefPicList(sps, rpl1, -1);
3905 pcSlice->setRPL1idx(-1);
3906 }
3907
3908 //Deal POC Msb cycle signalling for LTRP
3909 for (int i = 0; i < rpl1->getNumberOfLongtermPictures() + rpl1->getNumberOfShorttermPictures(); i++)
3910 {
3911 rpl1->setDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i, false);
3912 rpl1->setDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i, 0);
3913 }
3914 if (rpl1->getNumberOfLongtermPictures())
3915 {
3916 for (int i = 0; i < rpl1->getNumberOfLongtermPictures() + rpl1->getNumberOfShorttermPictures(); i++)
3917 {
3918 if (rpl1->isRefPicLongterm(i))
3919 {
3920 if (rpl1->getLtrpInSliceHeaderFlag())
3921 {
3922 READ_CODE(sps->getBitsForPOC(), uiCode, "slice_poc_lsb_lt[i][j]");
3923 rpl1->setRefPicIdentifier( i, uiCode, true, false, 0 );
3924 }
3925 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "delta_poc_msb_present_flag[i][j]");
3926 rpl1->setDeltaPocMSBPresentFlag(i, uiCode ? true : false);
3927 if (uiCode)
3928 {
3929 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "slice_delta_poc_msb_cycle_lt[i][j]");
3930 if(i != 0)
3931 {
3932 uiCode += rpl1->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i-1);
3933 }
3934 rpl1->setDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i, uiCode);
3935 }
3936 else if(i != 0)
3937 {
3938 rpl1->setDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i, rpl1->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i-1));
3939 }
3940 else
3941 {
3942 rpl1->setDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i,0);
3943 }
3944 }
3945 else if(i != 0)
3946 {
3947 rpl1->setDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i, rpl1->getDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i-1));
3948 }
3949 else
3950 {
3951 rpl1->setDeltaPocMSBCycleLT(i,0);
3952 }
3953 }
3954 }
3955
3956 }
3957 if( !pps->getRplInfoInPhFlag() && pcSlice->getIdrPicFlag() && !(sps->getIDRRefParamListPresent()) )
3958 {
3959 pcSlice->setNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_0, 0);
3960 pcSlice->setNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_1, 0);
3961 }
3962 if ((!pcSlice->isIntra() && pcSlice->getRPL0()->getNumRefEntries() > 1) ||
3963 (pcSlice->isInterB() && pcSlice->getRPL1()->getNumRefEntries() > 1) )
3964 {
3965 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "sh_num_ref_idx_active_override_flag");
3966 if (uiCode)
3967 {
3968 if(pcSlice->getRPL0()->getNumRefEntries() > 1)
3969 {
3970 READ_UVLC (uiCode, "sh_num_ref_idx_active_minus1[0]" );
3971 }
3972 else
3973 {
3974 uiCode = 0;
3975 }
3976 pcSlice->setNumRefIdx( REF_PIC_LIST_0, uiCode + 1 );
3977 if (pcSlice->isInterB())
3978 {
3979 if(pcSlice->getRPL1()->getNumRefEntries() > 1)
3980 {
3981 READ_UVLC (uiCode, "sh_num_ref_idx_active_minus1[1]" );
3982 }
3983 else
3984 {
3985 uiCode = 0;
3986 }
3987 pcSlice->setNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_1, uiCode + 1);
3988 }
3989 else
3990 {
3991 pcSlice->setNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_1, 0);
3992 }
3993 }
3994 else
3995 {
3996 if(pcSlice->getRPL0()->getNumRefEntries() >= pps->getNumRefIdxL0DefaultActive())
3997 {
3998 pcSlice->setNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_0, pps->getNumRefIdxL0DefaultActive());
3999 }
4000 else
4001 {
4002 pcSlice->setNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_0, pcSlice->getRPL0()->getNumRefEntries());
4003 }
4004
4005 if (pcSlice->isInterB())
4006 {
4007 if(pcSlice->getRPL1()->getNumRefEntries() >= pps->getNumRefIdxL1DefaultActive())
4008 {
4009 pcSlice->setNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_1, pps->getNumRefIdxL1DefaultActive());
4010 }
4011 else
4012 {
4013 pcSlice->setNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_1, pcSlice->getRPL1()->getNumRefEntries());
4014 }
4015 }
4016 else
4017 {
4018 pcSlice->setNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_1, 0);
4019 }
4020 }
4021 }
4022 else
4023 {
4024 pcSlice->setNumRefIdx( REF_PIC_LIST_0, pcSlice->isIntra() ? 0 : 1 );
4025 pcSlice->setNumRefIdx( REF_PIC_LIST_1, pcSlice->isInterB() ? 1 : 0 );
4026 }
4027
4028 if (pcSlice->isInterP() || pcSlice->isInterB())
4029 {
4030 CHECK(pcSlice->getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_0) == 0, "Number of active entries in RPL0 of P or B picture shall be greater than 0");
4031 if (pcSlice->isInterB())
4032 CHECK(pcSlice->getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_1) == 0, "Number of active entries in RPL1 of B picture shall be greater than 0");
4033 }
4034
4035
4036 pcSlice->setCabacInitFlag( false ); // default
4037 if(pps->getCabacInitPresentFlag() && !pcSlice->isIntra())
4038 {
4039 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sh_cabac_init_flag");
4040 pcSlice->setCabacInitFlag( uiCode ? true : false );
4041 pcSlice->setEncCABACTableIdx( pcSlice->getSliceType() == B_SLICE ? ( uiCode ? P_SLICE : B_SLICE ) : ( uiCode ? B_SLICE : P_SLICE ) );
4042 }
4043
4044 if ( picHeader->getEnableTMVPFlag() )
4045 {
4046 if( pcSlice->getSliceType() == P_SLICE )
4047 {
4048 pcSlice->setColFromL0Flag( true );
4049 }
4050 else if( !pps->getRplInfoInPhFlag() && pcSlice->getSliceType() == B_SLICE )
4051 {
4052 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "sh_collocated_from_l0_flag" );
4053 pcSlice->setColFromL0Flag( uiCode );
4054 }
4055 else
4056 {
4057 pcSlice->setColFromL0Flag( picHeader->getPicColFromL0Flag() );
4058 }
4059
4060 if (!pps->getRplInfoInPhFlag())
4061 {
4062 if ( pcSlice->getSliceType() != I_SLICE &&
4063 ((pcSlice->getColFromL0Flag() == 1 && pcSlice->getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_0) > 1)||
4064 (pcSlice->getColFromL0Flag() == 0 && pcSlice->getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_1) > 1)))
4065 {
4066 READ_UVLC( uiCode, "sh_collocated_ref_idx" );
4067 pcSlice->setColRefIdx(uiCode);
4068 }
4069 else
4070 {
4071 pcSlice->setColRefIdx(0);
4072 }
4073
4074 }
4075 else
4076 {
4077 pcSlice->setColRefIdx(picHeader->getColRefIdx());
4078 }
4079 }
4080 if ( (pps->getUseWP() && pcSlice->getSliceType()==P_SLICE) || (pps->getWPBiPred() && pcSlice->getSliceType()==B_SLICE) )
4081 {
4082 if (pps->getWpInfoInPhFlag())
4083 {
4084 CHECK(pcSlice->getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_0) > picHeader->getNumL0Weights(), "ERROR: Number of active reference picture L0 is greater than the number of weighted prediction signalled in Picture Header");
4085 CHECK(pcSlice->getNumRefIdx(REF_PIC_LIST_1) > picHeader->getNumL1Weights(), "ERROR: Number of active reference picture L1 is greater than the number of weighted prediction signalled in Picture Header");
4086 pcSlice->setWpScaling(picHeader->getWpScalingAll());
4087 }
4088 else
4089 {
4090 parsePredWeightTable(pcSlice, sps);
4091 }
4092 pcSlice->initWpScaling(sps);
4093 }
4094 else
4095 {
4096 for ( int iNumRef=0 ; iNumRef<((pcSlice->getSliceType() == B_SLICE )?2:1); iNumRef++ )
4097 {
4098 RefPicList eRefPicList = ( iNumRef ? REF_PIC_LIST_1 : REF_PIC_LIST_0 );
4099 for ( int iRefIdx=0 ; iRefIdx<pcSlice->getNumRefIdx(eRefPicList) ; iRefIdx++ )
4100 {
4101 WPScalingParam *wp = pcSlice->getWpScaling(eRefPicList, iRefIdx);
4102
4103 wp[0].presentFlag = false;
4104 wp[1].presentFlag = false;
4105 wp[2].presentFlag = false;
4106 }
4107 }
4108 }
4109
4110 int qpDelta = 0;
4111 if (pps->getQpDeltaInfoInPhFlag())
4112 {
4113 qpDelta = picHeader->getQpDelta();
4114 }
4115 else
4116 {
4117 READ_SVLC(iCode, "sh_qp_delta");
4118 qpDelta = iCode;
4119 }
4120 pcSlice->setSliceQp(26 + pps->getPicInitQPMinus26() + qpDelta);
4121 pcSlice->setSliceQpBase(pcSlice->getSliceQp());
4122
4123 CHECK( pcSlice->getSliceQp() < -sps->getQpBDOffset(CHANNEL_TYPE_LUMA), "Invalid slice QP delta" );
4124 CHECK( pcSlice->getSliceQp() > MAX_QP, "Invalid slice QP" );
4125
4126 if (pps->getSliceChromaQpFlag())
4127 {
4128 if (numValidComp>COMPONENT_Cb)
4129 {
4130 READ_SVLC( iCode, "sh_cb_qp_offset" );
4131 pcSlice->setSliceChromaQpDelta(COMPONENT_Cb, iCode );
4132 CHECK( pcSlice->getSliceChromaQpDelta(COMPONENT_Cb) < -12, "Invalid chroma QP offset" );
4133 CHECK( pcSlice->getSliceChromaQpDelta(COMPONENT_Cb) > 12, "Invalid chroma QP offset" );
4134 CHECK( (pps->getQpOffset(COMPONENT_Cb) + pcSlice->getSliceChromaQpDelta(COMPONENT_Cb)) < -12, "Invalid chroma QP offset" );
4135 CHECK( (pps->getQpOffset(COMPONENT_Cb) + pcSlice->getSliceChromaQpDelta(COMPONENT_Cb)) > 12, "Invalid chroma QP offset" );
4136 }
4137
4138 if (numValidComp>COMPONENT_Cr)
4139 {
4140 READ_SVLC( iCode, "sh_cr_qp_offset" );
4141 pcSlice->setSliceChromaQpDelta(COMPONENT_Cr, iCode );
4142 CHECK( pcSlice->getSliceChromaQpDelta(COMPONENT_Cr) < -12, "Invalid chroma QP offset" );
4143 CHECK( pcSlice->getSliceChromaQpDelta(COMPONENT_Cr) > 12, "Invalid chroma QP offset" );
4144 CHECK( (pps->getQpOffset(COMPONENT_Cr) + pcSlice->getSliceChromaQpDelta(COMPONENT_Cr)) < -12, "Invalid chroma QP offset" );
4145 CHECK( (pps->getQpOffset(COMPONENT_Cr) + pcSlice->getSliceChromaQpDelta(COMPONENT_Cr)) > 12, "Invalid chroma QP offset" );
4146 if (sps->getJointCbCrEnabledFlag())
4147 {
4148 READ_SVLC(iCode, "sh_joint_cbcr_qp_offset" );
4149 pcSlice->setSliceChromaQpDelta(JOINT_CbCr, iCode);
4150 CHECK( pcSlice->getSliceChromaQpDelta(JOINT_CbCr) < -12, "Invalid chroma QP offset");
4151 CHECK( pcSlice->getSliceChromaQpDelta(JOINT_CbCr) > 12, "Invalid chroma QP offset");
4152 CHECK( (pps->getQpOffset(JOINT_CbCr) + pcSlice->getSliceChromaQpDelta(JOINT_CbCr)) < -12, "Invalid chroma QP offset");
4153 CHECK( (pps->getQpOffset(JOINT_CbCr) + pcSlice->getSliceChromaQpDelta(JOINT_CbCr)) > 12, "Invalid chroma QP offset");
4154 }
4155 }
4156 }
4157
4158 if (pps->getCuChromaQpOffsetListEnabledFlag())
4159 {
4160 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sh_cu_chroma_qp_offset_enabled_flag"); pcSlice->setUseChromaQpAdj(uiCode != 0);
4161 }
4162 else
4163 {
4164 pcSlice->setUseChromaQpAdj(false);
4165 }
4166
4167 if (sps->getSAOEnabledFlag() && !pps->getSaoInfoInPhFlag())
4168 {
4169 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sh_sao_luma_used_flag"); pcSlice->setSaoEnabledFlag(CHANNEL_TYPE_LUMA, (bool)uiCode);
4170
4171 if (bChroma)
4172 {
4173 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sh_sao_chroma_used_flag"); pcSlice->setSaoEnabledFlag(CHANNEL_TYPE_CHROMA, (bool)uiCode);
4174 }
4175 }
4176
4177
4178 if (pps->getDeblockingFilterControlPresentFlag())
4179 {
4180 if (pps->getDeblockingFilterOverrideEnabledFlag() && !pps->getDbfInfoInPhFlag())
4181 {
4182 READ_FLAG ( uiCode, "sh_deblocking_params_present_flag" ); pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterOverrideFlag(uiCode ? true : false);
4183 }
4184 else
4185 {
4186 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterOverrideFlag(0);
4187 }
4188 if(pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterOverrideFlag())
4189 {
4190 if (!pps->getPPSDeblockingFilterDisabledFlag())
4191 {
4192 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sh_deblocking_filter_disabled_flag"); pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterDisable(uiCode ? 1 : 0);
4193 }
4194 else
4195 {
4196 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterDisable(false);
4197 }
4198 if(!pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterDisable())
4199 {
4200 READ_SVLC( iCode, "sh_luma_beta_offset_div2" ); pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterBetaOffsetDiv2( iCode );
4201 CHECK( pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterBetaOffsetDiv2() < -12 ||
4202 pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterBetaOffsetDiv2() > 12, "Invalid deblocking filter configuration");
4203 READ_SVLC( iCode, "sh_luma_tc_offset_div2" ); pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterTcOffsetDiv2( iCode );
4204 CHECK( pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterTcOffsetDiv2() < -12 ||
4205 pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterTcOffsetDiv2() > 12, "Invalid deblocking filter configuration");
4206
4207 if( pps->getPPSChromaToolFlag() )
4208 {
4209 READ_SVLC( iCode, "sh_cb_beta_offset_div2" ); pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterCbBetaOffsetDiv2( iCode );
4210 CHECK( pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterCbBetaOffsetDiv2() < -12 ||
4211 pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterCbBetaOffsetDiv2() > 12, "Invalid deblocking filter configuration" );
4212 READ_SVLC( iCode, "sh_cb_tc_offset_div2" ); pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterCbTcOffsetDiv2( iCode );
4213 CHECK( pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterCbTcOffsetDiv2() < -12 ||
4214 pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterCbTcOffsetDiv2() > 12, "Invalid deblocking filter configuration" );
4215
4216 READ_SVLC( iCode, "sh_cr_beta_offset_div2" ); pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterCrBetaOffsetDiv2( iCode );
4217 CHECK( pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterCrBetaOffsetDiv2() < -12 ||
4218 pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterCrBetaOffsetDiv2() > 12, "Invalid deblocking filter configuration" );
4219 READ_SVLC( iCode, "sh_cr_tc_offset_div2" ); pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterCrTcOffsetDiv2( iCode );
4220 CHECK( pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterCrTcOffsetDiv2() < -12 ||
4221 pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterCrTcOffsetDiv2() > 12, "Invalid deblocking filter configuration" );
4222 }
4223 else
4224 {
4225 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterCbBetaOffsetDiv2 ( pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterBetaOffsetDiv2() );
4226 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterCbTcOffsetDiv2 ( pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterTcOffsetDiv2() );
4227 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterCrBetaOffsetDiv2 ( pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterBetaOffsetDiv2() );
4228 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterCrTcOffsetDiv2 ( pcSlice->getDeblockingFilterTcOffsetDiv2() );
4229 }
4230 }
4231 }
4232 else
4233 {
4234 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterDisable ( picHeader->getDeblockingFilterDisable() );
4235 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterBetaOffsetDiv2( picHeader->getDeblockingFilterBetaOffsetDiv2() );
4236 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterTcOffsetDiv2 ( picHeader->getDeblockingFilterTcOffsetDiv2() );
4237 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterCbBetaOffsetDiv2( picHeader->getDeblockingFilterCbBetaOffsetDiv2() );
4238 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterCbTcOffsetDiv2 ( picHeader->getDeblockingFilterCbTcOffsetDiv2() );
4239 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterCrBetaOffsetDiv2(picHeader->getDeblockingFilterCrBetaOffsetDiv2());
4240 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterCrTcOffsetDiv2(picHeader->getDeblockingFilterCrTcOffsetDiv2());
4241 }
4242 }
4243 else
4244 {
4245 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterDisable ( false );
4246 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterBetaOffsetDiv2( 0 );
4247 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterTcOffsetDiv2 ( 0 );
4248 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterCbBetaOffsetDiv2( 0 );
4249 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterCbTcOffsetDiv2 ( 0 );
4250 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterCrBetaOffsetDiv2( 0 );
4251 pcSlice->setDeblockingFilterCrTcOffsetDiv2 ( 0 );
4252 }
4253
4254 // dependent quantization
4255 if( sps->getDepQuantEnabledFlag() )
4256 {
4257 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sh_dep_quant_used_flag");
4258 pcSlice->setDepQuantEnabledFlag(uiCode != 0);
4259 }
4260 else
4261 {
4262 pcSlice->setDepQuantEnabledFlag(false);
4263 }
4264
4265 // sign data hiding
4266 if( sps->getSignDataHidingEnabledFlag() && !pcSlice->getDepQuantEnabledFlag() )
4267 {
4268 READ_FLAG( uiCode, "sh_sign_data_hiding_used_flag" );
4269 pcSlice->setSignDataHidingEnabledFlag( uiCode != 0 );
4270 }
4271 else
4272 {
4273 pcSlice->setSignDataHidingEnabledFlag(false);
4274 }
4275
4276 // signal TS residual coding disabled flag
4277 if (sps->getTransformSkipEnabledFlag() && !pcSlice->getDepQuantEnabledFlag() && !pcSlice->getSignDataHidingEnabledFlag())
4278 {
4279 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sh_ts_residual_coding_disabled_flag");
4280 pcSlice->setTSResidualCodingDisabledFlag( uiCode != 0 );
4281 }
4282 else
4283 {
4284 pcSlice->setTSResidualCodingDisabledFlag( false );
4285 }
4286
4287 if( pcSlice->getFirstCtuRsAddrInSlice() == 0 )
4288 {
4289 pcSlice->setDefaultClpRng( *sps );
4290
4291 }
4292
4293 if(pps->getSliceHeaderExtensionPresentFlag())
4294 {
4295 READ_UVLC(uiCode,"sh_slice_header_extension_length");
4296 for(int i=0; i<uiCode; i++)
4297 {
4298 uint32_t ignore_;
4299 READ_CODE(8,ignore_,"sh_slice_header_extension_data_byte");
4300 }
4301 }
4302
4303 std::vector<uint32_t> entryPointOffset;
4304
4305 pcSlice->resetNumberOfSubstream();
4306 pcSlice->setNumSubstream(sps, pps);
4307
4308 pcSlice->setNumEntryPoints( sps, pps );
4309 if( pcSlice->getNumEntryPoints() > 0 )
4310 {
4311 uint32_t offsetLenMinus1;
4312 READ_UVLC( offsetLenMinus1, "sh_entry_offset_len_minus1" );
4313 entryPointOffset.resize( pcSlice->getNumEntryPoints() );
4314 for( uint32_t idx = 0; idx < pcSlice->getNumEntryPoints(); idx++ )
4315 {
4316 READ_CODE( offsetLenMinus1 + 1, uiCode, "sh_entry_point_offset_minus1" );
4317 entryPointOffset[idx] = uiCode + 1;
4318 }
4319 }
4320
4321#if RExt__DECODER_DEBUG_BIT_STATISTICS
4322 CodingStatistics::IncrementStatisticEP(STATS__BYTE_ALIGNMENT_BITS,m_pcBitstream->readByteAlignment(),0);
4323#else
4324 m_pcBitstream->readByteAlignment();
4325#endif
4326
4327 pcSlice->clearSubstreamSizes();
4328
4329 if( pcSlice->getNumEntryPoints() > 0 )
4330 {
4331 int endOfSliceHeaderLocation = m_pcBitstream->getByteLocation();
4332
4333 // Adjust endOfSliceHeaderLocation to account for emulation prevention bytes in the slice segment header
4334 for ( uint32_t curByteIdx = 0; curByteIdx<m_pcBitstream->numEmulationPreventionBytesRead(); curByteIdx++ )
4335 {
4336 if ( m_pcBitstream->getEmulationPreventionByteLocation( curByteIdx ) < endOfSliceHeaderLocation )
4337 {
4338 endOfSliceHeaderLocation++;
4339 }
4340 }
4341
4342 int curEntryPointOffset = 0;
4343 int prevEntryPointOffset = 0;
4344 for (uint32_t idx=0; idx<entryPointOffset.size(); idx++)
4345 {
4346 curEntryPointOffset += entryPointOffset[ idx ];
4347
4348 int emulationPreventionByteCount = 0;
4349 for ( uint32_t curByteIdx = 0; curByteIdx<m_pcBitstream->numEmulationPreventionBytesRead(); curByteIdx++ )
4350 {
4351 if ( m_pcBitstream->getEmulationPreventionByteLocation( curByteIdx ) >= ( prevEntryPointOffset + endOfSliceHeaderLocation ) &&
4352 m_pcBitstream->getEmulationPreventionByteLocation( curByteIdx ) < ( curEntryPointOffset + endOfSliceHeaderLocation ) )
4353 {
4354 emulationPreventionByteCount++;
4355 }
4356 }
4357
4358 entryPointOffset[ idx ] -= emulationPreventionByteCount;
4359 prevEntryPointOffset = curEntryPointOffset;
4360 pcSlice->addSubstreamSize(entryPointOffset [ idx ] );
4361 }
4362 }
4363 return;
4364}
4365
4366void HLSyntaxReader::getSlicePoc(Slice* pcSlice, PicHeader* picHeader, ParameterSetManager *parameterSetManager, const int prevTid0POC)
4367{
4368 uint32_t uiCode;
4369 uint32_t pocLsb;
4370 PPS* pps = NULL;
4371 SPS* sps = NULL;
4372
4373 CHECK(picHeader==0, "Invalid Picture Header");
4374 CHECK(picHeader->isValid()==false, "Invalid Picture Header");
4375 pps = parameterSetManager->getPPS( picHeader->getPPSId() );
4377 CHECK(pps==0, "Invalid PPS");
4378 sps = parameterSetManager->getSPS(pps->getSPSId());
4380 CHECK(sps==0, "Invalid SPS");
4381
4382 DTRACE_UPDATE( g_trace_ctx, std::make_pair( "final", 0 ) );
4383
4384 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "sh_picture_header_in_slice_header_flag");
4385 if (uiCode == 0)
4386 {
4387 pocLsb = picHeader->getPocLsb();
4388 }
4389 else
4390 {
4391 uint32_t phGdrOrIrapPicFlag;
4392 READ_FLAG(phGdrOrIrapPicFlag, "ph_gdr_or_irap_pic_flag");
4393 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ph_non_ref_pic_flag");
4394 if (phGdrOrIrapPicFlag)
4395 {
4396 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ph_gdr_pic_flag");
4397 }
4398 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ph_inter_slice_allowed_flag");
4399 if (uiCode)
4400 {
4401 READ_FLAG(uiCode, "ph_intra_slice_allowed_flag");
4402 }
4403 // parameter sets
4404 READ_UVLC(uiCode, "ph_pic_parameter_set_id");
4405 // picture order count
4406 READ_CODE(sps->getBitsForPOC(), pocLsb, "ph_pic_order_cnt_lsb");
4407 }
4408 int maxPocLsb = 1 << sps->getBitsForPOC();
4409 int pocMsb;
4410 if (pcSlice->getIdrPicFlag())
4411 {
4412 if (picHeader->getPocMsbPresentFlag())
4413 {
4414 pocMsb = picHeader->getPocMsbVal()*maxPocLsb;
4415 }
4416 else
4417 {
4418 pocMsb = 0;
4419 }
4420 pcSlice->setPOC(pocMsb + pocLsb);
4421 }
4422 else
4423 {
4424 int prevPoc = prevTid0POC;
4425 int prevPocLsb = prevPoc & (maxPocLsb - 1);
4426 int prevPocMsb = prevPoc - prevPocLsb;
4427 if (picHeader->getPocMsbPresentFlag())
4428 {
4429 pocMsb = picHeader->getPocMsbVal()*maxPocLsb;
4430 }
4431 else
4432 {
4433 if ((pocLsb < prevPocLsb) && ((prevPocLsb - pocLsb) >= (maxPocLsb / 2)))
4434 {
4435 pocMsb = prevPocMsb + maxPocLsb;
4436 }
4437 else if ((pocLsb > prevPocLsb) && ((pocLsb - prevPocLsb) > (maxPocLsb / 2)))
4438 {
4439 pocMsb = prevPocMsb - maxPocLsb;
4440 }
4441 else
4442 {
4443 pocMsb = prevPocMsb;
4444 }
4445 }
4446 pcSlice->setPOC(pocMsb + pocLsb);
4447 }
4448 DTRACE_UPDATE( g_trace_ctx, std::make_pair( "final", 1 ) );
4449}
4450
4451void HLSyntaxReader::parseConstraintInfo(ConstraintInfo *cinfo)
4452{
4453 uint32_t symbol;
4454 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_present_flag"); cinfo->setGciPresentFlag(symbol ? true : false);
4455 if (cinfo->getGciPresentFlag())
4456 {
4457 /* general */
4458 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_intra_only_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setIntraOnlyConstraintFlag(symbol ? true : false);
4459 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_all_layers_independent_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setAllLayersIndependentConstraintFlag(symbol ? true : false);
4460 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_one_au_only_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setOnePictureOnlyConstraintFlag(symbol ? true : false);
4461
4462 /* picture format */
4463 READ_CODE(4, symbol, "gci_sixteen_minus_max_bitdepth_constraint_idc"); cinfo->setMaxBitDepthConstraintIdc(symbol>8 ? 16 : (16 - symbol));
4464 CHECK(symbol>8, "gci_sixteen_minus_max_bitdepth_constraint_idc shall be in the range 0 to 8, inclusive");
4465 READ_CODE(2, symbol, "gci_three_minus_max_chroma_format_constraint_idc"); cinfo->setMaxChromaFormatConstraintIdc((ChromaFormat)(3 - symbol));
4466
4467 /* NAL unit type related */
4468 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_mixed_nalu_types_in_pic_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoMixedNaluTypesInPicConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4469 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_trail_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoTrailConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4470 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_stsa_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoStsaConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4471 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_rasl_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoRaslConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4472 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_radl_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoRadlConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4473 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_idr_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoIdrConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4474 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_cra_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoCraConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4475 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_gdr_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoGdrConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4476 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_aps_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoApsConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4477 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_idr_rpl_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoIdrRplConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4478
4479 /* tile, slice, subpicture partitioning */
4480 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_one_tile_per_pic_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setOneTilePerPicConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4481 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_pic_header_in_slice_header_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setPicHeaderInSliceHeaderConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4482 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_one_slice_per_pic_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setOneSlicePerPicConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4483 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_rectangular_slice_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoRectSliceConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4484 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_one_slice_per_subpic_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setOneSlicePerSubpicConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4485 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_subpic_info_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoSubpicInfoConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4486
4487 /* CTU and block partitioning */
4488 READ_CODE(2, symbol, "gci_three_minus_max_log2_ctu_size_constraint_idc"); cinfo->setMaxLog2CtuSizeConstraintIdc(((3 - symbol) + 5));
4489 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_partition_constraints_override_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoPartitionConstraintsOverrideConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4490 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_mtt_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoMttConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4491 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_qtbtt_dual_tree_intra_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoQtbttDualTreeIntraConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4492
4493 /* intra */
4494 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_palette_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoPaletteConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4495 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_ibc_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoIbcConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4496 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_isp_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoIspConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4497 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_mrl_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoMrlConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4498 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_mip_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoMipConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4499 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_cclm_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoCclmConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4500
4501 /* inter */
4502 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_ref_pic_resampling_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoRprConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4503 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_res_change_in_clvs_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoResChangeInClvsConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4504 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_weighted_prediction_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoWeightedPredictionConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4505 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_ref_wraparound_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoRefWraparoundConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4506 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_temporal_mvp_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoTemporalMvpConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4507 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_sbtmvp_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoSbtmvpConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4508 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_amvr_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoAmvrConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4509 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_bdof_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoBdofConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4510 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_smvd_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoSmvdConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4511 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_dmvr_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoDmvrConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4512 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_mmvd_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoMmvdConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4513 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_affine_motion_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoAffineMotionConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4514 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_prof_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoProfConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4515 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_bcw_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoBcwConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4516 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_ciip_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoCiipConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4517 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_gpm_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoGeoConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4518
4519 /* transform, quantization, residual */
4520 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_luma_transform_size_64_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoLumaTransformSize64ConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4521 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_transform_skip_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoTransformSkipConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4522 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_bdpcm_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoBDPCMConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4523 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_mts_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoMtsConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4524 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_lfnst_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoLfnstConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4525 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_joint_cbcr_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoJointCbCrConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4526 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_sbt_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoSbtConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4527 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_act_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoActConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4528 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_explicit_scaling_list_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoExplicitScaleListConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4529 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_dep_quant_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoDepQuantConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4530 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_sign_data_hiding_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoSignDataHidingConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4531 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_cu_qp_delta_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoCuQpDeltaConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4532 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_chroma_qp_offset_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoChromaQpOffsetConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4533
4534 /* loop filter */
4535 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_sao_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoSaoConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4536 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_alf_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoAlfConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4537 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_ccalf_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoCCAlfConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4538 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_lmcs_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoLmcsConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4539 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_ladf_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoLadfConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4540 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_no_virtual_boundaries_constraint_flag"); cinfo->setNoVirtualBoundaryConstraintFlag(symbol > 0 ? true : false);
4541 READ_CODE(8, symbol, "gci_num_reserved_bits");
4542 uint32_t const numReservedBits = symbol;
4543 for (int i = 0; i < numReservedBits; i++)
4544 {
4545 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_reserved_zero_bit"); CHECK(symbol != 0, "gci_reserved_zero_bit not equal to zero");
4546 }
4547 }
4548 while (!isByteAligned())
4549 {
4550 READ_FLAG(symbol, "gci_alignment_zero_bit"); CHECK(symbol != 0, "gci_alignment_zero_bit not equal to zero");
4551 }
4552}

4554
4555void HLSyntaxReader::parseProfileTierLevel(ProfileTierLevel *ptl, bool profileTierPresentFlag, int maxNumSubLayersMinus1)
4556{
4557 uint32_t symbol;
4558 if(profileTierPresentFlag)
4559 {
4560 READ_CODE(7 , symbol, "general_profile_idc" ); ptl->setProfileIdc (Profile::Name(symbol));
4561 READ_FLAG( symbol, "general_tier_flag" ); ptl->setTierFlag (symbol ? Level::HIGH : Level::MAIN);
4562 }
4563
4564 READ_CODE( 8, symbol, "general_level_idc" ); ptl->setLevelIdc( Level::Name( symbol ) );
4565
4566 READ_FLAG( symbol, "ptl_frame_only_constraint_flag" ); ptl->setFrameOnlyConstraintFlag(symbol);
4567 READ_FLAG( symbol, "ptl_multilayer_enabled_flag" ); ptl->setMultiLayerEnabledFlag(symbol);
4568 CHECK((ptl->getProfileIdc() == Profile::MAIN_10 || ptl->getProfileIdc() == Profile::MAIN_10_444
4569 || ptl->getProfileIdc() == Profile::MAIN_10_STILL_PICTURE
4570 || ptl->getProfileIdc() == Profile::MAIN_10_444_STILL_PICTURE)
4571 && symbol,
4572 "ptl_multilayer_enabled_flag shall be equal to 0 for non-multilayer profiles");
4573
4574 if(profileTierPresentFlag)
4575 {
4576 parseConstraintInfo(ptl->getConstraintInfo());
4577 }
4578
4579 for (int i = maxNumSubLayersMinus1 - 1; i >= 0; i--)
4580 {
4581 READ_FLAG( symbol, "sub_layer_level_present_flag[i]" ); ptl->setSubLayerLevelPresentFlag (i, symbol);
4582 }
4583
4584 while (!isByteAligned())
4585 {
4586 READ_FLAG( symbol, "ptl_reserved_zero_bit" ); CHECK (symbol != 0, "ptl_reserved_zero_bit not equal to zero");
4587 }
4588
4589 for (int i = maxNumSubLayersMinus1 - 1; i >= 0; i--)
4590 {
4591 if (ptl->getSubLayerLevelPresentFlag(i))
4592 {
4593 READ_CODE(8 , symbol, "sub_layer_level_idc" ); ptl->setSubLayerLevelIdc (i, Level::Name(symbol));
4594 }
4595 }
4596 ptl->setSubLayerLevelIdc(maxNumSubLayersMinus1, ptl->getLevelIdc());
4597 for( int i = maxNumSubLayersMinus1 - 1; i >= 0; i-- )
4598 {
4599 if( !ptl->getSubLayerLevelPresentFlag( i ) )
4600 {
4601 ptl->setSubLayerLevelIdc( i, ptl->getSubLayerLevelIdc( i + 1 ) );
4602 }
4603 }
4604
4605 if (profileTierPresentFlag)
4606 {
4607 READ_CODE(8, symbol, "ptl_num_sub_profiles");
4608 uint8_t numSubProfiles = symbol;
4609 ptl->setNumSubProfile(numSubProfiles);
4610 for (int i = 0; i < numSubProfiles; i++)
4611 {
4612 READ_CODE(32, symbol, "general_sub_profile_idc[i]");
4613 ptl->setSubProfileIdc(i, symbol);
4614 }
4615 }
4616}
