4620void HLSyntaxReader::parseTerminatingBit( uint32_t& ruiBit )
4621{
4622 ruiBit = false;
4623 int iBitsLeft = m_pcBitstream->getNumBitsLeft();
4624 if(iBitsLeft <= 8)
4625 {
4626 uint32_t uiPeekValue = m_pcBitstream->peekBits(iBitsLeft);
4627 if (uiPeekValue == (1<<(iBitsLeft-1)))
4628 {
4629 ruiBit = true;
4630 }
4631 }
4632}
4633
4634void HLSyntaxReader::parseRemainingBytes( bool noTrailingBytesExpected )
4635{
4636 if (noTrailingBytesExpected)
4637 {
4638 CHECK( 0 != m_pcBitstream->getNumBitsLeft(), "Bits left although no bits expected" );
4639 }
4640 else
4641 {
4642 while (m_pcBitstream->getNumBitsLeft())
4643 {
4644 uint32_t trailingNullByte=m_pcBitstream->readByte();
4645 if (trailingNullByte!=0)
4646 {
4647 msg( ERROR, "Trailing byte should be 0, but has value %02x\n", trailingNullByte);
4648 THROW("Invalid trailing '0' byte");
4649 }
4650 }
4651 }
4652}

4660
4662void HLSyntaxReader::parsePredWeightTable( Slice* pcSlice, const SPS *sps )
4663{
4664 const ChromaFormat chFmt = sps->getChromaFormatIdc();
4665 const int numValidComp = int(getNumberValidComponents(chFmt));
4666 const bool bChroma = (chFmt!=CHROMA_400);
4667 const SliceType eSliceType = pcSlice->getSliceType();
4668 const int iNbRef = (eSliceType == B_SLICE ) ? (2) : (1);
4669 uint32_t uiLog2WeightDenomLuma=0, uiLog2WeightDenomChroma=0;
4670 uint32_t uiTotalSignalledWeightFlags = 0;
4671
4672 int iDeltaDenom;
4673 // decode delta_luma_log2_weight_denom :
4674 READ_UVLC( uiLog2WeightDenomLuma, "luma_log2_weight_denom" );
4675 CHECK( uiLog2WeightDenomLuma > 7, "The value of luma_log2_weight_denom shall be in the range of 0 to 7" );
4676 if( bChroma )
4677 {
4678 READ_SVLC( iDeltaDenom, "delta_chroma_log2_weight_denom" );
4679 CHECK((iDeltaDenom + (int)uiLog2WeightDenomLuma)<0, "luma_log2_weight_denom + delta_chroma_log2_weight_denom shall be in the range of 0 to 7");
4680 CHECK((iDeltaDenom + (int)uiLog2WeightDenomLuma)>7, "luma_log2_weight_denom + delta_chroma_log2_weight_denom shall be in the range of 0 to 7");
4681 uiLog2WeightDenomChroma = (uint32_t)(iDeltaDenom + uiLog2WeightDenomLuma);
4682 }
4683
4684 for ( int iNumRef=0 ; iNumRef<iNbRef ; iNumRef++ ) // loop over l0 and l1 syntax elements
4685 {
4686 RefPicList eRefPicList = ( iNumRef ? REF_PIC_LIST_1 : REF_PIC_LIST_0 );
4687 for ( int iRefIdx=0 ; iRefIdx<pcSlice->getNumRefIdx(eRefPicList) ; iRefIdx++ )
4688 {
4689 WPScalingParam *wp = pcSlice->getWpScaling(eRefPicList, iRefIdx);
4690
4691 wp[COMPONENT_Y].log2WeightDenom = uiLog2WeightDenomLuma;
4692 for(int j=1; j<numValidComp; j++)
4693 {
4694 wp[j].log2WeightDenom = uiLog2WeightDenomChroma;
4695 }
4696
4697 uint32_t uiCode;
4698 READ_FLAG( uiCode, iNumRef==0?"luma_weight_l0_flag[i]":"luma_weight_l1_flag[i]" );
4699 wp[COMPONENT_Y].presentFlag = (uiCode == 1);
4700 uiTotalSignalledWeightFlags += wp[COMPONENT_Y].presentFlag;
4701 }
4702 if ( bChroma )
4703 {
4704 uint32_t uiCode;
4705 for ( int iRefIdx=0 ; iRefIdx<pcSlice->getNumRefIdx(eRefPicList) ; iRefIdx++ )
4706 {
4707 WPScalingParam *wp = pcSlice->getWpScaling(eRefPicList, iRefIdx);
4708 READ_FLAG( uiCode, iNumRef==0?"chroma_weight_l0_flag[i]":"chroma_weight_l1_flag[i]" );
4709 for(int j=1; j<numValidComp; j++)
4710 {
4711 wp[j].presentFlag = (uiCode == 1);
4712 }
4713 uiTotalSignalledWeightFlags += 2 * wp[COMPONENT_Cb].presentFlag;
4714 }
4715 }
4716 else
4717 {
4718 for ( int iRefIdx=0; iRefIdx<MAX_NUM_REF; iRefIdx++ )
4719 {
4720 WPScalingParam *wp = pcSlice->getWpScaling(eRefPicList, iRefIdx);
4721
4722 wp[COMPONENT_Cb].presentFlag = false;
4723 wp[COMPONENT_Cr].presentFlag = false;
4724 }
4725 }
4726 for ( int iRefIdx=0 ; iRefIdx<pcSlice->getNumRefIdx(eRefPicList) ; iRefIdx++ )
4727 {
4728 WPScalingParam *wp = pcSlice->getWpScaling(eRefPicList, iRefIdx);
4729 if (wp[COMPONENT_Y].presentFlag)
4730 {
4731 int iDeltaWeight;
4732 READ_SVLC( iDeltaWeight, iNumRef==0?"delta_luma_weight_l0[i]":"delta_luma_weight_l1[i]" );
4733 CHECK( iDeltaWeight < -128, "delta_luma_weight_lx shall be in the rage of -128 to 127" );
4734 CHECK( iDeltaWeight > 127, "delta_luma_weight_lx shall be in the rage of -128 to 127" );
4735 wp[COMPONENT_Y].codedWeight = (iDeltaWeight + (1 << wp[COMPONENT_Y].log2WeightDenom));
4736 READ_SVLC(wp[COMPONENT_Y].codedOffset, iNumRef == 0 ? "luma_offset_l0[i]" : "luma_offset_l1[i]");
4737 const int range=sps->getSpsRangeExtension().getHighPrecisionOffsetsEnabledFlag() ? (1<<sps->getBitDepth(CHANNEL_TYPE_LUMA))/2 : 128;
4738 CHECK(wp[0].codedOffset < -range, "luma_offset_lx shall be in the rage of -128 to 127");
4739 CHECK(wp[0].codedOffset >= range, "luma_offset_lx shall be in the rage of -128 to 127");
4740 }
4741 else
4742 {
4743 wp[COMPONENT_Y].codedWeight = (1 << wp[COMPONENT_Y].log2WeightDenom);
4744 wp[COMPONENT_Y].codedOffset = 0;
4745 }
4746 if ( bChroma )
4747 {
4748 if (wp[COMPONENT_Cb].presentFlag)
4749 {
4750 int range=sps->getSpsRangeExtension().getHighPrecisionOffsetsEnabledFlag() ? (1<<sps->getBitDepth(CHANNEL_TYPE_CHROMA))/2 : 128;
4751 for ( int j=1 ; j<numValidComp ; j++ )
4752 {
4753 int iDeltaWeight;
4754 READ_SVLC( iDeltaWeight, iNumRef==0?"delta_chroma_weight_l0[i]":"delta_chroma_weight_l1[i]" );
4755 CHECK( iDeltaWeight < -128, "delta_chroma_weight_lx shall be in the rage of -128 to 127" );
4756 CHECK( iDeltaWeight > 127, "delta_chroma_weight_lx shall be in the rage of -128 to 127" );
4757 wp[j].codedWeight = (iDeltaWeight + (1 << wp[j].log2WeightDenom));
4758
4759 int iDeltaChroma;
4760 READ_SVLC( iDeltaChroma, iNumRef==0?"delta_chroma_offset_l0[i]":"delta_chroma_offset_l1[i]" );
4761 CHECK( iDeltaChroma < -4*range, "delta_chroma_offset_lx shall be in the range of -4 * 128 to 4 * 127" );
4762 CHECK( iDeltaChroma > 4*(range-1), "delta_chroma_offset_lx shall be in the range of -4 * 128 to 4 * 127" );
4763 int pred = (range - ((range * wp[j].codedWeight) >> (wp[j].log2WeightDenom)));
4764 wp[j].codedOffset = Clip3(-range, range - 1, (iDeltaChroma + pred));
4765 }
4766 }
4767 else
4768 {
4769 for ( int j=1 ; j<numValidComp ; j++ )
4770 {
4771 wp[j].codedWeight = (1 << wp[j].log2WeightDenom);
4772 wp[j].codedOffset = 0;
4773 }
4774 }
4775 }
4776 }
4777
4778 for ( int iRefIdx=pcSlice->getNumRefIdx(eRefPicList) ; iRefIdx<MAX_NUM_REF ; iRefIdx++ )
4779 {
4780 WPScalingParam *wp = pcSlice->getWpScaling(eRefPicList, iRefIdx);
4781
4782 wp[COMPONENT_Y].presentFlag = false;
4783 wp[COMPONENT_Cb].presentFlag = false;
4784 wp[COMPONENT_Cr].presentFlag = false;
4785 }
4786 }
4787 CHECK(uiTotalSignalledWeightFlags>24, "Too many weight flag signalled");
4788}
4789
4790void HLSyntaxReader::parsePredWeightTable(PicHeader *picHeader, const PPS *pps, const SPS *sps)
4791{
4792 WPScalingParam * wp;
4793 const ChromaFormat chFmt = sps->getChromaFormatIdc();
4794 const int numValidComp = int(getNumberValidComponents(chFmt));
4795 const bool chroma = (chFmt != CHROMA_400);
4796 uint32_t log2WeightDenomLuma = 0;
4797 uint32_t log2WeightDenomChroma = 0;
4798 uint32_t totalSignalledWeightFlags = 0;
4799
4800 int deltaDenom;
4801 READ_UVLC(log2WeightDenomLuma, "luma_log2_weight_denom");
4802 CHECK(log2WeightDenomLuma > 7, "The value of luma_log2_weight_denom shall be in the range of 0 to 7");
4803 if (chroma)
4804 {
4805 READ_SVLC(deltaDenom, "delta_chroma_log2_weight_denom");
4806 CHECK((deltaDenom + (int) log2WeightDenomLuma) < 0, "luma_log2_weight_denom + delta_chroma_log2_weight_denom shall be in the range of 0 to 7");
4807 CHECK((deltaDenom + (int) log2WeightDenomLuma) > 7, "luma_log2_weight_denom + delta_chroma_log2_weight_denom shall be in the range of 0 to 7");
4808 log2WeightDenomChroma = (uint32_t)(deltaDenom + log2WeightDenomLuma);
4809 }
4810
4811 uint32_t numLxWeights;
4812 READ_UVLC(numLxWeights, "num_l0_weights");
4813 picHeader->setNumL0Weights(numLxWeights);
4814 picHeader->setNumL1Weights(0);
4815
4816 bool moreSyntaxToBeParsed = true;
4817 for (int numRef = 0; numRef < NUM_REF_PIC_LIST_01 && moreSyntaxToBeParsed; numRef++)
4818 {
4819 RefPicList refPicList = (numRef ? REF_PIC_LIST_1 : REF_PIC_LIST_0);
4820 for (int refIdx = 0; refIdx < numLxWeights; refIdx++)
4821 {
4822 wp = picHeader->getWpScaling(refPicList, refIdx);
4823
4824 wp[COMPONENT_Y].log2WeightDenom = log2WeightDenomLuma;
4825 for (int j = 1; j < numValidComp; j++)
4826 {
4827 wp[j].log2WeightDenom = log2WeightDenomChroma;
4828 }
4829
4830 uint32_t uiCode;
4831 READ_FLAG(uiCode, numRef == 0 ? "luma_weight_l0_flag[i]" : "luma_weight_l1_flag[i]");
4832 wp[COMPONENT_Y].presentFlag = (uiCode == 1);
4833 totalSignalledWeightFlags += wp[COMPONENT_Y].presentFlag;
4834 }
4835 if (chroma)
4836 {
4837 uint32_t uiCode;
4838 for (int refIdx = 0; refIdx < numLxWeights; refIdx++)
4839 {
4840 wp = picHeader->getWpScaling(refPicList, refIdx);
4841 READ_FLAG(uiCode, numRef == 0 ? "chroma_weight_l0_flag[i]" : "chroma_weight_l1_flag[i]");
4842 for (int j = 1; j < numValidComp; j++)
4843 {
4844 wp[j].presentFlag = (uiCode == 1);
4845 }
4846 totalSignalledWeightFlags += 2 * wp[COMPONENT_Cb].presentFlag;
4847 }
4848 }
4849 else
4850 {
4851 for ( int refIdx=0; refIdx<MAX_NUM_REF; refIdx++ )
4852 {
4853 wp = picHeader->getWpScaling(refPicList, refIdx);
4854 wp[1].presentFlag = false;
4855 wp[2].presentFlag = false;
4856 }
4857 }
4858 for (int refIdx = 0; refIdx < numLxWeights; refIdx++)
4859 {
4860 wp = picHeader->getWpScaling(refPicList, refIdx);
4861 if (wp[COMPONENT_Y].presentFlag)
4862 {
4863 int deltaWeight;
4864 READ_SVLC(deltaWeight, numRef == 0 ? "delta_luma_weight_l0[i]" : "delta_luma_weight_l1[i]");
4865 CHECK(deltaWeight < -128, "delta_luma_weight_lx shall be in the rage of -128 to 127");
4866 CHECK(deltaWeight > 127, "delta_luma_weight_lx shall be in the rage of -128 to 127");
4867 wp[COMPONENT_Y].codedWeight = (deltaWeight + (1 << wp[COMPONENT_Y].log2WeightDenom));
4868 READ_SVLC(wp[COMPONENT_Y].codedOffset, numRef == 0 ? "luma_offset_l0[i]" : "luma_offset_l1[i]");
4869 const int range = sps->getSpsRangeExtension().getHighPrecisionOffsetsEnabledFlag() ? (1 << sps->getBitDepth(CHANNEL_TYPE_LUMA)) / 2 : 128;
4870 CHECK(wp[0].codedOffset < -range, "luma_offset_lx shall be in the rage of -128 to 127");
4871 CHECK(wp[0].codedOffset >= range, "luma_offset_lx shall be in the rage of -128 to 127");
4872 }
4873 else
4874 {
4875 wp[COMPONENT_Y].codedWeight = (1 << wp[COMPONENT_Y].log2WeightDenom);
4876 wp[COMPONENT_Y].codedOffset = 0;
4877 }
4878 if (chroma)
4879 {
4880 if (wp[COMPONENT_Cb].presentFlag)
4881 {
4882 int range = sps->getSpsRangeExtension().getHighPrecisionOffsetsEnabledFlag() ? (1 << sps->getBitDepth(CHANNEL_TYPE_CHROMA)) / 2 : 128;
4883 for (int j = 1; j < numValidComp; j++)
4884 {
4885 int deltaWeight;
4886 READ_SVLC(deltaWeight, numRef == 0 ? "delta_chroma_weight_l0[i]" : "delta_chroma_weight_l1[i]");
4887 CHECK( deltaWeight < -128, "delta_chroma_weight_lx shall be in the rage of -128 to 127" );
4888 CHECK( deltaWeight > 127, "delta_chroma_weight_lx shall be in the rage of -128 to 127" );
4889 wp[j].codedWeight = (deltaWeight + (1 << wp[j].log2WeightDenom));
4890
4891 int deltaChroma;
4892 READ_SVLC(deltaChroma, numRef == 0 ? "delta_chroma_offset_l0[i]" : "delta_chroma_offset_l1[i]");
4893 CHECK( deltaChroma < -4*range, "delta_chroma_offset_lx shall be in the range of -4 * 128 to 4 * 127" );
4894 CHECK( deltaChroma >= 4*range, "delta_chroma_offset_lx shall be in the range of -4 * 128 to 4 * 127" );
4895 int pred = (range - ((range * wp[j].codedWeight) >> (wp[j].log2WeightDenom)));
4896 wp[j].codedOffset = Clip3(-range, range - 1, (deltaChroma + pred));
4897 }
4898 }
4899 else
4900 {
4901 for (int j = 1; j < numValidComp; j++)
4902 {
4903 wp[j].codedWeight = (1 << wp[j].log2WeightDenom);
4904 wp[j].codedOffset = 0;
4905 }
4906 }
4907 }
4908 }
4909
4910 for (int refIdx = numLxWeights; refIdx < MAX_NUM_REF; refIdx++)
4911 {
4912 wp = picHeader->getWpScaling(refPicList, refIdx);
4913
4914 wp[0].presentFlag = false;
4915 wp[1].presentFlag = false;
4916 wp[2].presentFlag = false;
4917 }
4918
4919 if (numRef == 0)
4920 {
4921 if (pps->getWPBiPred() && picHeader->getRPL(1)->getNumRefEntries() > 0)
4922 {
4923 READ_UVLC(numLxWeights, "num_l1_weights");
4924 }
4925 else
4926 {
4927 numLxWeights = 0;
4928 }
4929 moreSyntaxToBeParsed = (numLxWeights == 0) ? false : true;
4930 picHeader->setNumL1Weights(numLxWeights);
4931 }
4932 }
4933 CHECK(totalSignalledWeightFlags > 24, "Too many weight flag signalled");
4934}
4935
4939void HLSyntaxReader::parseScalingList(ScalingList *scalingList, bool aps_chromaPrsentFlag)
4940{
4941 uint32_t code;
4942 bool scalingListCopyModeFlag;
4943 scalingList->setChromaScalingListPresentFlag(aps_chromaPrsentFlag);
4944 for (int scalingListId = 0; scalingListId < 28; scalingListId++)
4945 {
4946 if (aps_chromaPrsentFlag || scalingList->isLumaScalingList(scalingListId))
4947 {
4948 READ_FLAG(code, "scaling_list_copy_mode_flag");
4949 scalingListCopyModeFlag = (code) ? true : false;
4950 scalingList->setScalingListCopyModeFlag(scalingListId, scalingListCopyModeFlag);
4951
4952 scalingList->setScalingListPreditorModeFlag(scalingListId, false);
4953 if (!scalingListCopyModeFlag)
4954 {
4955 READ_FLAG(code, "scaling_list_predictor_mode_flag");
4956 scalingList->setScalingListPreditorModeFlag(scalingListId, code);
4957 }
4958
4959 if ((scalingListCopyModeFlag || scalingList->getScalingListPreditorModeFlag(scalingListId)) && scalingListId!= SCALING_LIST_1D_START_2x2 && scalingListId!= SCALING_LIST_1D_START_4x4 && scalingListId!= SCALING_LIST_1D_START_8x8) //Copy Mode
4960 {
4961 READ_UVLC(code, "scaling_list_pred_matrix_id_delta");
4962 scalingList->setRefMatrixId(scalingListId, (uint32_t)((int)(scalingListId)-(code)));
4963 }
4964 else if (scalingListCopyModeFlag || scalingList->getScalingListPreditorModeFlag(scalingListId))
4965 {
4966 scalingList->setRefMatrixId(scalingListId, (uint32_t)((int)(scalingListId)));
4967 }
4968 if (scalingListCopyModeFlag)//copy
4969 {
4970 if (scalingListId >= SCALING_LIST_1D_START_16x16)
4971 {
4972 scalingList->setScalingListDC(scalingListId,
4973 ((scalingListId == scalingList->getRefMatrixId(scalingListId)) ? 16
4974 : (scalingList->getRefMatrixId(scalingListId) < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_16x16) ? scalingList->getScalingListAddress(scalingList->getRefMatrixId(scalingListId))[0] : scalingList->getScalingListDC(scalingList->getRefMatrixId(scalingListId))));
4975 }
4976 scalingList->processRefMatrix(scalingListId, scalingList->getRefMatrixId(scalingListId));
4977 }
4978 else
4979 {
4980 decodeScalingList(scalingList, scalingListId, scalingList->getScalingListPreditorModeFlag(scalingListId));
4981 }
4982 }
4983 else
4984 {
4985 scalingListCopyModeFlag = true;
4986 scalingList->setScalingListCopyModeFlag(scalingListId, scalingListCopyModeFlag);
4987 scalingList->setRefMatrixId(scalingListId, (uint32_t)((int)(scalingListId)));
4988 if (scalingListId >= SCALING_LIST_1D_START_16x16)
4989 {
4990 scalingList->setScalingListDC(scalingListId, 16);
4991 }
4992 scalingList->processRefMatrix(scalingListId, scalingList->getRefMatrixId(scalingListId));
4993 }
4994 }
4995
4996 return;
4997}
4998
5004void HLSyntaxReader::decodeScalingList(ScalingList *scalingList, uint32_t scalingListId, bool isPredictor)
5005{
5006 int matrixSize = (scalingListId < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_4x4) ? 2 : (scalingListId < SCALING_LIST_1D_START_8x8) ? 4 : 8;
5007 int i, coefNum = matrixSize * matrixSize;
5008 int data;
5009 int scalingListDcCoefMinus8 = 0;
5010 int nextCoef = (isPredictor) ? 0 : SCALING_LIST_START_VALUE;
5011 ScanElement *scan = g_scanOrder[SCAN_UNGROUPED][SCAN_DIAG][gp_sizeIdxInfo->idxFrom(matrixSize)][gp_sizeIdxInfo->idxFrom(matrixSize)];
5012 int *dst = scalingList->getScalingListAddress(scalingListId);
5013
5014 int PredListId = scalingList->getRefMatrixId(scalingListId);
5015 CHECK(isPredictor && PredListId > scalingListId, "Scaling List error predictor!");
5016 const int *srcPred = (isPredictor) ? ((scalingListId == PredListId) ? scalingList->getScalingListDefaultAddress(scalingListId) : scalingList->getScalingListAddress(PredListId)) : NULL;
5017 if(isPredictor && scalingListId == PredListId)
5018 scalingList->setScalingListDC(PredListId, SCALING_LIST_DC);
5019 int predCoef = 0;
5020
5021 if (scalingListId >= SCALING_LIST_1D_START_16x16)
5022 {
5023 READ_SVLC(scalingListDcCoefMinus8, "scaling_list_dc_coef_minus8");
5024 nextCoef += scalingListDcCoefMinus8;
5025 if (isPredictor)
5026 {
5027 predCoef = (PredListId >= SCALING_LIST_1D_START_16x16) ? scalingList->getScalingListDC(PredListId) : srcPred[0];
5028 }
5029 scalingList->setScalingListDC(scalingListId, (nextCoef + predCoef + 256) & 255);
5030 }
5031
5032 for(i = 0; i < coefNum; i++)
5033 {
5034 if (scalingListId >= SCALING_LIST_1D_START_64x64 && scan[i].x >= 4 && scan[i].y >= 4)
5035 {
5036 dst[scan[i].idx] = 0;
5037 continue;
5038 }
5039 READ_SVLC( data, "scaling_list_delta_coef");
5040 nextCoef += data;
5041 predCoef = (isPredictor) ? srcPred[scan[i].idx] : 0;
5042 dst[scan[i].idx] = (nextCoef + predCoef + 256) & 255;
5043 }
5044}

5046bool HLSyntaxReader::xMoreRbspData()
5047{
5048 int bitsLeft = m_pcBitstream->getNumBitsLeft();
5049
5050 // if there are more than 8 bits, it cannot be rbsp_trailing_bits
5051 if (bitsLeft > 8)
5052 {
5053 return true;
5054 }
5055
5056 uint8_t lastByte = m_pcBitstream->peekBits(bitsLeft);
5057 int cnt = bitsLeft;
5058
5059 // remove trailing bits equal to zero
5060 while ((cnt>0) && ((lastByte & 1) == 0))
5061 {
5062 lastByte >>= 1;
5063 cnt--;
5064 }
5065 // remove bit equal to one
5066 cnt--;
5067
5068 // we should not have a negative number of bits
5069 CHECK (cnt<0, "Negative number of bits");
5070
5071 // we have more data, if cnt is not zero
5072 return (cnt>0);
5073}

5076void HLSyntaxReader::alfFilter( AlfParam& alfParam, const bool isChroma, const int altIdx )
5077{
5078 uint32_t code;
5079
5080 // derive maxGolombIdx
5081 AlfFilterShape alfShape( isChroma ? 5 : 7 );
5082 const int numFilters = isChroma ? 1 : alfParam.numLumaFilters;
5083 short* coeff = isChroma ? alfParam.chromaCoeff[altIdx] : alfParam.lumaCoeff;
5084 Pel* clipp = isChroma ? alfParam.chromaClipp[altIdx] : alfParam.lumaClipp;
5085
5086
5087 // Filter coefficients
5088 for( int ind = 0; ind < numFilters; ++ind )
5089 {
5090
5091 for( int i = 0; i < alfShape.numCoeff - 1; i++ )
5092 {
5093 READ_UVLC( code, isChroma ? "alf_chroma_coeff_abs" : "alf_luma_coeff_abs" );
5094 coeff[ ind * MAX_NUM_ALF_LUMA_COEFF + i ] = code;
5095 if( coeff[ ind * MAX_NUM_ALF_LUMA_COEFF + i ] != 0 )
5096 {
5097 READ_FLAG( code, isChroma ? "alf_chroma_coeff_sign" : "alf_luma_coeff_sign" );
5098 coeff[ ind * MAX_NUM_ALF_LUMA_COEFF + i ] = ( code ) ? -coeff[ ind * MAX_NUM_ALF_LUMA_COEFF + i ] : coeff[ ind * MAX_NUM_ALF_LUMA_COEFF + i ];
5099 }
5100 CHECK( isChroma &&
5101 ( coeff[ind * MAX_NUM_ALF_LUMA_COEFF + i] > 127 || coeff[ind * MAX_NUM_ALF_LUMA_COEFF + i] < -128 )
5102 , "AlfCoeffC shall be in the range of -128 to 127, inclusive" );
5103 }
5104 }
5105
5106 // Clipping values coding
5107 if ( alfParam.nonLinearFlag[isChroma] )
5108 {
5109
5110 // Filter coefficients
5111 for( int ind = 0; ind < numFilters; ++ind )
5112 {
5113
5114 for( int i = 0; i < alfShape.numCoeff - 1; i++ )
5115 {
5116 READ_CODE(2, code, isChroma ? "alf_chroma_clip_idx" : "alf_luma_clip_idx");
5117 clipp[ind * MAX_NUM_ALF_LUMA_COEFF + i] = code;
5118 }
5119 }
5120 }
5121 else
5122 {
5123 for( int ind = 0; ind < numFilters; ++ind )
5124 {
5125 std::fill_n( clipp + ind * MAX_NUM_ALF_LUMA_COEFF, alfShape.numCoeff, 0 );
5126 }
5127 }
5128}
